προάγω.definition: fut. pf. Act. D.19.18, 25.8, Paus.3.11.10 :-Med., v. infr.: pf. Pass. in med. sense, v. infr. I.7:-lead forward or onward, Hdt.3.148, etc.; escort on their way, Id.8.132; X.Cyr.3.3.23 :-Pass., to be led on, And.2.9. 2…

προαγωγεία.definition: pandering, procuring, Pl.Tht.150a , X.Smp.4.61, Aeschin.1.14, Arist.EN1131a7

προαγωγή.definition: leading on, promotion, Posidon.36J; progress, prosperity, OGI223.9

προαγωνίζομαι.definition: fight before, from; fight in front of, D.S.17.34; D.H.4.16: abs., Ph.2.379; fight for or in defence of another, ib.177, Plu.Flam.11, etc.; plead in behalf of, c. acc. cogn., Philostr.VS1.18.4

προαγωνιστής.definition: one who fights for another, champion, Str.16.4.25, Ph.2.312,542, Luc.Salt.14, Jul.Or.2.87a; Poll.4.34

προαδικέω.definition: to be the first in wrong-doing, Arist.Rh.Al.1425b6, Ph.2.128:—Pass., to be wronged before or first, Decr. ap. D.18.181, Aeschin.3.133, etc

προαδυνατέω.definition: to be already very weak, v.l. for in Hp.Prorrh.1.8

προᾴδω.definition: sing before, prelude, Aeschin.2.163: c. acc., Him.Or.5.4:—Pass., Poll.4.112

προαθετέω.definition: reject as spurious first, Sch.Od.2.322:—Pass., ib.1.185

προαθροίζω.definition: gather or collect before, D.C.60.27:—Pass., Gal.4.590, Poll.2.204

προαιδέομαι.definition: owe one special respect, be under obligations to one, Hdt.1.61; . . , Id.3.140

προαινίσσομαι.definition: hint or indicate before, 1 aor. Heraclit.All.66

προαίρεσις.definition: choosing one thing before another; purpose, plan, or scope of action, D.23.141, 48.56; Id.Prooem.50; Id.23.127; deliberate wickedness, Id.Ep.3.18; Zaleuc. ap. Stob.4.2.19: abs., course of life, principle of action, D.…

προαιρέτης.definition: steward, keeper, BGU362 viii 13 , cf. PLips.123.19

προαιρέω.definition: fut. Babr.108.26: aor; mostly Med., late impf. Ph.1.72 codd.: fut. aor. pf. Pass. :—take away first for oneself, Pl.Ly.206e; remove, Plb.16.29.1

προαισθάνομαι.definition: aor. Th.3.38: pf. ib.112:— perceive or observe beforehand, Id.3.38, 5.58, X.An.1.1.7, etc.; become aware of . . beforehand, Th.3.102

προαισυμνάω.definition: or to be chairman of a board of , IPE12.352.57 , SIG1011.10 :—Pass., of acts done by such a chairman, ib.12

προακμάζω.definition: ripen before the time, be premature, Hsch; to be at the age just before one's prime, Hp.Coac.625

προακολουθέω.definition: precede, Ascl.in Metaph.371.26: perh. f.l. for Olymp.in Mete.21.16

προακονάω.definition: sharpen before or in front, Hsch. s.v

προακοντίζομαι.definition: Pass., to be darted like a javelin before, Luc.Tim.3

προακούω.definition: hear beforehand, Hdt.2.5, 5.86, etc.; Plb.10.5.5; D.22.35; . . Hdt.8.79; how matters stood, Id.6.16; of a horse, X.Cyr.4.3.21

προακροβολίζομαι.definition: skirmish with missiles before the battle, Poll.1.163

προαλγέω.definition: feel pain beforehand, in the loins, Hp.Prorrh.1.21, Arist.HA586b31; Hp.Coac.184; of mental anguish, Ph.2.326

προαλείφω.definition: coat, cover beforehand, Aen.Tact.34.1; Med., smear on to oneself beforehand, Hermes Trism. in Cat.Cod.Astr.8.156

προαλίσκομαι.definition: Pass., to be taken or captured; to be convicted beforehand, D.22.7

προάλλομαι.definition: spring forward, Q.S.4.510: aor. I part. Anon. ap. Suid

προαμαρτάνω.definition: fail or sin before, 2 Ep.Cor.12.21, 13.2: pf. part. Pass., OGI751.10 , J.BJ1.24.4, Hdn.3.14.4

προαμείβομαι.definition: Med., pass to another place, Hsch; c. acc. rei, receive in advance, Pl.Lg.921e

προαμύνομαι.definition: Med., take retaliatory measures; c. acc., take such measures against, not for his acts only, but for his intention also, Id.6.38

προαναβαίνω.definition: ascend before, preoccupy, Th.3.112; Polyaen.6.8; f.l. for in Gal.6.434

προαναβάλλομαι.definition: Med., say or sing by way of prelude, Ar.Pax1267, Isoc.12.39

προαναγιγνώσκω.definition: read aloud, D.C.38.2; esp. of a; read previously or beforehand, J.Vit.44, Plu.2.36e, Gal.15.745

προαναγράφω.definition: register or record beforehand, App.BC5.145: —Med., ib.1.6:—Pass., POxy.504.17 ; to be written beforehand, J.AJ1.3.4

προανάγω.definition: lead up before, J.BJ1.2.4:— Pass., put to sea before, Th.8.11, Polyaen.4.2.22, etc

προαναθερμαίνω.definition: heat up beforehand, Herod.Med. in Rh.Mus.58.109

προαναιρέω.definition: take away before; Med., catch first, Poll.9.104

προαναισιμόω.definition: use up, spend before, in times past before I was born, Hdt.2.11

προαναισχυντέω.definition: to be shameless on behalf of, Hyp.Dem.Fr.3

προανακαθαίρω.definition: clear away first, Procl.in Alc.p.251 C.:so in Med., . . Anon.in Tht.2.10

προανάκειμαι.definition: Pass., to be dedicated before, Gauthier et Sottas Décret trilingue en l'honneur de Ptolémée IVp.66 , OGI129 , J.AJ12.2.9

προανακεφαλαίωσις.definition: anticipatory summary, Sch.Il.15.56, Eust.1672.35, Sch.Ptol. Tetr.86

προανακινέω.definition: stir up before, Plu.Cat.Ma.26; without any prelude , Arist.Rh.1416a2

προανακοινόομαι.definition: Med., unite before, of rivers, Paus.8.35.1

προανακρούομαι.definition: Med., push back before, forestall; in Music, play as a prelude, Plu.2.161c; introduce by way of prelude, ib.996b; of masters, play by way of example, ib.790e:—Pass., . . Philostr.Jun.Im.Praef

προαναλαμβάνω.definition: lift up first, cj. in Sor.2.38; take up a narrative at an earlier point, D.S.17.5

προαναλέγω.definition: mention before, Mitteis Chr.31V25, IXI (ii; collect, gather before, Sammelb.4425 iii 10 :—also in Med., Gp.10.22.1

προαναλίσκω.definition: fut. Th.1.141: aor. also IG22.834.3:—use up or spend before, Th. l.c.; D.41.11; Lys.19.57; D.C.59.18; i.e. Plu.2.517a:—Pass., throw away one's life first, Th.7.81; of water, to be used up before, Hp.Vict.2.42, Arist.M…

προαναξηραίνω.definition: dry up before, Gal.12.318, al.:—Pass., pf. part. Id.6.266

προαναπαύω.definition: prescribe a previous rest, Id.12.683; Med., die before, Rev. Bibl.41.96

προαναπειράομαι.definition: carry out trial naval manoeuvres, cj.for in Poll.1.123

προαναπηδάω.definition: leap up before, of flames, Cass.Pr.1

προαναπλάσσω.definition: transform before, Hipparch. ap. Stob.4.44.81; imagine beforehand, Posidon.Stoic.3.131

προαναπνέω.definition: exhale before, Plu.2.949c: abs., take breath beforehand, Sch.Pi.N.8.32

προαναρπάζω.definition: carry off or arrest beforehand, D.21.125; of an enemy, i.e. Plu.Pomp.76

προαναρρήγνυμι.definition: cause to burst open before, Eust.1524.42

προανασείω.definition: brandish before or in front; agitate beforehand, Id.CG4

προανασκευάζομαι.definition: pack up and carry off beforehand, J.BJ.1.15.6: plpf. Pass. in med.sense, . . ib.1.13.9

προανασκοπέομαι.definition: look at beforehand, Id.AJ17.6.3, prob. in 17.5.6

προαναστέλλω.definition: check beforehand; in Surgery, draw back or open out first, in Pass., Sor.Fract.2

προανατείνω.definition: hold up in front, J.BJ6.1.6, cf. Paul.Aeg.6.33

προανατέλλω.definition: rise before, of stars, Hipparch.1.5.16; sprout afresh, LXXEz.17.9

προανατέμνω.definition: open up, clear first; dissect first, Gal.2.300 , 504

προανατολή.definition: earlier rising , Gem.16.16 ; of a star, rising above the Eastern horizon just before sunset, Ptol.Alm.8.4

προανατρέχω.definition: run up in front, prob. for in Sor.2.64 and Paul.Aeg.6.74

προανατρίβω.definition: use friction, rub first, Gal.12.420, Herod.Med. ap. Orib.10.18.15, Ps.-Dsc.2.115

προαναφέρω.definition: bring up or mention before, v.l. in; Pass., rush up before, Arist.Pr.897a28

προαναφθέγγομαι.definition: say by way of preface, Ph.1.680

προαναφυσάω.definition: play a prelude on the flute, v

προαναφωνέω.definition: pronounce before, S.E.M.1.130; proclaim before, predict, Sch.Il.5.662; announce beforehand, Ps.-Plu.Vit.Hom.163

προαναφώνησις.definition: previous proclamation; statement by anticipation, Ps.-Plu.Vit.Hom.65, TryphoTrop.2.12, Hdn.Fig.p.103S

προαναχαλάω.definition: relax, loosen before, Antyll. ap. Orib.10.31.3, prob. for in Sor.2.61

προαναχωρέω.definition: go away before, D.C.49.7: c. gen; proceed beyond, Sor.1.7, prob. for in Id.2.64

προανεγείρω.definition: arouse, awaken beforehand, Procl.in Prm.p.606S., cf. Syrian.in Metaph.149.12

προάνθησις.definition: previous or first bloom, Sch.Ar.Pax198, Hsch. s.v

προανίημι.definition: relax first, Sor.1.65; dissolve first, Asclep. ap. Gal.13.529

προανίστημι.definition: set up before, J.BJ3.7.10: aor.1 Med., ib.5.3.2:—Pass. with aor.2 Act., start up first, Stratt.62; rise from table first, Ach. Tat.5.18; rise before daybreak, Poll.1.71

προανίσχω.definition: = II, c. gen., J.BJ3.3.5: abs., arise before, Plu.2.427e

προανοίγω.definition: open before, Meges ap.Orib.44.24.9: metaph., Plu.2.36d

προανταναιρέομαι.definition: Pass., to be removed, withdrawn previously, PTeb.61.219, 72.147

προανύτω.definition: aor. Sch.Ar.Eq.1053:—get; accomplish before, in Pass., S.E.M.8.1, cf. Gal.15.101, Iamb.Myst.3.18

προαπαγορεύω.definition: fut. Ael.NA14.11; renounce beforehand, J.AJ15.7.10; D.C.1.c.:—Med., Paus.4.5.8

προαπαλλάσσω.definition: Att. remove beforehand, Id.44.10; Id.37.13; loses its energy, Marcellin.Puls.257:—Pass., depart or die beforehand, D.C.43.11: also intr. in Act., D.S.18.15; having predeceased, Phld.Acad.Ind.p.83 M

προαπαντάω.definition: go forth to meet, Th.1.69, 4.92, 6.42; go to meet before . . , Them.Or.14.183b

προαπάντησις.definition: meeting before, a Rhet. figure; interposition, Gal.UP8.3

προαπειλέω.definition: threaten beforehand, PCair.Zen.230.3 , J.BJ4.6.1, Onos.14.3, App.BC2.108

προαπέρχομαι.definition: die before, Lib.Or.55.10, Him.Or.23.8; Eun.VSp.494 B; die for, Lib.Eth.22.5

προαπιστέομαι.definition: to be disbelieved beforehand, f.l. in Sch.E.Andr.297

προαποβρέχω.definition: soak, steep before, in Pass., Gal.6.611, Herod.Med. ap. Orib.10.10.3: 2 aor. part. Gp.14.9.5

προαπογιγνώσκω.definition: despair beforehand, of a thing, Gal.8.772: c. acc., Id.18.39

προαπογράφομαι.definition: describe before, Ptol.Geog.2.1.6; register beforehand, POxy.249.7

προαποδείκνυμι.definition: prove or demonstrate before, in; Pass., to be appointed before, of magistrates, D.C.52.42, 59.9, al

προαποδίδωμι.definition: pay in advance, PTeb.296.13; give an account of first, S.E.M.7.46:—Pass., A.D.Adv.195.17

προαποδότης.definition: one who renders payment first, i.e.surety, SIG2845 , JHS13.343

προαποζέω.definition: boil down beforehand, Gal.15.872:—Pass., Id.6.623, Philagr. ap. Orib.5.17.7: also Alex.Trall.8.1

προαποθεραπεύω.definition: treat first, Herod.Med. in Rh.Mus.58.87:—Pass., Sor.1.40

προαποθνήσκω.definition: die before or first, Hdt.2.1; die on behalf or in defence of, Pl.Smp.208d; Arist.EE1235a34; Ph.2.200

προαποκαθίσταμαι.definition: Pass., cease and be cured before, Hp.Coac.204

προαποκάμνω.definition: grow tired before the end, give up the task, Pl.Euthphr.11e: c.gen., Plu.Mar.36

προαπόκειμαι.definition: Pass., to be stored up before, Sammelb.4425 iv 8 , prob. in Aristid.Or.50.49

προαποκλείω.definition: shut beforehand, App.BC4.77; shut out, exclude beforehand, Them.Or.7.92c

προαποκληρόομαι.definition: Pass., to be allotted beforehand, Luc.Bis Acc.14

προαποκλύζω.definition: wash or cleanse beforehand, Gal.12.179 , 264 , Paul.Aeg.3.42

προαποκρίνομαι.definition: answer first, App.BC4.69:— Pass; Pass., to be excreted first, Sor.1.58

προαποκτείνω.definition: kill beforehand, J.AJ20.2.2, Luc.Cat.8, D.C.54.9, etc.; proves fatal earlier, Gal.9.820

προαπολείπω.definition: leave beforehand; intr., fail before or first, Hp.Mul.1.59: c.gen., fail before, i.e. in comparison with, . . Antipho5.93; Plu.2.789d:—Med., ib.1078f

προαπόλλυμι.definition: aor. destroy first; more freq. in Pass., with pf. to be first destroyed, perish before or first, Antipho5.67, Th.5.61, 6.77; Pl.Phd.91d; D.4.37: c. gen., Lys.2.24

προαπομισθόω.definition: let out for hire before, Nic.Dam.130.26a J

προαποξύω.definition: scrape off beforehand, Gal.2.351:— Pass., ib.686, Dsc.Eup.1.166

προαποπαύω.definition: put a stop to first, Orib.9.52.1:—Med., stop before, c.gen., Id.inc.4.53

προαποπέμπω.definition: send away, dismiss before, D.C.60.34:—Med., X.Cyr.4.2.29:—Pass., Th.3.25

προαποπνίγομαι.definition: to be choked, drowned first, Aesop.144

προαπόπτωτος.definition: having fallen off before its time, Thphr.HP3.3.8

προαπορέω.definition: start preliminary doubts and difficulties, Arist.Metaph.995b2, APo.99b19:—Pass., opp. Id.Ph.208a35: aor. in med. sense, Pl.Ti.49b

προαπορρύπτω.definition: wash clean first, Philagr. ap. Orib.5.21.3:—Pass., Antyll.ib.10.24.8

προαποσβέννυμαι.definition: Pass., fut. M.Ant.12.15:—to be extinguished or go out first, Id.3.1; die first, D.C.55.10A.9

προαποσμήχω.definition: smear beforehand; wash off first, Menemach. ap. Orib.10.14.3

προαποστέλλω.definition: send away, dispatch beforehand or in advance, Th.4.77, J.BJ1.17.2, Plu.Arat.6:—Pass., to be sent in advance, Th.3.112: aor. part. PEleph.28.6 , Plb.3.45.1: plpf. App.BC4.20: also c. gen., = Th.3.5

προαποτέλεσμα.definition: previous influence of a star, Procl.Par.Ptol.114:—hence of or concerned therewith, ib.10, 109

προαποτίθημι.definition: put aside from before; Med., excrete previously, Gal.6.89, etc

προαποτρέπομαι.definition: turn aside before, leave off, c. part., X.An.6.5.31; turn aside to attack, D.C.47.36

προαποφαίνω.definition: declare or explain before, Plu.2.1146c; App.BC2.127:—Med., declare one's opinion before, Pl.Prt.340b, cf. App.Mac.9.1.: abs., Pl.Hp.Ma.288d; express an opinion off-hand, Plu.Mar.29:—Pass., PLips.38.11

προαποχράομαι.definition: use fully before, Sch.E.Hipp.58; kill before, D.C.57.15, Fr.36.8

προαρπάζω.definition: snatch away before, Luc.Tim.54: metaph., J.AJ13.5.8; ib.20.8.2, cf. Luc.Tox.6, etc.; snap at a conclusion, anticipate hastily, Pl.Grg.454c; S.E.M.1.157

προαρχιερατεύω.definition: hold the office of previously, Supp.Epigr. 4.318

προάρχω.definition: begin first, J.AJ18.9.6; hold office before, D.C.57.14; Id.76.5; IG7.303.38

προασιτέω.definition: go without food before, Antyll. ap. Orib.7.16.2, Gal.14.663, Orib.Fr.80

προασκέω.definition: train or exercise before, Isoc.4.75: c. gen., i.e. Arist.Metaph.993b14, cf. J.BJ4.2.1

προασπίζω.definition: hold a shield before, Aristid.Or.26.84; Philostr.Her.3.4, Hdn.6.2.5; Them.Or.16.200b; Ph.2.200: c. acc., cover with a shield, D.H.6.93:-Pass., to be covered with shields, by them, Hld.9.14. II. put forward as a shield…

προασπιστήρ.definition: one who holds a shield before, champion, Nonn.D.20.50

προάστιον.definition: house or estate in the suburbs, Philostr.VA1.7, VS2.1.11

προάστιος.definition: suburban, S.Fr.721. , etc., and is freq. in codd., but is proved wrong by the metre in Pi., S., E., AP ll.cc., cf. St.Byz. s.v. also by IG, SIG Il.cc.)

προαστίς.definition: Boeot. resident in a suburb, Schwyzer 462A7

προασφαλίζομαι.definition: Med., secure before, Eust.52.30:—Pass., to be so secured, Aret.CA2.3; J.BJ1.3.3, 6.1.4; in hope, Id.AJ17.5.5

προαύλημα.definition: prelude on the flute, Hsch. , Phot

προαυλίζομαι.definition: encamp before a place, c. gen., App.Hisp.25

προαύλιον.definition: prelude on the flute; place before a court, vestibule, Poll.1.77, Suid

προαυξής.definition: well-grown, Hp.Art.62; pertaining to elderly persons, Id. ap. Gal.19.132

προαφαιρέω.definition: take away before, Thphr.HP7.3.4; Gal.11.120, cf. 12.465; anticipate the appointed time, App.BC2.26:—Med., D.S.5.29, cf. App.Mith.90

προαφέψω.definition: boil down before, Gal.6.290, 667:—Pass., Thphr.HP7.12.2, Dsc.1.107, Antyll. ap. Orib.9.24.8

προαφηγέομαι.definition: Ion. relate before, Hdt.3.138, cf. PMasp.89.24

προαφίημι.definition: release first, let some blood before, Hp.Vid.Ac.3; dismiss first, D.C.37.50

προαφίσταμαι.definition: Pass., with pf. and aor. 2 Act., secede; leave off or desist before, Pl.Smp.175d, etc.; . . Id.Phd.85c; . . Alex.30.2

προβασανίζω.definition: examine or test before, HeroAut.2.5; torture before, Luc.Tyr.17:—Pass., LXX4 Ma.10.16, J.AJ17.5.5; Id.BJ5.11.1

προβασκαίνω.definition: envy before or because of, prob. for in Lib.Decl.29.2

προβασκάνιον.definition: safeguard against witchcraft, amulet or scarecrow hung up before workshops or in fields. LXXEp.Je.70, Plu.2.681f, Hsch. s.v. = muttonius, Gloss. ; less correct than Phryn.68

προβατεία.definition: keeping of sheep, SIG1165.4; property in cattle, flock of sheep, Str.12.3.13, Ael.NA4.32 , etc

προβάτειος.definition: of a sheep, Arist.HA522a22; = Ps.-Dsc.2.126; but = Id.3.37

προβατεύς.definition: = title of play by Antiphanes, Poll.7.184

προβατεύω.definition: keep cattle, SIG1165 , App.BC1.7; keep at grass, graze, App.BC1.8

προβάτιον.definition: Dim. of little sheep, Ar.V.955, Pl.293, Pl.Phdr.259a, Strato Com.1.22, Sotad.9.3, Plu.Fab.1, Philostr.VA3.43; Men.319.3; Ar.Pl.922; Procop.Arc.13; of a kid, Ar.Av.856

προβατογνώμων.definition: gen. good judge of cattle: metaph., good judge of character, A.Ag.795

προβατοδόρας.definition: sheep-flayer, name of the month Procl. ad Hes.Op.502

προβατοκάπηλος.definition: sheep-dealer, retailer of sheep, Plu.Per.24, Com.Adesp.62

προβατοκόμος.definition: one who tends sheep, Anon.inRh.3.607 W

προβατοκτηνοτρόφος.definition: keeping sheep and cattle, OGI655.5 , PHamb.34.6 , etc

προβατοτροφία.definition: Ion. keeping of sheep, prob. in Supp.Epigr.2.579.8

προβατοχίτων.definition: with coat of sheep's skin, Hsch. s.v

προβατών.definition: = IG11.287 A 149, al. , PCair.Zen.68.2 , Inscr.Délos 403.51 , Hdn.Gr.1.36

προβιβρώσκω.definition: eat first, Aret.SA2.2:— Pass., Dsc.3.45, cf. 1.125

προβιοτή.definition: previous existence, Plu.Fr.7.9, Porph.Gaur.11.4, Id. ap. Stob.2.8.42, Hierocl.Prov.p.172 B., al., Herm.in Phdr.p.109A

προβιόω.definition: live before, mostly pf.part. Pass., one's previous life, Plb.11.2.9, J.AJ4.8.15, Plu.2.561a, Hdn.2.1.8, Plot.3.4.5, cf.Plu.2.10b; also pf.Act. in intr. sense, IG12.655.10

προβίωτος.definition: having had a prior existence, Sophon.in de An.135.1

προβλαστάνω.definition: shoot or sprout before, Thphr.CP5.1.12, Ph.1.602; Thphr.CP1.13.12; shoot before the season, Plu.2.377c

προβλέπω.definition: foresee, LXXPs.36.13; provide against, D.H.11.20; Heraclit.Incred.11; Him.Or.31.1; provide, IG12.561 :—Med., Ep.Hebr.11.40

προβλής.definition: thrown forward, jutting out, Il.2.396; 16.407; 12.259; Od.5.405, cf. 10.89, 13.97, Archil.49 Diehl; without subst., forelands, headlands, S.Ph.936; Q.S.10.175: sg., Opp.H.5.252; AP5.293.3 , 7.147 ; Nonn.D.15.8; ib.28.…

προβόλαιος.definition: held out before one, levelled, in rest, Theoc.24.125; alone, = II, Orac. ap. Hdt.7.148

προβόλιον.definition: Dim. of sq. II, boar-spear, X.Cyn.10.1

πρόβολος.definition: anything that projects; jutting rock, foreland, Od.12.251: metaph., boulder in the path, obstacle, interpol.in D.8.61; Id.25.84 ; Plu.2.510a

προβοσκίς.definition: means of providing food; elephant's trunk, Arist.PA659a15, Phylarch.36J., Plb.3.46.12, Agatharch.71, Str.15.1.43

προβουλεία.definition: office of Papers of Amer. Sch.at Athens 3 No.428

προβούλευμα.definition: preliminary decree of the; = Lat. senatus consultum, D.H.6.67, 7.38

προβουλεύω.definition: Aeol. , contrive or; of the at Athens and elsewh., frame or pass a X.HG1.7.7; D.19.34; Id.21.162; IG12.66.17, 110.37; of a board of Th.8.1, Arist.Pol.1298b30; of the Spartan Plu.Agis11; = Lat. senatusconsultum, Plb.6.…

προβρέχω.definition: soak beforehand, Arist.Pr.931a14, Thphr.HP3.17.2:— Pass., Hp.Steril.224: aor. part. Dsc.3.6, Eup.2.31

προγάμιος.definition: = foreg., Ael.NA9.66; sacrifice before marriage, Poll.3.38

προγανόω.definition: cheer or comfort beforehand, Ph.1.104, dub. cj. in 2.416

προγαστρίδιος.definition: worn in front of the belly; Subst. false paunch worn by actors, Luc.Salt.27, JTr.41

προγάστωρ.definition: pot-bellied, Gerhard Phoinix p.6, Str.4.4.6, App.Anth.5.11, Luc.Nec.11, Gal.10.145, Adam.2.31; of a pot-bellied bottle, Antiph.224.6: Comp. Hp.Aër.24

προγεύσιμον.definition: food taken before a meal, PKlein.Form.261.5

προγεύστης.definition: one who tastes before, Plu.2.990a, Ath.4.171b: fem. Ph.1.170, cf. 603

προγεύω.definition: give a foretaste of, c. gen., Aristid. Quint.3.27:—Med., taste before, Anaxil.10 , Arist.PA690b27, Plu.2.49e; Ph.1.603

προγεωργέω.definition: cultivate earlier or already, BGU462.18 , POxy.101.8 , etc

προγηράσκω.definition: grow old before; grow prematurely old, Id.Rh.Pr.10, Sor.1.87; Ph.2.287

προγιγνώσκω.definition: Ion. and later fut; prognosticate, Arist.HA627b10

προγλωσσεύομαι.definition: to be hasty of tongue, Hsch. s.v

πρόγνωσις.definition: foreknowledge, LXXJu.9.6; perceiving beforehand, Plu.2.399d, 982c, Luc.Alex.8, etc

προγνώστης.definition: skilled in prognosis, of physicians, Cat.Cod.Astr.8.176

πρόγονος.definition: forefather, ancestor, Pi.O.6.59; E.Ion267, cf. Hel.15, Pl.Euthphr.11b: freq. in pl., Pi.P.9.105, A.Pers.405, Hdt.7.150, etc.; Pl.Mx.236e; Id.Ep.359d; Id.Tht.173d; also of gods or heroes who are the authors or founders…

προγράφω.definition: write before or first; write as a copy, Poll.4.18

προγρηγορέω.definition: remain awake first, in aor. part. Gal.11.311

προγυμνάζω.definition: exercise, train beforehand, S.Fr.498; Luc.Herm.78, cf. Porph.VP47: esp. train in oratory, Arr.Epict.1.26.13, etc.:—Med., study, practise oneself, Gal.Anim.Pass.2.3; but also, act as 2, Id.6.177:—Pass., of arguments or…

προγυμνασία.definition: previous exercise, Ph.2.90, cf. Iamb. ap. Stob.2.2.6

προγύμνασμα.definition: preparatory exercise, for war, Ath.14.631a; also in Rhetoric, Arist.Rh.Al.1436a25: in pl., title of works by Aphthonius, etc

προγυμναστής.definition: trainer, Arr.Epict.3.20.9,4.4.31; slave who goes through exercises with his master, Seneca Ep.83.3, Gal.6.187

προδανείζω.definition: lend before or first, D.C.51.17; advance money for public objects, OGI46.5 , cf. IG7.4254.38 , etc.; Arist.Ath.16.2:—Med., Hyp.Dem.Fr.4

προδανεισμός.definition: advance of funds for public purposes, CIG 2717b ; Milet.3 No.138.31

προδανειστής.definition: one who advances money for public purposes, OGI46.9 , IG11.287 A 122

προδαπανάω.definition: exhaust beforehand; defray the expense of beforehand, Sammelb.5232.17

προδείδω.definition: only aor.1 part. fear prematurely, S.OT90

προδείκνυμι.definition: foreshow what is about to happen, Hdt.1.209; Id.7.37, cf. 6.27; . . Thphr.CP1.13.10: c. acc. et inf., make known beforehand that . . , Th.3.47; . . Plu.Phoc.28; it having been already shown, A.DSynt.336.16

πρόδηλος.definition: clear or manifest in front or; = c. gen., Vett. Val.92.22,al

προδήλωσις.definition: declaring beforehand, prognostication, Plu.2.398d; giving notice in advance, Id.Mar.19

προδιαβαίνω.definition: cross before others, X.Eq.8.3, Plu.2.968e: abs., D.S.18.35, Plu.Pyrrh.24, D.C.41.47

προδιαβάλλω.definition: raise prejudices against beforehand, Th.6.75, Hyp.Lyc.10; Aps.p.261 H.; accuse beforehand, Luc.Tox.34:—Pass., Arist.Rh.1400a22, cf. 1418b14; also, to be prejudiced, Plu.2.37b

προδιαγιγνώσκω.definition: perceive or understand beforehand; determine beforehand, Id.5.38, J.AJ8.12.3; not to prejudge anything, D.C.52.31; J.AJ17.5.3

προδιάγνωσις.definition: previous recognition of the imminence of disease, Hp.Vict.1.2,3.69

προδιαζεύγνυμι.definition: Gramm., , a figure used by Alcman, when a predicate or attribute belonging to two words is joined to the first, as Sch.Od.10.513

προδιάζω.definition: of a banker, pay or advance money, POxy.180

προδιαθερμαίνω.definition: warm through before, in Pass., Gal.7.187

προδιάθεσις.definition: predisposition, Phld.Mus.p.63 K. , Anon.Lond.24.33, S.E.P.1.100 ; previous state, Dsc.Alex.Praef

προδιαιρέω.definition: divide beforehand, Orib.Fr.22; Med., warn, . . PCair.Zen.230.7

προδιαιτάω.definition: prepare by diet, Ath.Med. ap; Med., submit a case to arbitration first, SIG364.87

προδιακαθαίρω.definition: clear up a matter previously, Sor.1.44

προδιακαίω.definition: burn completely before, Heras ap.Gal.13.423 , Crito ap. eund.13.37

προδιάκειμαι.definition: Pass., to be in a certain condition or state before, Arr.Epict.3.21.14

προδιακεντέω.definition: make a hole in a radish first, Orib.Fr.81 , Aët.3.120

προδιακινέω.definition: set in motion before, J.AJ15.5.2; Gal.18.441

προδιακλύζομαι.definition: Med., wash out one's mouth first, Aët.13.23

προδιαλαμβάνω.definition: occupy before, J.BJ4.2.3; judge and decide beforehand, Plb.9.31.2,27.6.3; . . Id.11.1.3: c. inf., Id.5.29.4: abs., Id.2.2.10:— Pass., let it be assumed beforehand, Hipparch.2.1. 15

προδιαλέγω.definition: discuss before, Nicom.Ar.1.3; Med., with aor. Pass., speak, converse beforehand, Isoc.12.6; with . . , PSI4.360.15 , D.H.3.71; Plu.Pyrrh.22: abs., Isoc.12.199, cf. D.S.20.7

προδιαλογισμός.definition: previous casting up of accounts, PTeb.89.2, al

προδιαλύω.definition: dissolve or break up before; relax previously, Gal.18.462

προδιαμαρτύρομαι.definition: call to witness or invoke beforehand, Plb.24.10.6

προδιαναπαύω.definition: take an interval of rest beforehand, Diocl.Fr.141

προδιανοέομαι.definition: think over before, premeditate, Charond. ap. Stob.4.2.24; without premeditation, Arist.MM1188b30; Plu.2.942a

προδιαντλέομαι.definition: Pass., to be exhausted beforehand, dub.l. in Ath.5.185a

προδιαπέμπομαι.definition: Med., send on as a messenger, Plb.8.18.3; send a message in advance, Id.16.27.1: abs., Id.21.4.7

προδιαπονέομαι.definition: Pass., to be well trained before, of dogs, Poll.5.51

προδιαπορέομαι.definition: Pass., to be questioned or discussed before, A.D.Synt.229.11

προδιαρθρόω.definition: enucleate beforehand, Ph.Bybl. ap. Eus.PE1.9, S.E.M.1.96, 11.18

προδιαριθμέομαι.definition: Pass., to be enumerated before, Apollon.Cit.1

προδιασαφέω.definition: explain beforehand, A.D.Synt.97.9:—Pass., to be published or made plain beforehand, J.BJ7.5.3, Gal. 13.698; the aforesaid . . , CumontFouilles de Doura- Europos298, cf. SIG685.56

προδιασκέπτομαι.definition: examine well beforehand, ib.148: aor. inf. Id.Protr.9: pf. Id.7.418

προδιασκευή.definition: revision or interpolation further back, Sch.Il.24.109

προδιαστέλλω.definition: open out first, Sor.1.69; distinguish before, Tz. in An.Ox.3.317:—Med., forecast, Hp.Decent.11; give an explanation before, premise, J.AJ4.8.4, Dsc.Eup.1 Praef., etc.; make a previous agreement with, Ath.12.521a; send…

προδιασύρω.definition: pull to pieces, ridicule beforehand, Arist.Rh.1418b9, Rh.Al.1433b9

προδιατάσσομαι.definition: Med., arrange beforehand, prob.l. in Aen.Tact.16.16

προδιατίθημι.definition: arrange beforehand; predispose, esp. favourably, J.AJ12.4.3; Men.Rh.p.443 S.; but also of those who create prejudice, Suid.s.v

προδιατρίβω.definition: spend time on or study first, Phld.Rh.1.223 S

προδιατυπόω.definition: express by a type beforehand, prefigure; Pass., to be sketched in outline first, Ptol.Tetr.16, Olymp.in Mete.184.10

προδιαφθείρω.definition: ruin, destroy beforehand; corrupt, demoralize beforehand, prob. for in D.21.18; Plb.5.4.11:—Pass., Isoc.Ep.2.8

προδιαχωρέω.definition: to have a previous separation or difference with another, Arist.Rh.1373a19

προδιδάσκω.definition: teach beforehand, S.Aj.163 , Ar.Nu.476; Pl.Euthd.302c, Grg.489d, Hp.Ma.291b: c. acc. et inf., S.Ph.1015, cf. D.51.12; Plu.2.973b:—Med., S.Tr.681, Ar.Pl.687:—Pass., learn beforehand, Th.2.40

προδίδωμι.definition: give beforehand, pay in advance, X.HG1.5.7; forsake, abandon, Thgn.813; Ar.Pax408; . . Id.Th.229; Antipho1.5; Pl.Lg.762c; Id.Cri.45c:—Pass., Hdt.9.60, cf. Vett.Val.78.19

προδιεξέρχομαι.definition: go out through before, X.Cyn.5.4; of; go through, explain before, Aeschin.1.8

προδιεργάζομαι.definition: prepare beforehand, in Pass., . . Arist.EN1179b24, cf.Pr.931a12, Parth.23.2

προδιερευνάω.definition: fut. X.Cyr.5.4.4:—go scouting, l.c.: c.acc., search thoroughly, D.S.20.26

προδιέρχομαι.definition: go through before, of motions of the; go through or narrate before, Aeschin.2.67; D.S.1.9; J.AJ4.2.1; D.S.3.11; . . J.AJ12.3.3

προδιευκρινέω.definition: make clear beforehand, Hermog.Id.1.4:—Pass., Plb.6.11.1, S.E.P.2.68 , prob.in Herm.in Phdr.p.63A

προδιηγέομαι.definition: relate beforehand, premise, Hdt.4.145, D.59.1, Hermog.Inv.2.4:—Pass., Hp.Aër.13

προδιήγησις.definition: preliminary exposition or narration, Aeschin.1.117, cf. Arist.Rh.1414b14, Hermog.Inv.2.1, al.: pl., Aps.p.339H

προδιηθέω.definition: in Pass., filter through before, cj. for in Arist.Pr.933b37

προδιίστημι.definition: dilate previously, Antyll. ap; Pass., fall into discord beforehand, J.BJ4.3.2

προδικάζω.definition: judge beforehand, Ph.1.603:—Med., Poll.8.24:— Pass., IG5.343.15

προδικασία.definition: preliminary proceedings in a prosecution for murder, Antipho6.42 , cf.AB186

προδικαστής.definition: one who judges before or for; advocate, SIG134b25, 32

προδικέω.definition: to be a patron, advocate, or; act as advocate, . . GDI1432b5

προδικία.definition: priority of trial, SIG155a8 (Delph., iv; office of advocacy, Plu.2.793e

πρόδικος.definition: judged first, a cause; Act.,judging in first instance, Schwyzer 328aiiB 8 , cf. GDI5040.63

προδιοικέω.definition: regulate, manage beforehand, D.23.14; digest before, Antyll. ap. Orib.5.29.10

προδιοίκησις.definition: setting in due order beforehand, D.H.Rh.10.13: pl., Vett.Val.inCat.Cod.Astr.8.165, Sch.Hermog. in Rh.6.124 W

προδιομολογέομαι.definition: agree in allowing beforehand, Pl.Ti.78a, Arist.Top.108b15; c. inf., D.C.38.14; . . Id.62.21:—Pass., points conceded on both sides beforehand, v.l. for in Pl.Sph.241a; Arist.EN1103b34; Ph.1.431

προδιορθόομαι.definition: Med., correct, set right by anticipation, Herm.in Phdr.p.109A

προδιόρθωσις.definition: setting right by anticipation, Hermog.Inv.4.12, Alex.Fig.3, Aristid.Quint.2.10, Eust.733.6

προδιορίζω.definition: limit or define beforehand, D.S.12.2, Alex.Aphr.in Top.146.17, al.; D.S.1.4:—Med., ib.5, Ph.1.442, Hermog.Id.1.1, Aps.p.247H. :—Pass., Ph.1.631

προδιορισμός.definition: previous definition or distinction, Gal.6.830, Aps.p.243H

προδιώκω.definition: get in advance in pursuit, Th.6.70, f.l. in X.An.3.3.10

προδοκέω.definition: seem good, be resolved beforehand, IG7.3563 :—mostly in Pass., had been before determined, Th.7.18; Id.3.40; this was my former opinion, Pl.Phd.88d

πρόδομα.definition: that which is given in advance, prepayment, advance of money, PCair.Zen.269 , Plb.29.8.8, 15.25.16 , JHS11.122 , PTeb.42.15 , Hdn.Gr.2.935, Hsch. s.v

προδομεύς.definition: one who builds before, epith. of certain gods, Paus.1.42.1

προδοξάζω.definition: deem, judge beforehand, Pl.Tht.178e, Arist.Metaph.1011b6:—Pass., Id.Rh.1356a10

πρόδοξος.definition: judging hastily, Phryn.PSp.8B., Phot.p.140R., Suid. s.v

προδοσία.definition: Ion. abandonment in need, betrayal, E.Hel.1633: mostly in Prose, treason, Hdt.6.88,8.128; Id.6.100; D.24.127, cf. Pl.R.443a

πρόδοτος.definition: betrayed, abandoned, Trag. in lyr., S.El.126,208, 1074; E.Hipp.595

πρόδουλος.definition: serving as a slave, of a shoe, A.Ag.945

προδρομεύω.definition: to be a mounted skirmisher, Arist.Ath.49.1

πρόδρομος.definition: running forward with headlong speed; running before, going in advance, Hdt.9.14; Id.1.60; E.IA424; freq. of horsemen in advance of an army, Hdt.4.121, 122; Id.7.203, cf. Th.2.22; A.Th.80 ; mounted skirmishers, 'guides…

προδύνω.definition: = sq., Gem.9.1: abs., set earlier, prob. in Ptol.Tetr.147

προδυστυχέω.definition: to be unfortunate before, Isoc.4.141, 6.104, D.C.48.42

προδυσωπέω.definition: cause to be given up for very shame, J.BJ2.14.7

προδωσείω.definition: Desiderat. of wish to betray, Dam.Isid.173

προεγγράφομαι.definition: Pass., to be inscribed beforehand, D.C.39.17

προεγγυάομαι.definition: furnish security or guarantee, Milet.3 No.138.42 :—Pass., App.Fr.1.1

προεγγυεύω.definition: only in Dor. form pf. inf. = foreg., Tab.Heracl.1.155

προέγγυος.definition: Dor. surety, Tab.Heracl.1.100, al., Schwyzer394 , Milet.3 No. 138.39

προεγείρω.definition: wake up before, Arist.EN1150b23; intr., continue awake, Id.Pr.916b2 codd

προεγκάθημαι.definition: Pass., to be implanted before, Plb.3.15.9

προεγκαλέω.definition: accuse before: name of a play by Menander, Stob.4.19.17

προέγκειμαι.definition: Pass., to be laid or lie in before, Hdn.1.17.10; to be interred previously, IGRom.4.1284.31

προεγκλύζω.definition: use a clyster first, prob. in Dsc.Eup.1.231

προεγχαράσσω.definition: engrave before, Ph.2.229; scarify first, Aret.CD2.13

προεγχειρέω.definition: attempt before the time, Plb.2.68.2; test a matter beforehand, Arist.Top.160b15:—Pass., S.E.M.1.35

προεγχειρίζομαι.definition: in Pass., to be taken in hand already, Heph.Astr.3.4

προεγχρίω.definition: rub in or on before, Dsc.Eup.2.19 , cj. for in Gal.13.820

προεγχυματίζω.definition: make an infusion first, Hippiatr.129; Subst. ibid

προεδρία.definition: Ion. privilege of the front; in concrete sense, front seat, on a chair of state, Hdt.4.88; Id.6.57; Ar.Ach.42: esp., at Athens, seats of the in the Ecclesia, Din.2.13

πρόεδρος.definition: one who sits in the first place; at Athens, in pl., presiding officers of the or Lex ap. D.24.21, Aeschin.2.65, Arist.Ath.44.2; IG22.779.11, 1227.23, al.; SIG158.5 , etc.; similar officers at Mytilene, Th.3.25; App.Ma…

προεθίζω.definition: train beforehand; accustom beforehand, c. dat., Gal.14.256:—Pass., Id.2.223

προειδωλοποιέω.definition: form an idea of beforehand, Hld.9.25

προεισβάλλω.definition: throw in a remark before; intr., start, make a beginning, Longin.22.2

προεισέρχομαι.definition: come or go in before, D.28.14, D.S.16.94; Antyll. ap. Orib.6.10.14

προεισπέμπω.definition: send in before, X.Cyr.5.2.6, J.AJ14.11.6, Luc.Alex.11, etc

προεισπράσσω.definition: in Pass., of a debtor, to have money prematurely exacted from him, PCair.Zen.367.18

προεισφέρω.definition: introduce a law before, in Pass., Poll.5.166, Lib.Decl.39.3:—Med., introduce before , Sch.Ar.Ach.321

προεισφορά.definition: money advanced to pay the for; advance of money to the State, Inscr.Prien.108.51, 56 ; SIG1003.30

προείσφορος.definition: one who contributes to a Inscr.Prien.108.78

προεκβάλλω.definition: throw out, eject before, Arist.HA605a7; Astrol., calculate first, Cat.Cod.Astr.1.167

προεκδιδάσκω.definition: teach thoroughly before, Id.AJ17.6.1 , Them.Or.32.358b, Iamb.VP12.58 codd

προεκδίδωμι.definition: publish beforehand, Plb.16.20.7:—Pass; excreting before, Herod.Med. in Rh.Mus.58.100

προεκδρομή.definition: running out in advance, of troops, Poll.1.164

προεκζέω.definition: boil off before, Ruf. ap. Orib.4.2.19

προέκθεσις.definition: introduction, preface, Plb.3.1.7, 8.11.2; prefatory account, Scymn.13, D.H.Comp.23, Quint. Inst.9.2.106

προεκθρῴσκω.definition: leap out before, Eus.Mynd.34: c. gen., Sch.E.Hec.458

προεκκαθαίρω.definition: cleanse, purify before, J.AJ18.5.2; Sor.1.40, cf. Lysis ap.Iamb.VP17.76, Sch.Luc.Cat.24

προέκκειμαι.definition: lie before, project beyond; Pass. of to be fixed in advance, Cic.Att.6.5.2; to be set forth previously, Demetr.Lac.Herc.1012.33, etc.; PTeb.5.224 ; A.D.Synt.10.24; the above-mentioned . . , Longin.11.1; to be cited ab…

προεκκενόω.definition: drain off beforehand, J.AJ3.1.2, Sch.Il.9.223; evacuate first, Gal.15.721: metaph., exhaust a subject, Sch. Hermog. in Rh.4.490 W

προεκκλύζω.definition: rinse out first, Gal.11.132, Androm. ap. eund.12.631, Apollon.ib.647

προεκκομίζω.definition: carry out beforehand, Hdt.2.63: metaph; Med., remove first, Hippiatr.75

προεκκρίνω.definition: anticipate a crisis, Hp.Hum.13; Pass., carried off first, Dsc.1.47; to be cleared out first, Sor.2.63

προεκκρούω.definition: push or drive out before, Vett. Val.337.12, D.C.43.4

προεκλέγω.definition: collect moneys before or in advance, D.18.234, 50.9; App.BC5.2

προεκλείπω.definition: fail to assist, Hp.Ep.10:—Pass., to be evacuated previously, J.AJ17.10.9

προεκλογίζομαι.definition: calculate before, Ph.2.279, Mithr.Ep.Brut.Praef., Hierocl.in CA12p.447M

προεκλύω.definition: relax before, Ath.2.45e; weaken; release first, Sor.1.111

προεκμανθάνω.definition: learn by heart before, TheonProg.3, Sch.D.T.p.18H

προεκνιτρόω.definition: clean beforehand with Dsc.4.136, 5.1, Cleopatra ap. Gal.12.404:—Pass., Antyll. ap. Orib.7.21.3, etc

προεκπέμπω.definition: send out before, Ph.2.110, J.AJ13.7.3, Plu.Cam.41, Alc.34; Lib.Or.55.33

προεκπηδάω.definition: leap out before, Thphr.CP1.19.1,4.6.7; D.S.12.64: metaph., Them.Or.19.232d

προεκπίπτω.definition: fall or come out before, precede; go beyond limits, Str.1.2.3; Longin.15.8 , cf.38.1

προεκπλήσσω.definition: scare or astound before, J.AJ18.9.7, Onos.29.2, Plu.Lys.25, Luc.Ind.9, etc.:—Pass., Id.Alex.16

προεκρήγνυμαι.definition: Pass., break out suddenly or prematurely, Hp.Epid.1.4; also of diseases, Id.Hum.13, Gal.9.916

προεκτελέω.definition: bring quite to an end before, Ael.VH13.1

προεκτίθημι.definition: put out or publish before; build out, as a salient or projection, Ph.Bel.84.6

προεκτίκτω.definition: lay before, prob. in Id.HA549a17: abs., ib.b11

προεκτίνω.definition: pay before, Them.Or.16.199c , Chor. in Lib.4.85 R

προεκτρέχω.definition: aor. run out before, Ph.1.166; shoot out before the season, Thphr.CP2.1.6

προεκφέρω.definition: put out before, LXXGe.38.28; utter, pronounce before, Demetr.Eloc.51

προεκφλογόω.definition: set on fire before, Olymp.in Mete.31.23

προεκφοβέω.definition: scare before, Plu.Mar.19, Luc.Salt.18, D.C.42.14:—Pass., Plu.Mar.26

προεκφοιτάω.definition: go forth, be announced previously; anticipate a statement, Ph.2.294

προεκφράττω.definition: first remove obstruction, Gal.8.375, Orib.Eup.4.100:—Pass., Gal.15.72

προεκφωνέω.definition: pronounce one thing before another, S.E.M.1.125

προεκχωρέω.definition: go out before, D.C.41.41, v.l. for in 43.39; Id.50.2

προελαύνω.definition: intr., ride on or forward, Id.An.6.3.14: c. gen., ride before one, Id.Mem.3.3.1:—also in Pass., of Time, as the night was now far advanced, Hdt.9.44

προελέγχω.definition: refute before: pf. part. Pass. Oenom. ap. Eus.PE6.7

προελευθερόομαι.definition: Pass., to be set free before, D.C.48.34

προέλκω.definition: draw, drag forth, Ael.VH4.15: metaph., lead on, entice, J.AJ15.3.3:—Med., having drawn it over his head, Sch.S.Aj.245: metaph., lead on, ib.7

προελπίζω.definition: hope for before, Posidipp.27.8, Them.Or.5.65a; Ep.Eph.1.12: generally, anticipate, expect, Gal.16.822, Dexipp.Hist.32 J., Simp.in Epict.p.50D

προεμβαίνω.definition: enter a boat first or before, Plu.Pomp.78; enter a ford first, Philostr.VA2.15

προεμβάλλω.definition: put in or insert before; deposit beforehand, PCair.Zen.637.6

προεμβατήριος.definition: belonging to a a reward given one who first boarded the enemy's ship, Hld.5.31

προεμβιβάζω.definition: put in before, make them hated before, Plb.2.45.4; cf

προεμέω.definition: vomit beforehand, aor. part. Orib.Fr.81: pf. part. fem. Dsc.5.67, cf. Eup.2.20

προεμπίπλαμαι.definition: Pass., to be filled up before, Luc.Cal.8

προεμπίπτω.definition: fall on or into before; protrude into, c. dat., Gal.UP7.7; of a bear trying to bite a net, Plu.2.918f

προέμφασις.definition: previous manifestation, Dam.Pr.118,122 ; Simp.in Ph.422.6; foreshadowing, Id.in Cat.246.18

προεμφορέομαι.definition: Pass., to be filled full before, Plu.2.1067f

προενδείκνυμαι.definition: exhibit oneself or make a demonstration before, Aeschin.3.219

προενδημέω.definition: to be in a place or among a people before; to be prevalent before, J.AJ2.14.4; familiarize oneself with things beforehand, Posidon.Stoic.3.131

προενεδρεύω.definition: lay an ambush before, prob.in Aen.Tact.4.8: c. acc., place in ambush before, App.Hann.20

προενέχομαι.definition: Pass., to be involved in before, LXX2 Ma.5.18

προενεχυράζω.definition: distrain upon previously, in Pass., PTeb. 61.274 ; cf. sq

προενεχυριάζω.definition: bind by pledges before, Sch.T Il.9.45 ; Charito2.7

προενθυμέω.definition: notice before, Aen. Tact.24.18; aor. Pass. in med.sense, think seriously on before, Str.2.5.1, Lib.Or.14.71

προενιδρύω.definition: set up, establish in or among beforehand, Iamb.Myst.5.23

προενίημι.definition: place in a grave, inter previously, pf; inject previously, Orib.Fr.55, Aët.15.13

προεννέπω.definition: proclaim, announce, A.Eu.852; . . , E.Med.351: c. inf., I publicly bid him hail, S.Tr.227, cf. E.Hipp.1085; . . A.Eu.98

προεννοέω.definition: conceive or consider beforehand, Plu.2.1072a, Artem.1.3

προενοικέω.definition: dwell in or inhabit before, D.S.5.84, Ph.2.132

προενοίκησις.definition: dwelling in a place before, Th.1.25, cf. D.C.53.16, Hld.8.1

προεντυγχάνω.definition: encounter, meet first, Ph.1.363, al; intercede with first, Ph.1.547; have audience of first, Plu.Nic.10; an appearance which spoke for him before he opened his mouth, Id.Pomp.2

προεξαγκωνίζω.definition: as a pugilistic term, spar before beginning to fight: hence metaph., of a speaker, Arist.Rh.1416a2

προεξάγω.definition: lead or carry out first, Hdt.9.106; Plb.30.7.8, Plu.2.117d:—Pass., go out first, Th.7.70 ; to be exported previously, BGU802i11, al

προεξαδυνατέω.definition: to be already very weak, Hp.Prorrh.1.8, Coac.99, Gal.16.531

προεξαιθριάζω.definition: first expose to the air, Archig. ap. Gal.13.254

προεξαιρέω.definition: take out before, Sch.Ar.Eq.378; conquer before, App.BC4.76, D.C.46.37

προεξαΐσσω.definition: Att. dart out before, as out of the ranks in battle, Hdt.9.62; Th.8.25

προεξάλλομαι.definition: leap out before: metaph., of passions, Them.Or.1.15d: c. gen., Id.Or.2.33b

προεξανθέω.definition: put forth as flowers first, Plu.2.552c

προεξανίσταμαι.definition: Pass., with aor. 2, pf. and plpf; in a race, start before the signal is given, Hdt.8.59, cf. Plu.Them.11; condemn hastily, Ph.2.210

προεξαποστέλλω.definition: send out before, Plb.3.86.3, LXX2 Ma.12.21

προεξαρτάω.definition: hang in front, v.l. in D.S.3.26

προεξασθενέω.definition: become quite weak first, Arist.Pr.865a36; Ph.2.371: c. gen., J.BJ3.7.7

προεξέδρα.definition: Ion. chair of state, Hdt.7.44, Poll.9.46

προέξειμι.definition: improve, derive benefit, Herod.Med. in Rh.Mus.58.76; sally forth from, Th.3.1

προεξελαύνω.definition: ride out in front, Plu.Phil.7, etc; run out in a ship in front, Plu.Nic.24

προεξεπίσταμαι.definition: contr. know well before, A.Pr.101; ib.699

προεξεργάζομαι.definition: work out before, Nicol.Prog.inRh.1.321 W.: pf. Pass. in pass. sense, Arist.SE183b35, cf. Paus.1.34.5

προεξερευνάω.definition: contr. investigate before, E.Ph.92; Aen. Tact.15.5

προεξέρχομαι.definition: go out before, Th.7.74; Plb.2.23.6; D.H.1.46; . . J.AJ2.7.2 ); Ph.1.603: abs., anticipate arrest by flight, SIG 283.11

προεξογκόομαι.definition: to be made to swell first, Sor.2.11

προεξορμάω.definition: set out, start earlier; rush out before the time, Arist.HA587b1

προέορτος.definition: of a festival, preliminary, Ph.2.294, cf. 481

προεπαγγέλλω.definition: announce before; canvass for an office before, D.C.39.31

προεπανασείω.definition: raise the hand against before: metaph., was threatened before, Th.5.17

προεπαφίημι.definition: send forward against the enemy, Luc.Tox.54

προεπείγω.definition: to be urgent before, v.l. in Orib.5.30.13:—Pass., Lib.Decl.28.2; hasten before, Sch.E.Tr.456

προεπιβάλλω.definition: lay or throw upon before, Plb.16.9.3; Gal.14.291:—Pass., Heliod. ap. Orib.50.53.3

προεπιβουλεύω.definition: plot against beforehand, Th.1.33:—Pass., to be the object of such plots, Id.3.83, D.S.19.65

προεπιγιγνώσκω.definition: recognize or observe before, S.E.P.3.22: —Pass., ib.2.119,210

προεπιδείκνυμι.definition: explain, demonstrate before; Med., display before, Ph.1.551:—Pass., Id.2.93

προεπίδεσμος.definition: band or ligature put on at first, Gal.18.746

προεπιδημέω.definition: to be at home before, Charito3.4, 5.2

προεπιλύω.definition: in Med., solve previously, Ammon.in Porph.56.22

προεπινοέω.definition: observe or consider before, Str.2.5.1:—Pass., to be previously conceived or thought of, Plu.2.1071f: c. gen., Ph.Fr.63H., cf. S.E.M.11.186, Plot.5.9.8

προεπιξενόομαι.definition: Pass., to be received as a guest before, Luc.Bis Acc.7

προεπιπλήσσω.definition: to be the first to blame, prob. in Arist.Rh.1408b2

προεπισκέπτομαι.definition: examine beforehand, Sch.Arat.411, cf. Ptol.Geog.1.6.3, Gal.9.525 : pf. in act. sense, Alex. Aphr.in Top.559.16; in pass. sense, Str.8.3.24

προεπισκήπτομαι.definition: bring an action of first, Mitteis Chr.31 vi7

προεπισκοπέω.definition: I aor. imper. Luc.Merc.Cond.3:— inspect, consider before, l.c

προεπίσταμαι.definition: know or understand beforehand, Pl.Grg.459e, X.Cyr.4.3.12, Isoc.9.12, Arist.APr.67a22, Ael.NA7.8, etc

προεπιστέλλω.definition: dispatch before, PSI4.332.6 ; order by letter before, Paus.7.11.3 :—Pass., of money, to have been allocated before, Arch.Pap.4.117 ii 13

προεπιχειρέω.definition: to be the first to attack, Th.6.34, Ph.2.422, Plu.Thes.9,11, etc

προεργάζομαι.definition: Med. with pf. Pass., work beforehand, Hdt.2.158; work or till beforehand, X.Oec.20.3:—pf. also in pass. sense, to be done before, Antipho2.2.12, Th.2.89, 8.65; glory won before, X.An.6.1.21; . . OGI266.8

προερεθίζω.definition: irritate before, Gal.12.590, Sor. ap. eund.12.418 ; excite, call forth before the time, Heph.Astr.1.25

προερευνάω.definition: in Med., search out first or before, Onos.6.8; the vedettes, X.Lac.13.6

προερέω.definition: Att. contr. serving as fut. to; order beforehand or publicly, Hdt.1.77,81; . . Id.3.61:— Pass., . . Pl.Smp.198e; Th.2.84, cf. Antipho6.40; the prescribed implement, Hdt.1.126; Id.6.128; . . ordered beforehand, Id.7.11…

προέρχομαι.definition: come forth, Arist.HA576a24; to be born, Olymp.Vit.Pl.p.1 W.: generally, Luc.Tox.25, al.; appear, be published, of a book, Str.13.1.54

προευαγγελίζομαι.definition: bring glad tidings before, Ph.1.7,602, Sch.S.Tr.335; . . Ep.Gal.3.8

προευδοκιμέω.definition: to be in good repute before, D.H.Rh.5.6; D.C.39.25

προευεργετέω.definition: confer a favour on before, D.S.19.6 ; Sch.Pi.P.2.32

προευκρινέω.definition: pick out carefully before, Aret.CD1.5; judge carefully, Id.CA1.10; this matter having been cleared up first, A.D.Synt.235.6

προευλαβέομαι.definition: aor. take heed, be cautious beforehand, D.25.95

προευπορέω.definition: provide in advance, prob. (for; solve an overcome a difficulty beforehand, Arist.Ph.208a35 , Simp.in Ph.523.12

προευτρεπίζω.definition: adjust, make ready before, Iamb.Comm.Math.15; prepare, Id.Protr.1; Id.Myst.3.14; HeroDeff.136.13:—Med., J.AJ20.4.2; having it ready, Hld.7.24:—Pass., aor.1 part., Ph.1.212; moved before, J.AJ20.6.3

προεφίημι.definition: deliver previously, PTeb.120.96 (i; Med., c. acc., attack first, . . Phld.Sign.19

προεφίστημι.definition: call one's attention to beforehand, Plb.10.2.1

προεφοδεύομαι.definition: Pass., to be traversed before, Str.12.8.8

προέψημα.definition: savoury meat, Ph.Fr.44 H. , dub. l. ib.39 H

προεωλίζω.definition: first make fish tender by keeping, Xenocr. ap. Orib.2.58.30, Gal.13.580 , 16.761

προζημιόομαι.definition: Pass., suffer loss before, Pl. ap. Lyd.Mens.4.7

προζητέω.definition: search previously, Arist.Mem.451b28:—Pass., to be inquired into first, Ph.Bel.68.19, S.E.P.2.9

προηβάω.definition: to be not yet adult, J.AJ4.8.48

προηγέομαι.definition: go first and lead the way, Hdt.2.48, 7.40; precede logically, S.E.P.1.210

προήγησις.definition: going before, leading, Ph.1.697; = I, Ptol.Tetr.78 ; following on inflammation, Sor.2.35; sequence of causes, Simp.in Ph.794.10

προηγητής.definition: one who goes before to show the way; one who conducts the bride's car in her procession, Hyp.Lyc.5, cf. Hsch

προηγήτωρ.definition: = v.l. in Ph.2.107; leader of animals, Hippiatr.1

προηγορέω.definition: to be spokesman for others, X.An.5.5.7; to be senior in rank, of the Roman consul who possesses the fasces, Not.Arch.4.23

προηγορία.definition: speaking in behalf of others, Luc.Pisc.22

προήδομαι.definition: Pass., to be pleased before or first, with . . , Arist.EN1167a5

προήκω.definition: to have gone before, be the first; to have advanced, Ar.Nu.513; LXX4 Ma.5.4; D.C.58.27; Plu.Alc.13; also, Arist.Pol.1336b18 ; have come to this pass, D.3.1; of Time, Plu.Brut.15; also as my work proceeds, Gal.2.573

προησσάω.definition: Att. overpower beforehand, Plb.2.53.3: but mostly in pf. or plpf. Pass., to be beaten or worsted before, Id.3.90.4, cf. 10.7.6, D.S.13.79, J.AJ15.5.2

προηχέω.definition: cause to resound before, Pratin.Lyr.1.11 ; Philostr.VS1Praef., cf. Them.Or.16.201d

προθειλοπεδεύω.definition: dry in the sun before, Dsc.5.28

προθεμελιόω.definition: lay foundations before, in Pass., Vett.Val.359.19, Ph.2.9

προθεραπεία.definition: Rhet., preparation for the; Medic., preliminary treatment, Orib.Fr.55

προθεραπεύω.definition: prepare beforehand; court beforehand, J.AJ6.14.4; Plu.Alc.25: metaph., Ph.2.3

προθερμαίνω.definition: warm first, Plu.2.725a, Gal.6.90, Procl.Sacr.p.149 B.:—Pass., of water, Arist.Mete.348b32, Fr.216

προθέρμανσις.definition: previous warming, Procl.Sacr.p.149 B., Simp.in Cat.248.33

προθεσμός.definition: in pl., royal privileges or prerogatives, Plu.Nob.3

προθεσπίζω.definition: foretell, A.Pr.213, cf. IG12.891.6 , Ph.1.511 , J.AJ10.5.1, Plu.2.421b, Luc.Alex.19, etc

προθεωρέω.definition: consider before, Hp.Ep.17, v.l. in Arist.HA538a6

προθεωρία.definition: preface, Them.Or.26 tit., An.Ox.3.376; prophecy, Hsch. s.v

προθησαυρίζω.definition: store up, accumulate before, Arist.PA674b24:— Pass., Pall.in Hp.2.27 D

προθνῄσκω.definition: die before, Th.2.52; of hair, fall off prematurely, in form Aret.SD2.13

προθρηνέω.definition: bewail beforehand, Ph.2.72, cf. Aristid.1.419 J

προθυμέομαι.definition: abs. , show zeal, exert oneself, A.Pr.383, 630, Hdt.8.86, 9.38, Th.4.81, X.An.6.4.22, etc.; to be of good cheer, in good spirits, opp. Id.Cyr.6.2.13

προθυμία.definition: Ion. readiness, willingness; c. gen. pers., at his desire, Hdt.6.65, cf. E.Hipp.1329; as far as his desire goes, Hdt.1.124; by the will of the god, E.Ion1385; also Lys.12.99

προθυμοποιέομαι.definition: make willing or ready, encourage, Steph. in Hp. Aph.2.473 D., v.l. in D.S.14.56:—Act. in Eust.1393.43

προθύτης.definition: Aeol. one who offers IG 12.484.25 ; of the priest of a BCH24.386

προθύω.definition: fut. E.Ion805, SIG548.11 (Delph., iii; sacrifice for or in behalf of, E.Ion805; Id.Supp.29

προϊδρύω.definition: pre-establish, in Pass., Dam.Pr.13; ib.28 bis

προϊεράομαι.definition: to be deputy priest or priestess; sacrifice on behalf of another, SIG 1037.6

προΐζομαι.definition: Med., take the first seat, Hdt.8.67:—later, in Act., Sch. Ar.Pax1241, dub. l. in Plot.5.8.11

προικίζω.definition: portion, give a dowry to, D.S.16.55, Ph.2.311, name of a comedy by Apollod.Car

προίκιος.definition: = foreg. I, of the cicada, AP6.120 ; of honey, ib.9.404 ; dub. l. in Call.Fr.542 = Oxy.2079.34

προικοφορέομαι.definition: Med., receive as a dower, Eust.1851.16

προϊππεύω.definition: ride before or in front, D.S.17.86, Plu.Sull.28, etc.; D.S.18.30, Arr.An.1.15.7; Plu.Cam.2

προΐσσομαι.definition: ask a gift, beg, Archil.130; cf

προΐστημι.definition: fut. aor. 1 part; set over, v.l. for Pl.La.197d

προϊστορέω.definition: make previous inquiry or research; relate by way of introduction, Phlp.in Mete.75.20

προϊσχναίνω.definition: become dry or lean before, Arist.Pr.874a35

προκαθεύδω.definition: fut. sleep before or first; sleep for or on behalf of another, Philostr.VA8.7

προκαθηγεμών.definition: epith. of Artemis at Ephesus, Ephes. 2 No. 20; at Iasus, Rev. Et. Gr.6.159

προκαθηγέομαι.definition: go before and guide, Plb.3.95.6; to be precedent, opp. consequent or subsequent, S.E.P.2.101,116, etc

προκαθηγέτης.definition: leader, epith. of gods, as Pan, IG5.93 ; Hermes, BSA 16.107 ; Apollo, Epigr.Gr.1023.5 : fem. epith. of Athena, CIG4332 ; prob. in Epic. Alex. Adesp.9 ii 17; Dor. Mesom.Mus.6

προκαθηγητήρ.definition: wedge-shaped instrument for setting the of a torsion-engine, Ph.Bel.67.4

προκαθιερόομαι.definition: Pass., to be consecrated before, Sch.Pi.P.4.361

προκαθιζάνω.definition: cause to sit down in, . . Supp.Epigr.4.573.3

προκαθίημι.definition: let down beforehand, Aen.Tact.18.9: metaph., plunge the city into confusion, D.14.5; put a person forward in order to deceive, Id.19.77; spread it before, D.C.58.9 , Aristid.1.482J.:— Pass., D.C.62.15

προκαθοσιόομαι.definition: Pass., to be dedicated before, Hld.10.37; J.AJ16.11.8

προκακόομαι.definition: Pass., to be afflicted before, LXX4 Ma.17.22, Sch.Ar.Ra.33, etc

προκαλινδέομαι.definition: Pass., fall prostrate before another, Lat. provolvi ad genna, Isoc.4.151 , D.19.338, etc.; Aristaenet.1.27; Anon. ap. Suid.; Jul.Ep.205

προκαλύπτω.definition: hang before or put over as a covering; cover over, X.An.3.4.8 :—Med., veiled her eyes, E.Med.1147:—Pass., to be covered, X.Cyr.5.4.45

προκαρόομαι.definition: Pass., to be affected with drowsiness before, Hp.Prorrh.1.155, Coac.25

προκαταβαίνω.definition: descend, of the foetus, Arist.HA583b31; D.S.15.85 ; step into a bath first, Gal.11.606

προκαταβάλλω.definition: apply first, Heliod. ap. Orib.48.35.2; Med., lay the foundations of before, Id.2.476; D.C.43.49, 57.10: metaph., Andronic.Rhod.p.577 M.:—Pass., Ph.1.405, al

προκαταβάπτω.definition: dip, plunge first, Olymp. Alch.p.94B.:—Pass., Paul.Aeg.3.70

προκαταβολή.definition: payment on account: in Att. Law; foundation: metaph. of medical treatment, Philum.Ven.3.1; condition precedent, Ammon, in Int.145.12

προκαταγγέλλω.definition: announce or declare beforehand, Act.Ap.3.18, J.AJ2.5.2
