προκατάγνυμαι.definition: Pass., to be broken in pieces before, Sch.Od.3.296

προκατάγομαι.definition: Pass., get into harbour before, Luc.Cat.18

προκαταγράφω.definition: write down before or in an earlier passage, Epicur.Nat.26 G. , Sor.1.1

προκαταδικάζομαι.definition: Pass., to be condemned before, Din.Fr.89; to pay 2 minae, Tab.Heracl.1.171

προκαταδουλόομαι.definition: Pass., to be subdued before, D.S.12.1

προκαταδύνω.definition: set before, Hipparch.1.5.17; also Gal.9.906, Heph.Astr.2.11: aor. Alex.Aphr.in Mete.31.25

προκαταθέω.definition: run down before, v.l. in X.An.6.3.10

προκαταθήγω.definition: sharpen at the point before, Hsch

προκαταιονάω.definition: moisten before, Gal.10.910, Orib.Frr.76, 110, Paul. Aeg.3.81

προκατακαίω.definition: burn before, D.C.60.34; of soldiers, burn all before them, X.An.1.6.2

προκατάκειμαι.definition: lie down before, at meals, Luc.Merc.Cond.26,Hld.4.16

προκατακλίνω.definition: cause to lie down before others, at meals, ib.15.2.4:—Pass., = Luc.DDeor.13.1; stoop down before, J.BJ5.6.3

προκατακνίζω.definition: pick, trim first, Dsc.2.123 , cf. Gal.19.456

προκατακόπτω.definition: cut up beforehand, Antiph.230.7: metaph., cut to pieces, massacre first, Eun.VSp.480B

προκατακρίνω.definition: form a prejudgement of, Plu.2.112d; reject in comparison with, f.l. in AP12.207

προκαταλαγχάνω.definition: obtain by lot beforehand, Sch. Pi.N.3.129

προκαταλαμβάνω.definition: seize beforehand, occupy in advance; generally, preoccupy, Aeschin.3.71; ib.248; Id.2.108; by the previous speakers, Isoc.4.74

προκαταλέγομαι.definition: Pass., to be described beforehand, Hdt.4.175: pf. part. Ath.3.119a; but also A.D.Conj.213.1, cf. Heph.Astr.2.24

προκαταλήγω.definition: terminate beforehand, Plb.2.14.6; anticipate cessation, Gal.19.201

προκατάληψις.definition: seizing in advance; preoccupation, anticipation of an adversary's arguments, Arist.Rh.Al.1428a8 , 1432b11; in anticipation of . . , J.AJ19.1.13

προκαταλλάσσομαι.definition: Pass., to be reconciled before, D.C.55.10a

προκαταλύω.definition: break up, annul beforehand; intr., rest before, Ph.1.229

προκαταμανθάνω.definition: learn or consider first, Antyll. ap. Orib.8.5.1, cf. D.C.52.33

προκαταναλίσκω.definition: squander beforehand, Satyr.20; use him up before with . . , Posidon.36J.:—Pass., D.H.3.44

προκατανίζω.definition: wash first, in aor. part. fem. Heraclid.Tar. ap. Gal.13.727

προκαταντλέω.definition: give a previous douche, Dsc.Eup.1.168, Gal.13.632, Aët.12.27

προκαταξύω.definition: scrape first, Asclep. ap. Gal.12.411 , Archig. ap. Aët.6.55

προκαταπαύω.definition: cause to cease before, from . . , Lib.Or.18.99; but before the moderate amount, Gal.6.286

προκαταπίπτω.definition: fall down before, sooner, M.Ant.4.15; rumours reached Rome in advance, Plu.Pomp.43

προκαταπλάσσω.definition: plaster before, in Pass., Heras ap.Gal.13.547, Herod.Med. ap. Orib.Fr.70

προκαταπλήσσω.definition: strike with terror beforehand, D.C.47.34:—Med., Plb.5.70.9:—Pass., D.S.19.106

προκαταπονέω.definition: tire, weary first, Agathin. ap. Orib.10.7.14:—Pass., Ruf. ap. Orib.inc.9.1

προκάταργμα.definition: libation before the sacrifice, Sch.Ar.Pl.660; cf

προκαταριθμέω.definition: reckon up beforehand, Hierocl.p.57 A; enumerate above, Herod.Med. ap. Orib.5.30.21

προκάταρξις.definition: first beginning, i.e. litis contestatio, Cod.Just. 1.3.45.4; POxy.67.11

προκαταρρήγνυμι.definition: break down before, prob. in D.C.36.7

προκαταρτίζω.definition: complete beforehand, Supp.Epigr.4.449.13 , 2 Ep.Cor.9.5:—Pass., got ready, prepared beforehand, Hp.Decent.8, cf. Ph.Bel.95.40

προκαταρχή.definition: origin, title of work by Zeno Epicureus, Phld.Herc.1005.7

προκατάρχω.definition: begin first, Ph.1.487; of causes , Dsc.Ther.Praef., cf. Sor.2.17, Gal.9.1: c. gen., Dam.Pr.284; Plu.2.574d, cf. Iamb.Myst.1.7

προκατασκέπτομαι.definition: fut. Arr.An.1.13.1: aor. D.H.11.26:—inspect beforehand, ll.cc

προκατασκευάζω.definition: prepare beforehand; Rhet., use the device of 3, Hermog.Inv.3.2; Id.Stat.3

προκατασκευή.definition: preparatory training; preface, introduction, Plb.1.3.10, 1.13.7, etc

προκατασκιρρόομαι.definition: Pass., to be hardened beforehand: metaph., inveterate en mity, LXX3 Ma.4.1

προκατασπείρω.definition: sow beforehand, PMeyer 12.21 : metaph., implant beforehand, Aen.Gaz.Thphr.p.56B

προκαταστέλλω.definition: begin by calming or moderating, Aristid.Quint.2.15; Eust.104.14

προκαταστρέφω.definition: subdue, overthrow beforehand, J.BJ4.7.3; die first, Phld.Herc. 1041.8, D.L.2.138: metaph., . . stop short at . . , Epicur.Sent.25

προκαταταχέω.definition: to be beforehand, get the start of another, S.E.M.10.145 sq.; with v.l. ib.153:—Pass., of ships, Gem.12.18

προκατατίθημι.definition: in aor. gloss on; mostly Med., set down before, make an introductory statement, Hp.Vict.1.1

προκαταυλέω.definition: soothe beforehand by flute-playing, Cels. ap. OrigenesCels.3.16

προκαταφέρομαι.definition: Pass., fall down or sink in first; die first, Lib.Or.40.3

προκαταφεύγω.definition: escape to a place of safety first, Th.3.78; Id.2.91; of suppliants seeking sanctuary, Id.1.134

προκαταφορά.definition: Astrol., name of the sixth Cat.Cod. Astr.8.154

προκαταχέω.definition: pour upon first, f.l. for in Gal.13.598

προκαταχράομαι.definition: use up beforehand; simply, employ first, App.BC3.51

προκαταχρίω.definition: smear beforehand, Dsc.1.43, cf. Asclep. ap. Gal.12.411

προκαταχωρίζω.definition: assign before, LXX3 Ma.2.29; deposit before, of deeds, PTeb.302.23

προκαταψύχω.definition: cool first, Ptol.Tetr.15:—Pass., Procl.Par.Ptol.22: pf. part. Gal.13.584

προκατεργάζομαι.definition: subdue first, D.C.43.4; prepare beforehand, Thphr.CP3.20.8, al.; work up beforehand, Gal.UP8.10; do or perform beforehand, D.S.30.8:—pf. Pass., Id.4.17; to be prepared, J.AJ19.1.14, Plu.Comp. Demetr.Ant.1: aor. only i…

προκατέρχομαι.definition: aor. return before, Hdn.1.10.7, f.l. for in Corp.Herm.1.20

προκατεύχομαι.definition: Med., pray before doing a thing, Hld.2.35; J.BJ2.8.5

προκατηγορέω.definition: bring accusations beforehand, f.l. for; to be the first accuser, Hermog.Meth.27

προκατηχέω.definition: soothe beforehand with sounds, Cels. ap; instruct beforehand, Hld.9.9

προκατισχνόομαι.definition: to be emaciated already, Gal. ap. Orib.44.25.24

προκατοπτάομαι.definition: become adust first, of humours, Gal.15.86

προκατοπτεύω.definition: observe first, Hld.7.6:—Pass., Vett; learn from scouts, Hld.9.1

προκαυτεύω.definition: sacrifice as a preliminary burnt-offering, in Pass., SIG 1026.12

προκελεύω.definition: give orders before, Wilcken Chr.14 iii 16 , dub. sens. in Hsch. s.v

προκενόω.definition: empty beforehand, J.BJ6.7.2:—Pass; Medic., drain or evacuate first, Ruf. ap. Orib.7.26.7, Aret.CD1.2, Gal.10.798

προκέντημα.definition: thing pricked or traced out beforehand, design, pattern, S.E.M.7.107 , Nicom.Ar.1.4

προκηδεύω.definition: bury before oneself, CIG3891 :—Pass., to be buried before, ib.3902f , 3113

προκήδομαι.definition: take care of, take thought for, A.Pr.629, S.Ant.741, Tr.966 ; in later Prose, prob. in Phld.Rh.2.157 S., cf.J.AJ13.16.6

προκηρυκεύομαι.definition: have proclaimed by herald, give; negotiate by herald, And.3.3; Aeschin.2.172

προκήρυξις.definition: proclamation by herald, Thphr.Fr.97.2 , Wilcken Chr.41 iii 37

προκηρύσσω.definition: Att. proclaim by herald, proclaim publicly, S.Ant.461, Is.6.37, etc.: c. inf., Arist.Oec.1350a20; Plu.Cleom.9: c. acc. rei, S.El.684; Id.Ant.34; Plb.5.60.3; Ael.VH4.1; advertise for sale, Poll.8.103 ; put up to auctio…

προκινδυνεύω.definition: pf. IG9.531.5 :—run risk before others, brave the first danger, bear the brunt of battle, Th.7.56, D.18.208; Id.2.24: c. gen., brave danger for the people, And.4.1, cf. X.Hier.10.8; braved him for Greece , Th.1.73; X.…

προκινέω.definition: move forward, X.Cyr.1.4.21; urge; excite or begin before, D.S.17.19

προκισηρίζω.definition: rub with pumice-stone first, PLeid.X.89 B

προκλαίω.definition: Att. weep beforehand or openly; trans., lament beforehand, Hdt.5.8, cf. E.Alc.526, Ph.1520 codd.)

προκλέπτομαι.definition: Pass., to be deceived before, Sch.S.Ant.493

προκληδονίζομαι.definition: deem a favourable omen, draw good augury from, J.BJ3.1.3

προκλύζω.definition: wash out beforehand, in Pass., Dsc.1.30; Medic., purge beforehand by a clyster, Id.Eup.1.231, Alex. Trall.9.3

πρόκλυτος.definition: heard formerly, of olden time, Il.20.204

προκνήμιον.definition: inner bone of the leg, tibia, Poll.2.190

προκνημίς.definition: covering for the leg, Plb.6.23.8, Ascl.Tact.1.2, Ael.Tact.2.8, Polyaen.6.4.3

προκοιμάομαι.definition: go to sleep before, those who have died already, Antioch.Astr.inCat.Cod.Astr.8.110

προκοιτέω.definition: keep guard before a place, J.BJ4.5.1, D.C.64.7: also Id.54.15

προκοιτία.definition: watch kept before a place, Id.67.15: pl., Plb.2.5.6, 6.35.5

προκοιτών.definition: ante-chamber, Plin.Ep.2.17.23: condemned by Phryn.227, cf. Poll.10.43

προκομίζω.definition: bring forward, produce, J.AJ1.16.2; Pass., to be carried on before, esp. to a place of safety, Hdt.4.122, Luc.Nav.19; to be borne in procession, D.S.31.8

προκοπή.definition: progress on a journey, Plu.2.76d; generally, progress, advance, that opinion forming was the stoppage of progress, Bion ap.D.L.4.50; Plb.2.37.10, 2.13.1, 8.15.6; Id.1.12.7; opp. J.AJ4.4.1; freq. of moral progress, Sto…

προκοπιάω.definition: labour, make effort previously, IGRom.3.739 vi 91

προκόπτω.definition: cut one's way forward, only metaph; with neut. Adjs., shall make no progress, advance not at all. Alc.35; having prepared most of the way, E.Hipp.23; what good would you get? Id.Alc.1079; . . they made no progress tow…

προκρεμαννύω.definition: hang in front, prob. for -in Aen.Tact.32.3:—Pass. hang forward, Arist.Phgn.811b14; part. ib.a25

πρόκριμα.definition: prejudgement, 1 Ep.Ti.5.21, Anon; = praejudicium, IG5.21 ii 7 , Mitteis Chr.88 ii 30 , PFlor.68.13 , Cod.Just.10.11.8.5

προκριματίζω.definition: praerogo, Gloss.:—Pass., to be punished, Greg.Cor.inRh.7.1123 W

προκριτέος.definition: to be preferred, Xenocr. ap; one must prefer, Ap.Ty.Ep.11, cf. Dsc.5.108, Plu.Nob.9, etc

πρόκριτος.definition: chosen before others, select; at Rome, = princeps, D.C.57.8; = princeps senatus, Id.53.1, cf. 46.20; = princeps juventutis, Id.78.17 ; , = princeps peregrinorum, prob. in Id.78.14

πρόκρουσις.definition: name of a musical phrase, Anon.Bellerm.p.20

προκρούω.definition: beat out and so stretch, whence the name of; attack, Dor. impf. Ar.Lys.1252

προκτάομαι.definition: in pf. and plpf., possess beforehand, Str.8.3.33

προκτενίζω.definition: comb the scalp before applying hair- restorer, Gal.12.421

πρόκτησις.definition: title-deed showing previous ownership, Sammelb. 4638.10 , POxy.504.13 , CPR187.6

προκυβερνάω.definition: guide the steerer from the prow, Poll.1.98

προκύκλιος.definition: of a Herod.6.90; II., dub. sens., of certain gods at Erythrae, SIG1014.130

προκυλινδέομαι.definition: Pass., roll before or at the feet of, prostrate oneself before another, Ar.Av.501 , Luc.DDeor.6.2 ; D.19.338 ; Wilcken Chr.6.8 ; Arist.HA613b18 ; cf

προκυνέω.definition: of a dog, give tongue too soon, Poll.5.65

προκυνηγία.definition: show preliminary to a venatio, IGRom.3.631 ; also ib.681

προκύπτω.definition: point forwards and downwards; stick one's head out, peep out, D.C.64.6; S.E.M.7.350, cf. 364: c. gen., Alciphr.3.30; Babr.116.3

προκυρόομαι.definition: Pass., to be ratified or confirmed before, Supp.Epigr.3.674 A 28 ; Ep.Gal.3.17:—Med., Anon.Prog.inRh.1.605 W

προλαγχάνω.definition: obtain by lot first, Ar.Ec.1159; obtain as a perquisite, SIG57.10

προλάζυμαι.definition: receive beforehand or by anticipation, c. gen. partit., E.Ion1027

προλαλέω.definition: converse first, Antyll. ap. Orib.6.9.1; state, announce before, Eust.1382.24:—Pass., J.AJ15.3.8

προλαλιά.definition: discourse, alternative title of Luc.Bacch. and Herc., Sch. ad loc.; good Attic acc. to Thom.Mag.p.224 R

προλαμβάνω.definition: fut. Isoc.6.16: aor; take or seize beforehand, Aeschin.3.142; A.D.Synt.40.24; D.18.26; provide that . . , Id.3.2: c. part., having first procured your vote of condemnation, Id.24.77:—Pass., Corp.Herm.12.3

προλειόω.definition: pound or grind beforehand, Gal.12.347, Alex.Trall.9.3:—Pass., Heras ap.Gal.13.756

προλεπτύνω.definition: make thin, reduce beforehand, Arist.GA726a1, cf. Gal.6.90:—Pass., to be made or become thin, Pl.Ti.66a, Arist.HA513a14; of diseases, to be reduced, mitigated, Ruf.Fr.72

προλεσχηνεύομαι.definition: hold conversations with one before, Hdt.6.4

προλεύσσω.definition: see before oneself or in front, S.Ph.1360

προλημματίζω.definition: place before, in Pass., A.D.Synt.7.17: pf. ib.19.26

πρόληψις.definition: preconception, mental picture or; in common use, previous notion or conception, Plb.8.27.1; Id.10.43.8, cf. A.D.Conj.247.22, al., PFay.124.16

προλιμνάζω.definition: form a marsh before a river, Paus.8.22.3

προλιμοκτονέομαι.definition: Pass., to be starved beforehand, Arist.HA595a22, al

προλιπαίνω.definition: anoint beforehand, Sor.1.69, cf. Dsc.Alex.1, Orib.8.6.27

προλόβιον.definition: lower lobe of the ear, Poll.2.85, Hsch.; cf

πρόλοβος.definition: = crop of birds, e.g. of; thyroid cartilage, Adam's apple, Poll.2.207

προλογίζω.definition: speak a prologue, Sch.S.Ph.1, etc.; to be; to be spokesman in a law-court, PLond. 5.1708.27

προλούω.definition: wash beforehand, Hp.Mul.1.68, Archig. ap. Gal.13.235:— Pass., Sor.1.65; bathe beforehand, Clearch.16

προλοχίζω.definition: lay an ambuscade beforehand, J.BJ1.4.4; place men in ambuscade, Id.AJ5.2.11, BJ1.2.2

προλυπέομαι.definition: Pass., feel pain or distress before, Pl.R.584b, Phdr.258e, Phlb.39d

προμαλακτήριον.definition: the room in which bathers were rubbed before bathing, Gal.12.239

προμαλάσσω.definition: Att. soften beforehand; relax first, in Pass., Alex.Trall.10

προμανθάνω.definition: learn beforehand, and know beforehand, Pi.O.8.60, cf. Com.Adesp.785 ; Th.1.138: c. acc., learn gradually or by rote, E.Fr.912.10 ; Ar.Nu.966; Pl.Lg.643c: c. gen., dub. in Call.Fr.anon.205: c. inf., S.Ph.538

προμαντεύομαι.definition: prophesy, foretell, divine, abs., Hdt.3. [125]: c. acc., Arist.Fr.10; foresee, E.Fr.482; D.C.57.20; . . Luc.DDeor.16.1: c.acc. et inf., Id.DMort.11.2:—Act. in Plu.Cat.Ma.23

πρόμαντις.definition: Ion. prophet or prophetess; = the representative of the god and the organ of his prophecies, title of the Pythia, Hdt.6.66, 7.111, 141; Th.5.16; Neophr.1.3; also of Apollo at Patara, Hdt.1.182; of Ptoän Apollo, Id.8.1…

προμαραίνω.definition: cause to waste away: reduce to nothing, Vett. Val.355.27:—Pass., die away first, Arist.Pr.932b33; dried grapes, Aët.12.55; to be wasted, worn out, Vett.Val.242.2, cf. 252.27

προμαχέω.definition: fight in front, X.Cyr.3.3.60, cf. Apollod.Poliorc.187.9; fighting as their champions, Simon.90

προμαχεών.definition: breastwork, battlement, in pl., Hdt.1.98, 3.151, X.An.7.8.13; Hdt.1.164

προμαχόρμα.definition: = sq. II, epith. of Athena at Buporthmos, Paus.2.34.8

προμεθίημι.definition: c. acc. et dat., hand over before, App.BC3.8,36

προμεθύσκομαι.definition: Pass., to be drunk with wine before, aor. Plu.2.734a

προμείγνυμι.definition: mingle beforehand, only in Pass., to have intercourse with her before, Il.9.452

προμελαίνομαι.definition: Pass., become black at the tip, . . Nic.Th.797

προμελετάω.definition: practise beforehand; acquire a habit of, c. inf., Diocl.Fr.27:—Pass., that to which one is not accustomed, Sor.1.26

προμεταβάλλω.definition: alter or metabolize before, of food; intr., change before, S.E.M.5.59

προμέτρης.definition: = Lat. mensor, camp-surveyor; title of magistrate at Ephesus, CIG 3028

προμετρητής.definition: a servant of the IG22.1672.291, Hyp.Fr.191, Din.Fr.16.4; = mensor, Gloss

πρόμετρος.definition: = Sm.2 Ki. 21.20; previous measure, of a unit, Syrian.in Metaph.134.26

προμετωπίδιος.definition: before or on the forehead; Subst. skin of the forehead, Hdt.7.70

προμετωπίς.definition: star on the forehead; front of a coffin, Inscr.Magn.281

Προμήθειος.definition: Ps.Plu.Fluv.5.4; festival of Prometheus, Lys.21.3, X.Ath.3.4: IG12.84.37,22.1138.11

προμηθέομαι.definition: 2sg. Archil. in PLit.Lond.54:—to be use forethought, take care, c. gen., Hdt.3.78; . . Hierocl.in CA26p.479M.; Pl.Prt.316c; Id.La.198e: abs., Hp.Vict.3.73, al.: c. inf., Alciphr.1.10: c. acc. rei, Hp.Fract.20, Pl.Cri.…

Προμηθεύς.definition: as Appellat., A.Pr.86: as Adj. provident rule , Id.Supp.700; Pythag. name for unity, Theol.Ar.5: for nine, ib.57

προμηνυτής.definition: one who gives information in advance, Vett.Val.173.19

προμηνύτρια.definition: she who indicates before, Sch.rec. A.Th.402

προμηνύω.definition: denounce beforehand, S.Ant.84, cf. Luc.Merc.Cond.3; Chor.p.97 B.; indicate before, predict, LXXWi.18.19, Plu.Lys.29, Alex.Aphr.Pr.Praef., Ach.Tat.6.5; Plu.Comp.Cim.Luc.3

προμισθόομαι.definition: Pass., to be hired before, Plu.Marc.5

προμισθωτής.definition: one who hires out stage- properties, Lat. promisthota, Dessau ILS5208

προμνάομαι.definition: woo or court for another, Pl.Tht.150a; generally, endeavour to obtain, solicit, X.An.7.3.18; solicit it for him, Plu.Luc.6; Id.2.38b

προμνήστρια.definition: woman who woos or courts for another, matchmaker, Ar.Nu.41, Pl.Tht.149d, Luc.DDeor.20.16: metaph., E.Hipp.589; is prob. for in X.Mem.2.6.36

προμοιχεύω.definition: procure a woman by adultery, Plu.Galb.19

προμυέω.definition: initiate beforehand, in aor. Med., prob. for in Hsch. s.v

προμύσσω.definition: Att. snuff a lamp, Ar.V.249 , Plu.2.798b. 2. metaph., extort money from, Hp.Praec.4. 3. a lamp which trims itself, pushes out its own wick, dub. cj. for in HeroSpir.1.34

προμυχθίζω.definition: groan or roar before, Hsch., Phot

προναυκληρέω.definition: act for one as shipmaster, Bull.Soc.Roy.Lund1928/9 iv 48

προναύκληρος.definition: one who acts for a shipmaster, IG12 .585 ; gloss on Sch.Od.8.163; = magister navis, Gloss

προναυμαχέω.definition: fight at sea for or in defence of, Hdt.6.7

προνεύω.definition: stoop or bend forward, Pl.Euthd.274b; of a rider, X.Eq.8.7; of rowers, Id.Oec.8.8, Plb.1.21.2; of horns, Arist.HA611b5; of promontories, Poll.1.115 cod. B, Suid. s.v. of a wrestler, Gal.6.142

προνήχομαι.definition: swim before, Plu.2.980f, Ael.NA10.8: c. gen., Plu.2.984a

προνικάω.definition: gain a victory beforehand, Th.2.89 , Is.11.18, etc

προνιτρόω.definition: = Archig. ap. Paul.Aeg.4.6, Thessal. ap. Harpocr.inCat.Cod.Astr.8.148

προνοητής.definition: supervisor, administrator, OGI660.8 ; of estates, PLond.2.214 ; of Hermes, Herm. ap. Stob.1.49.44; curator of public buildings, etc., CIG4591 ; PGrenf.2.67

προνομαία.definition: = II, Ph.2.512, Plu.Alex.60, Luc.Zeux.10, etc.; of a fly's proboscis, Id.Musc.Enc.6; of a bee's, Philostr.Im.2.12

προνομεύω.definition: forage, plunder, Plb.2.27.2, Str.16.1.18; trans., plunder, ravage, D.H.8.11 ; pluck, Posidipp.24; eat greedily, Plu.2.709a

προνομή.definition: plunder, booty, LXXNu.31.11, al., Phleg.Mir.3; store, provision, LXX3 Ki.10.23

προνομία.definition: privilege, Ph.1.6, al; right of pasturage, IG9.442

προνομοθετέω.definition: make a law before, Suid. s.v. to be established by law before, Milet.3 No.134.17, D.C.36.39

προνοτίζω.definition: wet, moisten beforehand, in Pass., Dsc.2.83, Archig. ap.Orib.8.2.7

προξενέω.definition: impf. (but E.Fr.1104; generally, to be one's protector, patron, E.Med.724, Ar.Th.576

προξενητής.definition: broker, agent, CIG2942 ; slave-broker, OGI524.2 ; Cod.Just. 5.1.6.1

προξενόομαι.definition: Pass., to be entertained before, c. dat. pers., Str.1.2.33

προξηροτριβέομαι.definition: Pass., to be rubbed dry before, Crateuas9, Antyll. ap. Orib.10.21.4

προοδεύω.definition: walk first, App.BC4.43; travel before, Luc.Herm.73; emanate, prob. in Iamb.VP17.74; the patient has a slight motion of the bowels, Paul.Aeg.3.71: metaph. in fut. Med., will go on ad infinitum, Alex.Aphr.in Metaph.288.24

προοδηγός.definition: one who goes before to show the way, LXX2 Ma.12.36

προοδοιπορέω.definition: travel before, Luc.Herm.27; Pass., to be travelled over before, J.AJ3.1.1

προοδοιπόρος.definition: one who travels before, Hsch. s.v

προοδοποιέω.definition: aor. Arist.Pr.867a39: pf; c. acc., prepare beforehand, Arist.Pr.867a39; S.E.M.6.34; Plu.Sol.12, cf. Lyc.4:—Pass., Arist.Pol.1270a4; Id.PA650b28; Id.Rh.1379a21, cf. GA770b3, Epicur.Nat.Herc.1420.3

προόδους.definition: with prominent teeth, Poll.2.96 cod.A: also Phot., Eust.1872.33; written Phryn.PSp.101 B

προοδυνάομαι.definition: Pass., feel pain before, Gal.16.557, Sch.Pi.P.2.166

προοικειόομαι.definition: Med., make friendly, win over beforehand, prob. in D.H.5.64

προοικία.definition: the projecting eaves of a house, Clitodem.25

προοικοδομέω.definition: build in front, Ph.Bel.84.13:—Pass., dub.in Luc.Alex.14

προοικονομέω.definition: arrange before, J.AJ2.5.7:—Med., get; Med., introduce into a speech before, premise, Cic.QF 2.3.6

προοικονομία.definition: prefatory summary, Hdn.Fig.p.103 S., Donat.ad Ter.Eun.719, Serv.ad Verg.A.1.226, al., Eust.16.7

προοιμιάζομαι.definition: pf. Luc.Nigr.10:—in; c.acc., say by way of preface, premise, E.IT1162; Pl.La.179a, cf. Thphr.Char.Praef.4; . . begin by invoking them, A.Eu.20: c.dat.modi, Them.Or.13.173d: pf. in pass. sense, Arist.Pol.1325b33; ib.13…

προοίμιον.definition: metaph. of any prelude or beginning, A.Ag.31, cf. 829; ib.1216, cf. Th.7; . . only just beginning, Id.Pr.741; any part of this presage, Id.Eu.142; . . Id.Supp.830 , cf. E.Hipp.568, X.Mem.4.2.3; Pi.Fr.78; Alex.110.3; P…

προοίχομαι.definition: to have gone on before, X.Cyr.7.4.8

προολμοκοπέω.definition: pound in a mortar first, in Pass., Orib.Fr.93, Aët.12.32

προομαλύνω.definition: make level or even first, Pl.Ti.50e

προόμνυμι.definition: and , swear before or beforehand, D.29.57; . . by the gods, Pl.Lg.954a; Paus. l. c.: c. acc. et inf., A.Ag.1196; D.29.52

προομολογέω.definition: grant or concede beforehand; Pass., to be betrothed beforehand, J.Ap.2.24

πρόοπτος.definition: Att. contr. foreseen, manifest, Hdt.9.17, cf. Isoc.10.27; Th.5.99, cf. 111; A.Th.848 ; S.OC1440, cf. E.Hipp.1366 ; . . Aristopho5; . . Phoenicid.4.18

προόρασις.definition: foreseeing, prevision, Phld.D.1.13; Plot.3.2.1, cf. 6.7.1, Simp.in Ph.391.32: pl., Them.Or.11.146b; = Lat. Providentia Augusta, IG Rom.4.1593

προοράω.definition: foresee, Hdt.5.24, etc.; X.Cyr.3.2.15; Id.Smp.4.5; D.4.41, cf. 54.19 : abs., Arist.Pol.1252a32

προορίζω.definition: determine beforehand, Hld.7.24; predetermine, predestine, Ep.Eph.1.5; Act.Ap.4.28; Ep.Rom.8.29

προορμίζω.definition: moor or anchor in front, Th.7.38

προορχηστήρ.definition: one who leads the dance, among the Thessalians = Luc.Salt.14

προοφείλω.definition: Att. contr. owe beforehand; to be bound to do, . . E.Heracl.240

προοφθαλμίς.definition: first bud of a young vine, Gp.5.3.3

προοχεύω.definition: impregnate before, Phlp.in GA128.13:—Pass., of eggs, Arist.GA757b2

προπαθαίνομαι.definition: of an orator, to be passionate beforehand, Sopat.inRh.8.58 W

προπάθεια.definition: preliminary experience, anticipation; previous experience, Id.Fr.7.10

προπάθημα.definition: previous suffering, f.l. for Hsch. s.v

προπαθής.definition: suffering before, f.l. for in Ph.2.595

προπαιδεία.definition: preparatory teaching, which they must receive before entering on dialectic, Pl.R.536d, cf. Luc.Rh.Pr.14

προπαιδεύω.definition: teach beforehand, in Pass., Pl.R.536d; . . Arist.Pol.1337a19; S.E.M.6.29

προπαλαιόω.definition: keep till old, Ruf. ap. Orib.4.2.16

προπαραβάλλω.definition: put beside one beforehand, Alex.Trall.11.1:—Med., do so for oneself, Th.7.5

προπαραγγέλλω.definition: announce beforehand, GDI5040.41 , Hld.9.10: c. inf., D.C.46.41:—Pass., to be warned before, Aen.Tact.27.3

προπαραδίδωμι.definition: explain or set down beforehand; betray beforehand, Gal.5.310

προπαραλαμβάνω.definition: receive from another before; intr., anticipate the menstrual period, Sor.1.21

προπαραλήγω.definition: to be the antepenultimate, the antepenultimate, Sch.Ar.Ra.1455, Eust.15.34, al.:— Med., have in the antepenultimate, EM308.49

προπαρασημαίνομαι.definition: Pass., to be noted before, Eust.1133.14, al

προπαρασκευάζω.definition: prepare beforehand, Pl.R.429d, cf.Plt.308d; X.Mem.2.2.5; Th.2.88; Arist.HA613a4:—Med., prepare for oneself, Is.8.38; Th.1.57; for one's purposes, D.C.38.13: abs., make one's preparations, Aen.Tact.11.14, Plu.Eum.6:—Pa…

προπαρασκευή.definition: preparation, Hp.Acut.25 , Sor.1.66, Procl.in Prm.p.679S. ; futurae litis, Donat. ad Ter.Eun.495; of opp. Herm.in Phdr.p.158A

προπαρατίθημι.definition: set on table before, in Med., Heraclid. Tar. ap. Ath.2.53c, cf. eund.ib.3.120c

προπαρεγγυάω.definition: guarantee in advance, Anon. ap. Suid

προπαροξύνω.definition: pronounce with the acute accent on; Pass., have a premature access of fever, Gal.16.708

προπαροξύτονος.definition: with the acute on the antepenultimate, D.T.p.108 U., Theognost.Can.67. Adv. Hermog.Stat.2, Phryn.115

προπάσχω.definition: suffer first or beforehand, Hdt.7.11, Th.3.82, etc.; S.OC230 , Antipho2.1.5, Pl.R.376a; to be ill-treated before, Th.3.67; X.Mem.2.2.5: generally, to be previously affected or modified, Plu.2.725a, Plot.4.5.2

προπαύω.definition: stop a process before, . . Hp.Liqu.1:—Med., D.S.1.39, Lib.Or.2.62

προπείθω.definition: in Pass., to be persuaded beforehand, Nausiph.2, Luc.Alex.17

προπειράζω.definition: = sq., Ph.Bel.100.9; Herod. Med. ap. Orib.8.3.7

προπειράομαι.definition: Med., with aor. and pf. Pass., try or prove before, Luc.Herm.53, Vett.Val.168.1, D.C.51.11; pf. part. J.AJ9.4.4, Gal.13.861

προπεμπτήριος.definition: = sq., Him.Ecl.13 tit.; a funeral hymn, Philostr.VA3.49

προπεπαίνομαι.definition: Pass., to become concocted prematurely, Hp.Epid.4.28

προπεριειλέω.definition: wrap round first, Heliod. ap. Orib.49.9.1

προπερικαθαίρω.definition: cleanse all round before, Dsc.Eup.1.196, Aphrodas ap. Gal.12.878

προπεριξύω.definition: scrape all round first, Gal.13.379, Orib.Fr.114

προπεριπατέω.definition: take walking exercise first, Diocl.Fr.141, Antyll. ap. Orib.6.9.1, Gal.11.311

προπερισπάω.definition: circumflex the penultimate, Gal.18.518 , Sch.Ar.Eq.21, etc.; a word circumflexed on the penultimate, Hdn. Gr.1.10 . Adv. circumflexed on the penultimate, Sch.Ar.Av.1655, etc

προπεριχαράσσω.definition: incise beforehand round about, Dsc.3.80 , etc

προπετάννυμι.definition: and spread out before, X.Cyr.4.2.23; Ar.Fr.104: metaph., D.C.52.7

προπέτεια.definition: headlong haste, rashness, Isoc.5.90; prominence, of the nose, Sor.1.103; of the eyes, Gal.18.301, Aët.7.2

προπετής.definition: falling or slipping down in; inclined forward, Hp.Art.1; more prominent, ib.31; . . X.Eq.1.8; sloping, of shoulders, Gal.1.623; stooping, Arist.Phgn.807b31

πρόπηγνυμι.definition: fix beforehand, pf. imper. Pass; congealed before, Dsc.3.78

προπηδάω.definition: fut. A.Fr.23:—spring before; spring forward, D.S.17.100, Arr.Tact.12.4, App.Syr.35: c. gen., Babr.107.13; Hdn.6.9.1; J.BJ4.3.12; ib.5.7.3; Luc.Alex.13

προπηλακίζω.definition: Att. fut. Th.6.54: (apparently from; c. acc. rei, throw in one's teeth, reproach one with, Id.18.256

προπηλακισμός.definition: = foreg., Hdt.6.73; D.18.12; Aeschin.3.258: pl., Pl.Lg.855b, etc

προπιέζω.definition: compress first, v.l. for in Paul.Aeg.1.30

προπίνω.definition: take a snack before dinner, Mart.5.78.3; drink up, drain dry, Anacr.63.3: metaph., drink it in, AP5.170 :—Pass., Call.Epigr.37

προπιπίσκω.definition: aor. give to drink beforehand, Hp.Morb.2.70

προπιστεύω.definition: trust or believe beforehand, D.23.127, D.H.11.20, Ph.1.100:—Pass., X.Ages.4.4

προπιστόομαι.definition: Pass., to be made credible before, pf. S.E.P.1.116, M.8.122,261; ib.62

προπίτνω.definition: fall prostrate, A.Pers.588 ; of a suppliant, S.El.1380

προπληρόω.definition: fill before, Asclep. ap. Gal.12.586, Ph.1.603, Dsc.Alex. Praef

προπλύνω.definition: wash clean before, Dieuch. ap. Orib.4.7.30:—Pass., pf. inf. Gal.18.470; part. Dsc.2.76

προποδισμός.definition: process, progression; direct motion, of planets, pl., opp. Procl.Hyp.7.4; opp. Nicom.Ar.1.5, Alex.Aphr.in Metaph.440.7

προποιέω.definition: do before or beforehand; make beforehand, prepare, Hdt.7.44; Gal.5.833

προπολεμέω.definition: make war for or in defence of, Isoc.14.33; Plb.2.48.1, etc.; with . . for . . , D.H.6.49; Pl.R.429b, cf.OGI56.12 : abs., the guards or defenders of a country, Pl.R.423a; ib.442b, 547d, Arist.Pol.1279b3; the body inten…

προπολέμιος.definition: customary before war, D.C.46.33; Id.50.4, D.H.3.9

προπολεύω.definition: minister to, Epigr.Gr.785 , cf. Phot. s.v

προπολιόομαι.definition: Pass., grow grey before, v.l. in Diod.Cron. ap. S.E.M.10.114

προπόλιος.definition: grey-haired before his time, Poll.2.12; chaplet, dub. in Semus20

προπολιτεύομαι.definition: transact beforehand; hold chief office, Them.Or.16.205c; POxy.67.2 , PLips.37.3

προπομπεία.definition: escorting in procession, conducting; first place in a procession, IG42.66.65 , Delph.3.48.53 , Bull.Soc.Roy.Lund 1928/9 iv 17 , Hermog.Id.2.10; written Luc.Am.18

προπομπεύω.definition: go before in a procession, Posidon.36 J.; Inscr.Prien.109.215 ; before him or it, Plu.2.365b, Luc.Merc.Cond.25, Hdn.5.6.8; Jul.Or.4.154b: abs., Hdn.2.8.6; POxy.1381.19 : metaph., Iamb.Myst.2.4

προπομπή.definition: sending forward; escort, X.Ages.2.27, cf. Plb.20.11.8, Plu.Num.14; Longin.28.2

προπονέω.definition: work or labour beforehand, X.Cyr.7.5.80; work for or instead of another, X.An.3.1.37, Cyr.8.2.2

προπορεία.definition: those who go in front, advanced guard, Plb.9.5.8

προπορεύω.definition: cause to go before, Ael.NA10.22:—Pass; come forward, Plb.1.80.8, etc

προπορίζομαι.definition: Pass., to be provided beforehand, Luc.Salt.61, prob. in Cyran.43

προποτίζω.definition: present as or in a draught, of physicians; cause to drink, Gp.13.8.9; Hippiatr.1

προποτισμός.definition: = foreg., Dsc.2.160 , Heraclid.Tar. ap. Gal.11.795 , Archig. ap.eund.8.153, Hippiatr.4

προπραγματεύομαι.definition: Pass., to be written or published before, Eun.VSp.457 B.; to be worked out before, Ptol.Alm.13.7

προπρεσβεύω.definition: accomplish previously as envoy, Ephes.2 No.26

προπταίω.definition: dub. for in Luc.Ner.5; f.l. in Phalar.Ep.38.2

προπτύω.definition: spit forth or out, LXX2 Ma.6.20

πρόπτωσις.definition: fall forwards, prolapse; falling down before one, prostration, LXX2 Ma.3.21; utterance, v.l. in S.E.M.1.117

προπύλαιος.definition: before the gate, of the; gateway, entrance, of Egyptian temples, Hdt.2.63, 101, 121, etc.; on the Acropolis at Athens, IG12.92.34, 366.45, Hdt.5.77, Ar.Eq.1326, Th.2.13, D.13.28, 22.13, Aeschin.2.105, Plu.Per.13; at E…

προπυλίτης.definition: one who pursues his trade in a CIG3028.4

πρόπυλον.definition: freq. in pl., = Hdt.2.91, Hp.Epid.4.42, S.El.1375, E.HF523, etc.: in sg., IG12.891, Arist.Ath.15.4, AP6.114 , IG22.1046.13, Inscr. in PFay.p.32, Plu.2.363f, etc

προπυλών.definition: gateway of a house, POxy.243.15, 21 , Hdn.Gr.1.40

προπυνθάνομαι.definition: pf. learn by inquiring before, hear beforehand, Hdt.1.21, 5.63, 102; . . Th.4.42, etc

προπυριάω.definition: foment previously, Hp.Superf.29, al., Antyll. ap. Orib.7.9.6

προπώλης.definition: one who buys for another or negotiates a sale, broker, Ar.Fr.707a, Poll.7.12, Vett.Val.4.23

προπωλήτρια.definition: fem. of PGrenf.2.23 ii 11 , PLips.2.9 , BGU994 iii 6

πρόρρηγμα.definition: membrane enveloping the foetus, Sor.1.57, Paul.Aeg.3.76

προρρήγνυμαι.definition: to be ruptured previously, Sor.1.57: pf. part. Gal.17.131

πρόρρησις.definition: prediction, prognosis, Hp.Prog.15; previous instruction or warning, Th.1.49

προσαγανακτέω.definition: to be angry besides, Hp.Ep.17, D.H.10.24; at a thing, J.AJ4.8.2, App.BC1.46

προσαγγελία.definition: bringing of tidings, message, SIG567.8; information laid against a person, IG9.1109.87 , TAM2.487 , OGI515.20, al

προσαγγέλλω.definition: announce, bring tidings, Pl.Ep.362c; denounce, Id.Marc.2, cf. OGI483.39, 164 , Luc.Tox.32, etc.; SIG338.33 ; give oneself up to justice, Hermog.Id.2.8, cf. Inv.4.13; Plu.Cic.3:—Pass., MAMA 4.297

προσάγγελμα.definition: report, return, declaration; information laid against a person, charge, PSI4.393.1 , 2.169.8

προσαγκαλίζομαι.definition: take in one's arms, J.BJ7.9.1, Aristaenet.1.21, Poll.2.139

προσαγκυλόομαι.definition: Pass., to be fastened with a loop, HeroAut.2.11

προσαγλαΐζομαι.definition: Pass., to be adorned besides, J.BJ5.5.2

προσαγνοέω.definition: to be ignorant besides, c. acc. cogn., Thphr.HP9.4.8, cf. Arist.Ph.191b11

προσάγνυμαι.definition: Pass., break or dash against, Q.S.3.510, 14.626

προσαγοράζω.definition: buy besides, PCair.Zen.192.9 , D.S.13.84, CIG3385 , 2694b6 , etc

προσαγόρευμα.definition: appellation, name, Phld.Rh.2.239 S., D.H.Rh.5.1; of the title 'Imperator', App.BC2.44

προσαγόρευσις.definition: address, greeting, Men.381; D.H.Comp.25, cf. Epict.Ench.25.1, Plu.Fab.17, etc.; in a letter, Id.Pyrrh.6

προσαγορευτέος.definition: to be called or named; one must call, Arist.Po.1447b23, cf. Gal.5.506

προσαγορεύω.definition: Att. aor. being fut. and pf; c. dupl. acc., address or greet as so and so, A.Ch.950 ; X.Cyr.8.7.14; Plu.Aem.8:—Pass., A.Pr.834; Lat. imperator consalutatus, Plu.Pomp.8, etc

προσαγρυπνέω.definition: lie awake by, sit up over, Plu.2.1093c; Chaerem. ap. Porph.Abst.4.8; Lyd.Mag.3.10

προσαγωγεῖον.definition: carpenter's or stonemason's square, Pl.Phlb.56c , IG7.3073.118, 139

προσαγωγεύς.definition: introducer, one who; talebearer, hence 'agent provocateur' of tyrants, Plu.2.522f:—hence fem. Dor. Arist.Pol.1313b13

προσαγωγή.definition: bringing to, for; bringing up, Plb.1.48.2 , 14.10.9 ; much like our phrase 'to make approaches', Id.9.41.1

προσαγωνίζομαι.definition: contend besides, with one, Philostr.Her.4.2, cf. Poll.3.141

προσαδικέω.definition: do one a further wrong; wrong another person besides, Hld.2.5

προσᾴδω.definition: sing to, to thee will I sing; sing the songs in a tragedy, Ar.Eq.401; Aristaenet.1.2; Ael.VH14.23; dub. in IG5.528

προσαιρέομαι.definition: Med., choose and associate with; choose in addition to, X.HG6.2.39; ib.2.1.16

προσαΐσσω.definition: Att. spring or rush to, Od.22.337,342,365; a cloud comes over my eyes, A.Pr.145 ; in Prose, of flames, Aen.Tact.34.2; also of persons, ChioEp.13.1

προσαιτέω.definition: ask besides, Pi.Fr.177.6; demand or require for a purpose, . . Id.Vect.4.39

προσαίτης.definition: beggar, Ev.Marc.10.46, Gal.13.636, Porph.Antr.34, dub.l. in Plu.2.294a, Luc.Nav.24:—fem. Suid

προσαιωρέομαι.definition: Med., raise oneself, by or on one's lance, D.S.33.7

προσακούω.definition: hear besides, X.HG3.4.1; as Pass. of to be addressed in such terms, ib.2.4.22, cf. Plu.2.71e, 812e; I am called . . , J.BJ1.26.2

προσακριβόω.definition: strengthd. for Arist. ap. D.L.5.28 , Str.15.1.14

προσαλαζονεύω.definition: play the braggart besides, Hsch. s.v

προσαλίσκομαι.definition: to be cast in a lawsuit besides, Ar.Ach.701

προσάλλομαι.definition: jump up at, X.Cyr.8.4.20, Arist.HA612a11, Str.16.4.19, Plu.2.977c; of a wind, Arist.Mu.395a7; of the heart, Ruf.Syn.Puls.3.6

προσαλλοτριόομαι.definition: Pass., to be alienated or averse from, Phld.Ir.p.84 W.; opp. S.E.M.7.140

προσαμέλγομαι.definition: Dor. Pass., yield milk besides, Theoc.1.26

προσαμπέχω.definition: veil besides, Chaerem.14.8:—Pass., remain held or entangled in, AP12.93

προσαμφιέννυμι.definition: Att. fut. put on over, Ar.Eq.891

προσαναβαίνω.definition: fut. X.Eq.Mag.1.2:—go up, or; c. acc. loci, climb, ascend, Pl.Com.79

προσανάβασις.definition: poet. going up, ascent, LXXJo.15.3, Bacch. ap. Apollon.Cit.1 ; a ladder's means of ascent, A.Th.466, E.Ph.1173; ib.489, Ba.1213; place where they may be approached, Id.Ph.744; steps leading to the house, Id.IT97

προσαναβιβρώσκω.definition: corrode, in Pass., Gal. ap; use a gargle afterwards, Heraclid.Tar. ap. Gal.12.984

προσαναγκάζω.definition: force or constrain besides, Th.7.18; increase the severity of exercises, Id.Vict.3.68; of military training, Th.6.72

προσαναγράφω.definition: record or enter besides; prescribe as well, Sor.2.65

προσανάγω.definition: Dor. carry up to; seemingly intr., come up to, approach, f.l. for in Plu.2.564c; approached the land, Id.Pyrrh.15

προσαναδίδωμι.definition: distribute or give out besides, Plb.10.14.3; Plu.2.241f

προσαναζητέω.definition: search out besides, Decr. ap. Arist.Ath.29.3

προσαναιδεύομαι.definition: act impudently besides, Ar.Eq.397 as misquoted by Suid. s.v

προσαναιρέω.definition: lift up besides:—Med., take upon oneself; destroy besides, Arist.EN1172b1, cf. APr.62a3

προσαναισιμόομαι.definition: Pass., to be spent besides, Hdt.5.34

προσανακαθαίρω.definition: purify in addition, aor. part. Med. Plot.6.7.29

προσανάκειμαι.definition: Pass., lie hard by, Sch.Il.15.740; to be wholly given up or devoted to, Plu.2.314b

προσανακεράννυμαι.definition: Pass., to be mixed up, Ael.NA14.4

προσανάκλιμα.definition: that on which one leans, AP7.407

προσανακλίνω.definition: lean against, of elephants, Agatharch.55:—Pass., lean on, D.S.17.41, Paus.10.30.6; of a city, Str.14.1.43

προσανακόπτω.definition: beat up in addition, Damocr. ap. Gal.13.823

προσανακουφίζω.definition: hold up, save from falling besides, J.Vit.18

προσαναλαμβάνω.definition: take in or receive besides; use besides, Thphr.HP5.7.7

προσαναλέγω.definition: collect besides, Ael.NA4.39:—Pass; Med., recount besides, LXX2 Ma.8.19

προσαναλίσκω.definition: fut. lavish or consume besides, Pl.Prt.311d; D.20.10, cf. D.C.43.18; IG22.834.7; waste further time on . . , D.L.6.98; Porph.Abst.1.56

προσανάλλομαι.definition: leap up at a thing, Ath.7.277f

προσαναλύω.definition: break up as well, Steph.in Hp.1.104 D

προσαναμείγνυμι.definition: mix with as well, in Pass., Gal.18.155

προσαναμιμνήσκω.definition: remind of, Plb.4.28.6, al.: abs., Id.4.29.7:—Med. with aor. 1 Pass., mention, record as well, Gal.8.904, 18.434

προσανανεόομαι.definition: Med., recall afresh to memory, Plb.8.37.2

προσαναξηραίνω.definition: dry up besides, Herod.Med. ap. Orib.5.30.12

προσαναξύω.definition: scrape off besides, Antyll. ap. Orib.44.23.4

προσαναπαύω.definition: cause to rest also or beside; Med. or Pass., sleep beside, Nicostr. ap. Stob.4.23.65

προσαναπίπτω.definition: recline by or with others at meals, Plb.30.26.6

προσαναπλάσσω.definition: Att. mould upon; invent besides, . . S.E.M.11.158; ascribe, Ph.1.226, al.; Eust.1387.22 ; Gal.17.257:—Pass., Longin.7.1, Corn.ND34, Palaeph.15

προσαναπληρόω.definition: fill up, replenish besides, Arist.Pol.1256b3, cf. D.S.5.71; LXXWi.19.4; 2 Ep.Cor.9.12, cf. Ph.2.444; A.D.Pron.3.7:—Med., add so as to fill up, Pl.Men.84d

προσαναπτύσσω.definition: Att. fold back, hence, open out, further, Gal.14.787:—Pass., to be folded back upon, Arist.HA549b2

προσαναρρήγνυμι.definition: lacerate in addition, Plu.Crass.25; i.e. caused haemorrhage, Id.Cleom.30: metaph., let them break out, Ph.2.372, cf. 479

προσαναρριπίζω.definition: fan or blow up besides, ib.442

προσαναρτάω.definition: hang upon, Luc.Philops.11: metaph., attach, connect, in Pass., Phld.Ir.p.80 W

προσανασείω.definition: shake up or about besides, Hp.Art.4: metaph., to be roused still further, Plb.1.69.8; f.l. for in Plu.TG21

προσαναστέλλω.definition: hold in, get under control, Plu.Alex.6; mould an infant's nostrils, Sor.1.103

προσανατείνω.definition: strain tight beside; lift up, Aristaenet.1.15, 2.2

προσανατέμνω.definition: cut off as well, Ph.2.128; incise as well, Gal.10.391

προσανατενίζω.definition: gaze at, c. dat., Tim.Gaz. ap. Ar.Byz.Epit.103.27

προσανατίθημι.definition: offer or dedicate besides; ascribe, Porph. ap. Eus.PE3.11

προσανατρέφω.definition: build up, restore by food, D.S.1.43, cf. Cic.Att.6.1.2

προσανατρέχω.definition: run back, retrace past events, Plb.5.31.8; Id.1.12.8, etc

προσανατρίβω.definition: rub upon or against; rub as well, Cleopatra ap. Gal.12.404; massage as well, Sor.1.103

προσαναφέρω.definition: make a supplementary declaration; report, Aristeas29, PGrenf.1.11 ii 8 , UPZ119.47 , etc.:—Pass., Aristeas30

προσαναφλέγω.definition: light up, kindle besides, ib.451: metaph., Id.2.240

προσαναχρώννυμαι.definition: Med., communicate by contact; associate closely with, ib.51f, 490d, 672f, 754c; follow, imitate closely, ib.740f

προσάνειμι.definition: go up to, Th.7.44, D.C.56.13; a city lying on an ascent, Poll.9.20

προσανερωτάω.definition: ask or inquire further, . . Pl.Men.74c, cf. Ruf.Interrog.3, Gal.11.188

προσανευρίσκω.definition: find out besides, Str.15.1.22, Iamb.in Nic.p.101 P.:—Pass., Theo Sm.p.52 H

προσανευρύνω.definition: dilate further, in Pass., Sor.1.10, Heliod. ap. Orib.50.9.13

προσανέχω.definition: wait, . . Plb.4.19.12, cf. 3.94.3: c; rely on, place one's dependence on, Id.5.72.2, cf.4.60.8, J.AJ10.6.2, BJ4.2.1, Heliod. in PMed.Lond.155.4.5; Plb.1.84.12

προσανθέω.definition: flower beside, shine beside, c. dat., Philostr.Im.2.5; add lustre to, ib.8, 1.29; Dam.Isid.74

προσανίημι.definition: fut. send up in addition; slacken, lower the pitch of besides, Plu.2.1145d

προσανιμάω.definition: draw up water besides, dub. in Aristid.1.155 J

προσανίσταμαι.definition: Pass., rise and press against; rise in insurrection, in aor.2, D.C.39.54 codd

προσανοιδέω.definition: swell up besides, Herod.Med. ap. Orib.6.20.12

προσανοικοδομέομαι.definition: Pass., to be added for edification, LXXSi.3.14

προσανοιμώζω.definition: moan or sigh at a thing, Plb.5.16.4

προσαντεπιτάσσω.definition: issue an order against in return, D.C.38.43

προσαντέχω.definition: hold out against still longer, Plb.16.30.5; cf

προσαντιβάλλω.definition: collate a document, Sammelb.6298.9 , BGU525.6 , POxy.2131.3

προσαντιλαμβάνομαι.definition: Med., take hold of one another, by the hands, Str.3.3.7

προσαντλέω.definition: draw and pour upon, Dsc.4.64 ; bathe, foment, Herod.Med. ap. Orib.10.37.11, Antyll. ap. eund.9.23.11

προσαξιόω.definition: demand besides, Plb.3.11.7, 18.8.5; c. inf., ask one also to do a thing, PCair.Zen.440.6 , PHamb.25.8 , Arch.Pap.3.134 , cf. LXX3 Ma.7.10

προσαπάγω.definition: lead off to prison or captivity; bring, render in addition, Inscr.Magn.73a22

προσαπαιτέω.definition: require or ask besides, Thphr.CP1.16.12, D.H.Dem.43, Plu.2.177e, Luc.Tyr.13, Alciphr.1.2, Chor.inRev.Phil.1.81

προσαπαντάω.definition: go to meet, Philostr.VA4.5; c. acc., reach, of a probe, Antyll. ap. Orib.44.20.31

προσαπειλέω.definition: threaten besides, Test. ap. D.21.93:—Pass., v.l. in LXXSi.13.3

προσαπεργάζομαι.definition: finish off, complete besides, App.Mith.13, cf. Archig. ap. Gal.12.410

προσαπερείδομαι.definition: Pass., press forcibly against, Arist.Pr.937b36; lean on, A.D.Synt.131.9: metaph., rely mainly upon, Plb.3.21.3

προσαπέχω.definition: pf. inf. to have received in addition, POxy.510.21

προσαποβάλλω.definition: throw away or lose besides, f.l. for in Ar.Nu.1256; Plb.33.5.4; Plu.Nic.5; X.Mem.3.6.7

προσαποβλέπω.definition: turn one's eyes and look at, Ath.5.180b

προσαπογράφω.definition: denounce besides, Lys.13.[31], 56; register besides, BGU52.5 , etc.:—Med., they shall register besides the name of their native city, SIG1023.41

προσαποδείκνυμι.definition: prove, demonstrate besides; appoint besides, . . OGI56.23 ; Inscr.Prien.42.17 ; D.C.54.10, etc.; Str.7.7.12

προσαποδιδράσκω.definition: aor. inf. run away besides, D.C.50.33

προσαποδίδωμι.definition: pay as a debt besides; Med., sell besides, Plb.31.22.4

προσαπόδοσις.definition: a Rhet. figure, by which when two or more statements follow one another, the reason for each is given after each statement, or after the whole series, Quint.Inst.9.3.94, Rutil.1.1

προσαποδύομαι.definition: Med., put off as well, Plu.2.139d

προσαποθνῄσκω.definition: die besides or with, LXXEx.21.29, D.C.53.9

προσαπόκειμαι.definition: to be stored up as well, dub.in Aristid.Or.50 .49

προσαποκρέμαμαι.definition: Pass., to be suspended from as well, Procop.Pers.1.1

προσαποκρίνομαι.definition: answer with some addition, Pl.Euthd.296a, cf. Arist.SE175b11

προσαπολαμβάνω.definition: catch, take up as well, Hp.Art.11; receive besides, dub. in Jul.Or.7.228b

προσαπολαύω.definition: reap, share in besides, D.H.6.58; Jul.Or.7.228b : c. acc., Com.Adesp.1311; gain something different besides, Pl.Alc.2.150c

προσαπόλλυμι.definition: destroy; lose besides, Hdt.1.207, cf. 9.23, Ar.Nu.1256; Pl.Grg.519a

προσαποξέω.definition: erase, expunge as well: metaph., Lib.Decl.43.45

προσαποπέμπω.definition: send away or off besides, Ar.Pl.999

προσαπορέω.definition: propose a further difficulty, Arist.Pol.1275b39, Jul.Or.5.171d, Dexipp.in Cat.42.32, Iamb.Myst.4.5

προσαποσείω.definition: in Med., close one's ears in addition, dub. in Ph.1.384

προσαποσκευάζομαι.definition: Med., make away with also, J.BJ4.5.4

προσαποστέλλω.definition: send off or dispatch besides, Th.4.108, PSI4.410.25 , LXX2 Ma.11.14

προσαποστερέω.definition: defraud or deprive of besides, D.21.67 , cf. Lib.Or.17.6

προσαποτιμάω.definition: estimate besides, the value of which he set at more . ., D.41.27

προσαποτίνω.definition: fut. pay besides, Pl.Lg.945a, cf. PEleph.1.11 , Abh. Berl.Akad.1925.29 ; Men.235.9; Dius ap.J.AJ8.5.3; opp. Hyp.Eux.17

προσαποφαίνω.definition: show or prove besides, Pl.Plt.287a:—Med., Arist.Metaph.1089b16, Plu.2.152b

προσαποφέρω.definition: carry off besides, Posidon.10J; return as well, :—Pass., was returned besides as liable to taxation, D.50.8

προσαποχρώννυμαι.definition: Pass., to be coloured besides, HeroAut.30.6

προσαράσσω.definition: Att. dash against, D.S.34/5.2.12; J.AJ14.13.10; slam the door in one's face, Luc.DMeretr.15.2, Nav.22; esp. of shipwreck, Plu.Marc.15; Luc.VH2.47; D.C.48.47; wreck them, Philostr.VA4.32; shatter, Iamb.Myst.6.5:— Pass.…

προσάρδω.definition: water or irrigate besides, v.l. in J.BJ3.3.4

προσαρθρόομαι.definition: Pass., to be attached by joints, Hp.Art.45

προσαριθμέω.definition: pay in to the bank in addition; reckon among, J.AJ7.12.4; reckon in as well, Plot.1.5.6:—Pass., Str.17.1.54, Plu.2.1029d

προσαρκέω.definition: give aid, succour, assist, S.OT141; ib.12; Id.OC72; Id.Fr.524.2: abs., E.Hec.862:—Pass., to be satisfied, c. part., Longin. ap. Porph.Plot.20

προσαρμόζω.definition: later Att. fit to, attach; metaph., adapt, Pl.Cra.414d; Id.Phdr.271b; Plu.2.52b; set measures, Pl.Lg.669c

προσαρτάω.definition: fasten or attach to; metaph. in Pass., belong to, Pl.Phlb.58a; X.Oec.6.15; D.5.12; devoted to . . , Luc.Nec.5; . . hanging on, Plu.Tim.11; Id.Pomp.46, cf. M.Ant.12.3, etc

προσαρτής.definition: attached, opp. Antyll. ap. Orib.45.2.2, cf. 45.17.6, Leonid. ap. Aët.15.5

προσάρχομαι.definition: offer, present, Pl.Tht.168c: so perh. . . paid him the tributes due to an athlete , Th.4.121

προσασκέω.definition: exercise besides, Plb.5.109.4:— Pass., Ph.1.657 ; of land, to be cultivated, J.BJ3.3.2

προσαστεΐζομαι.definition: add wittily to one's words, Plb.Fr.208

προσασχολέομαι.definition: to be engaged in, c. dat., Simp.in Epict.p.19 D

προσαυαίνομαι.definition: Pass., to be dried or wither away upon, A.Pr.147 , cf. Hp.Mul.2.137

προσαυγάζω.definition: look towards, Lyc.1082, cf; c. dat., shine upon, J.AJ12.2.9

προσαυλέω.definition: perform on the flute, Ar.Ec.892, Plu.Demetr.53: abs., Arist.Aud.801b18; accompany in unison, Id.Pr.921a26; Plu.2.632c:— Pass., ib.1140d

προσαυξάνω.definition: and increase, enhance, promote; add, . . SIG399.32 :—Pass., to be added, Philet.3

προσαύξησις.definition: additional growth, Gal.2.744; successive increase in size of vertebrae, Gal.UP13.7

προσαυτουργέω.definition: make with one's own hands besides, Them.Or.26.319a

προσαφαιρέω.definition: take away besides; Pass. in Gramm., suffer further aphaeresis , A.D.Adv.158.17

προσαφικνέομαι.definition: arrive and join a force, Th.8.30; approach, cj. in AP12.185

προσαφίστημι.definition: cause to revolt besides, Th.4.117; Pass., become separated from, c. gen., Heliod. ap. Orib.46.22.5, Archig.ib.46.26.3

προσαφοδεύω.definition: void excrement at one, Arist.HA630b9, Mir.830a18

προσαφορίζω.definition: determine and assign besides, Gal.6.816:— Pass., Epist.Antig. in SIG 344.99

προσβαθύνω.definition: make still deeper, Heliod. ap. Orib.46.11.9

προσβακχεύω.definition: send Bacchic rage upon one, Philostr.Im.1.18

προσβασανίζω.definition: torture besides, Posidon.36 J. cod.A Ath

προσβιάζομαι.definition: compel, constrain, Ar.Pl.16; force or storm heights, D.S.20.39: aor. Pass. to be forced or hard pressed, Th.1.106

προσβιβάζω.definition: Att.fut. Ar.Av.426; liken, make to resemble, Plu.Pomp.46

προσβιόω.definition: live longer or after, Plu.Num.21, cf. Luc.43, Phalar.Ep.103.3

πρόσβλεψις.definition: looking at or upon, Plu.2.45c: Dor. aspect, appearance, Diotog. ap. Stob.4.7.62

προσβοήθεια.definition: support, aid, prob. in Dosith.p.397 K

προσβοηθέω.definition: Ion. come to aid, abs., Th.2.25, cf. 6.66, 69, etc.; with ten ships . . , Id.8.23; v.l. in X.HG1.3.5; v.l. in Hdt.8.144; Th.1.50

προσβράσσω.definition: throw up, dash against, in Pass., Plu.2.675e, cf. Zen.4.38, Hsch. s.v

προσγειτνιάω.definition: to be neighbouring, of land, PTeb.441

προσγελάω.definition: fut. Ar.Pax600:—smile at one; greet. the senses, A.Eu.253; S.Ichn.291; Eub.109, cf. Diph.33.5

προσγενής.definition: akin, as Subst., kinsman, PTeb.380.10 , PStrassb.42.12 , Suid. s.v. abs., Eust.410.38

προσγίγνομαι.definition: Ion. and later attach; become in addition, Id.R.375e

προσγιγνώσκω.definition: learn in addition, the land of which it has since become known that . . , PLond.3.604.8

προσγλίχομαι.definition: desire eagerly besides, . . Arist.Metaph.986a7; desire in addition to, ib.1090b31

προσγραφή.definition: enrolment, Milet.3 No.143; adscription of i.e. written but not pronounced, Eust.1409.47

πρόσγραφος.definition: added to a list, = Lat; Subst., note or bill of the price, Plu.2.832a: generally, supplementary document, POxy. 513.34 , BGU457.1 , etc

προσγράφω.definition: Dor. Berl.Sitzb.1927.8; add to a list of persons, enrol, register, Plu.Publ.21, Num.8; Philostr.VA1.33:—Med., cause to be registered besides, Is.10.2, D.22.71; register, enrol oneself, IG12.821.11 , cf. 825.26 , SIG64…

προσγυμνάζω.definition: exercise at or in a thing; metaph. in Med., enter into a contest with, D.Chr.36.27: abs., M.Ant.6.20

προσδανείζω.definition: lend besides, PFlor.81.1 :—Med., borrow besides, X.An.7.5.5, Lys.19.55; that he had also borrowed from his friends, ib.26

προσδαπανάω.definition: spend besides, IG22.949.10, 1227.8, Ev.Luc.10.35, Luc.Ep.Sat.39:—Med., Them.Or.23.289b

προσδαψιλεύομαι.definition: spend lavishly besides, v.l. for in Ph.2.66

προσδεκτέος.definition: to be admitted, by one; one must receive, admit, Din.1.92, Plu.2.134e; one must accept, Heliod. ap. Orib.48.70.7

πρόσδεσις.definition: tying on or to, Gloss; attachment of a limb, Heliod. ap. Orib.49.25.10

προσδεσμεύω.definition: bind on or to, D.S.4.59; Iamb.Protr.8; Sch.Ar.V.580 :—Pass., Aët.6.35

πρόσδετος.definition: tied to a thing; fixed, Heliod. ap. Orib.49.2.3

προσδιαβάλλω.definition: insinuate besides; bring into greater disfavour, Plu.Alc.28, cf. Fab.7; increase the feeling of . . against, Id.Cor.27; Id.Per.29

προσδιαγράφω.definition: Dor. Supp.Epigr.3.674.47 :—pay in addition, PFay.14.4 :—Pass., additional payments, Ostr.Strassb.55 , PFay.36.16 , etc

προσδιαιρέω.definition: Med., divide or distinguish further, . . Arist.Rh.1414a19; ib.1369a7; subdivide an estate, CPR206.13

προσδιακρίνω.definition: decide as well, A.D.Synt.5.26; distinguish in addition, ib.236.12:—Pass., ib.36.5

προσδιαλαμβάνω.definition: consider as well, dub. in Epicur.Nat.Herc.996; after a suitable declaration on the subject has been made, BGU1060.30

προσδιαλέγομαι.definition: answer in conversation or disputation; simply, hold converse with, Pl.Lg.887e; negotiate with, PSI4.344.3,7

προσδιανέμω.definition: distribute besides, Plu.Cat. Ma.10:—Med., divide among themselves besides, D.19.168, Plu.Demetr.30

προσδιανίσταμαι.definition: Pass., stand near: metaph., exercise vigilance over one, Simp.in Epict.p.31 D

προσδιασαφέω.definition: explain further, proceed to explain, Sammelb.7267.8 , FAmh.2.31.14 , Plb.3.24.15, Hipparch.2.4.5, Str.10.1.2, Apollon. Cit.3, Plu.2.22b, A.D.Synt.184.23, al., S.E.M.7.114

προσδιαστέλλω.definition: distend further, Aret.CA1.4; add a further condition, in Med., Posidon.8 J

προσδιαστρέφω.definition: pervert besides, of persons, Plu.2.61b , 697d; also ib.1083b

προσδιασύρω.definition: satirize or ridicule besides, v.l. for

προσδιατάσσω.definition: Att. ordain besides, J.AJ4.8.41; add a clause to a will, POxy.494.26 :— Med., Ph.2.399, f.l. in Aen.Tact.16.16

προσδιατρίβω.definition: have intercourse with; spend some time longer in A.. PCair.Zen. 217.2 , cf. Lib.Or.31.13

προσδιαφέρομαι.definition: Pass., differ besides, Procl.in Alc.p.265 C

προσδιαφθείρω.definition: destroy besides, S.Ph.76, cf; corrupt, spoil besides, PCair Zen.484.16 ; Sor.1.53; Gal. ap. Orib.51.36.2; cause abortion of the existing foetus as well, Hp.Vict.1.31

προσδιαφορέω.definition: act also as a diaphoretic, Antyll. ap. Orib.9.24.7

προσδιδάσκω.definition: teach besides, Pl.Chrm.173d; Men.553.4:—Pass., Ph.2.473 codd

προσδίδωμι.definition: give or pay in addition; give a share of, E.Cyc.531; Ar.Eq.1222; E.Hel.700; esp. dole out, of a sacrificing priest, Plu.Crass.19; Ar.Pax1111, cf.955 ; . . give him some of the health- offering, Herod.4.94: hence, dole…

προσδιεγγυάω.definition: give additional security for, UPZ 112 vi8

προσδιέρχομαι.definition: pass through besides, Hp.Prorrh.1.92; describe, treat of besides, Plu.Them.28, 2.362e

προσδιίστημι.definition: separate, dilate, widen further, Antyll. ap. Orib.6.10.14; Sor.1.46

προσδικάζω.definition: award as a judge, D.H.11.52; Med., make a further claim in a suit, D.37.32

προσδιοικέω.definition: settle business besides, PCair.Zen.361.37; manage besides, D.C.51.18

προσδιορθόω.definition: correct, set right as well; Med., pay up, make good in addition, PEleph. 14.10 , cf. 20.60 , CIG2693e.11

προσδιορίζω.definition: define, specify besides, D.20.130; Med., maintain besides, Plb.32.3.10, cf.Plu.Nic.7

προσδιορισμός.definition: further definition, determination; further condition in a problem, Dioph.1.14,5.10

προσδοκάω.definition: Ion. (which is sts. found as; c. inf. pres., think, suppose that one is doing or that a thing is, E.Alc.1091, Pl.Lg.803e, X.An.6.1.16: c. inf. pf., think that a thing has been . . , Pl.Plt.275a

προσδοκέω.definition: aor. to be thought besides, c. inf., D.22.75, 24.183

προσδοκία.definition: looking for, expectation, whether in; c. gen., Pl.La.198b, Ti.70c; Arist.PA669a21; Id.EN1115a9: in good sense, X.Cyr.1.6.19 ; D.18.281; Pl.Smp.194a; i.e. the fulfilment of the expectations raised, Aeschin.2.178

προσδόκιμος.definition: expected, looked for, or to be; freq. of persons, expected, Id.1.78; expected to come to Cyprus, against Miletus, Id.5.108, 6.6; Id.9.89; Th.1.14; Id.7.15, cf. D.6.15; D.S.18.64. Adv. Gloss

προσδοξάζω.definition: add to opinion, Pl.Tht.209d; import into judgement an element additional to sense-impression, Epicur.Ep.1pp.12, 19 U. . Nat.10 G

πρόσδοσις.definition: additional donation, PSI9.904.2 (i; f.l. for in Hierocl.p.63A

προσδουλεύω.definition: to be a slave besides, Gloss

προσδυσκολαίνω.definition: to be refractory towards one, Plu.2.818a

προσεάω.definition: suffer to go further; permit as well, PLond.5.1790.7

προσεγγελάω.definition: laugh at, v.l. for in Aesop.330

προσεγγίζω.definition: bring near, Luc.Am.53; intr., approach, AP7.422 , Philum.Ven.12.1; D.S.3.16; Herod.Med. ap. Orib.5.30.9; Sch.E.Hec.585: abs., Plb.38.7.4, Ezek.Exag.96:—Med., Sch.E.Hec.439; c.acc., Cat.Cod.Astr.1.157

προσεγγράφω.definition: carve on, or inscribe, besides; add a saving or limiting clause, Aeschin.3.203

προσεγγυάομαι.definition: Med., become surety besides, become his surety also for the sum owed, D.31.11, cf. Aristid.2.204 J

προσεγείρω.definition: lift up, Philostr.Gym.35; stimulate, excite, ib.55, cf. VS2.9.2; cf

προσεγκαλέω.definition: accuse besides, . . D.S.14.17; . . D.C.41.6: c. dat. et part., Plu.2.401b: abs., Alex.146.8, D.H.7.46, Gal.UP5.4: prov., 'Satan rebuking sin', Lib.Ep.1134.1

προσεγκελεύομαι.definition: Med., exhort besides; play a rousing tune, Id.Aem.33

προσεγχέω.definition: pour in besides, Arist.GA753a20, Diph.17.10; Arist.Pr.961a25; Plu.2.149b:—Med., cause to be poured in, Arist.Pr.961a18:—Pass., Id.GA723a19, Aret.CA2.5

προσεγχρίω.definition: besmear besides or once more, AP11.117 , cf. Ph.2.454

προσεδαφίζω.definition: the shield is made fast or solid all round with wreathed snakes, A.Th.496

προσεδρεύω.definition: sit near, wait or watch beside; besiege, Plb.8.7.11

πρόσεδρος.definition: sitting near, cj. for; assiduous, Hsch

προσεθίζω.definition: accustom or inure one to a thing, X.Ap.25: c. acc. et inf., Id.Cyr.8.1.36, Eq.Mag.1.17, Gal.16.142:—Pass., accustom oneself to a thing, X.Lac.2.4, cf. Ael.Tact.35.6: c. inf., Luc.Dem.Enc.17

προσεικάζω.definition: aor. make like, assimilate; I am not able to guess by comparison, ib.163 ; conjecture in addition, Str.3.5.8

πρόσειμι εἰμί.definition: sum), to be added to, Hdt.2.99; abs., to be present, at hand as well, . . A.Ag.558; S.Ph.129; . . Id.Ant.720; Id.Tr.251; Ar.Av.1315 ; . . D.1.27; there was nothing else in the world, Id.21.176; this too will be ours, …

προσείρομαι.definition: Med., in fut. ask besides, Hsch

προσεισάγω.definition: bring in besides, J.BJ5.1.3 , cf. D.L.9.88:—Med., Arg.D.46:—Pass., Gal.9.432

προσεισέρχομαι.definition: come in as well, PCair.Zen.730.1 , Simp.in Cat.156.29

προσεισκρίνω.definition: introduce in addition into a vessel, HeroSpir.1 Prooem.:—Pass., ibid

προσεισπράσσω.definition: exact besides, OGI335.134 : c. dupl. acc., Plu.Alc.8, cf. PCair.Zen.91.5 :—Pass., ib.283.3 , PRev.Laws52.10

προσεισφέρω.definition: contribute besides, Herm.Hist.2; propose in addition for election, ib.5 .1390.126

προσείω.definition: hold out and shake, shake it threateningly, E.HF1218; wave it up and down, Id.Ba.930; Ael.VH12.23; wave a bough before cattle, so as to lead them on, Pl.Phdr.230d; Ael.NA1.29; and metaph., hold them out as a bait, ib.…

προσεκβάλλω.definition: cast out besides, D.21.122, Plu.CG14; draw out further, produce, Str.2.1.37:—Pass., Cleom.2.1, Gal.UP10.12

προσεκβοάω.definition: call out at the same time, D.C.44.20, Paul.Aeg.3.15

προσεκδιδάσκω.definition: strengthd. for D.C.Fr.6.6, v.l. in J.AJ17.6.1

προσεκδίδωμι.definition: give out by contract as well, SIG245 i 21, 67 ; let on lease as well, GDI5661.35

προσεκκαίω.definition: set fire to besides, D.C.62.17: metaph., inflame or provoke besides, Phld.Lib.p.21 O.; Plu.2.60e; Id.Cleom.2; Porph.Abst.2.41:—Pass., S.E.M.11.179; J.BJ3.9.6

προσέκκειμαι.definition: to be announced, set forth in addition, dub.l. in PLille 4.15

προσεκκόπτω.definition: extirpate besides, Telesp.59 H.; f.l. for in Lib.Ep.1385.5

προσεκλεαίνω.definition: triturate as well, Dsc.2.171, Archig ap.Gal.12.793

προσεκλέγω.definition: pull out besides, Telesp.60 H.; Ph.2.596:—Med., select besides, Plb.6.24.2

προσεκλύω.definition: relax or weaken the more, Plu.2.143d; f.l. for in J.AJ15.7.1

προσεκπίπτω.definition: fall out besides, of sinews mortifying, Hp.Fract.27: metaph., Longin.15.8

προσεκπληρόω.definition: fill up an aperture, ib.68; make up to the full amount, Mon.Anc.Gr. 19.10

προσεκπυρόω.definition: set on fire besides, metaph., Luc.Tox.15

προσεκταράσσω.definition: stir up still more, ib.463f, D.C.61.8

προσεκτίθημι.definition: exhibit or post up publicly in addition, Sammelb.7337.35 :—Med., set forth besides, Nicom.Harm.11, Iamb.in Nic.p.38P

προσεκτίνω.definition: fut. Plu.Arat.54:—pay in addition, Pl.Lg.934a; Plu.Phoc.27; Id.Arat.l.c.; BGU1113.21 ; Chor.p.246B

προσεκφέρω.definition: Pass., to be carried too far, of runners, Chrysipp.Stoic.3.127

προσελαύνω.definition: Att. fut. X.Cyr.6.2.18: aor. 1; ride towards, ride up, Hdt.7.208, cf. 9.20, X.Cyr.4.2.17; ib.1.4.23; also Hdt.9.44, X.HG4.5.7, cf. Cyr.1.4.17; ib.6.2.18; opp. , Id.An.6.3.7

προσέλευσις.definition: approach, Antyll. ap. Orib.6.33.4, Gp.9.4.4, Procl.in Prm.p.655S., Phlp.in GA178.31; approach, access to . . , Judeich Altertümer von HierapolisNo. 336.16

προσέληνος.definition: before the moon, older than; the days before the new moon appears, Gp.1.6.2

προσέλκω.definition: draw towards, draw on, prob. l. in Pi.O.6.83; Com.Adesp.139; . . wrest the facts . . , Arist.Cael.293a27:—Med., draw towards oneself, attract, Thgn.372; Pl.R.439b: aor. take into one's arms, embrace, E.Hipp.1432, IA14…

προσελλείπω.definition: to be still wanting, fail by the whole length of the course, of a very slow runner, AP11.85 ; the sums still wanting, D.S.20.101, cf. IG4.4.9

προσελπίζω.definition: hope besides, Anon. ap. Suid. s.v. Petr.Patr.p.433D

προσεμβαίνω.definition: step upon, trample on; step into, enter, Dsc.5.11

προσεμβάλλω.definition: throw or put into besides, Pl.Cra.439c; intr., go into besides, Plu.2.751f

προσεμβατεύω.definition: continue dalliance, prob. cj. for in Aristaenet.2.22

προσεμπάσσω.definition: sprinkle upon besides, Dsc.2.76.6, cf. Ruf. ap. Orib.8.47.11

προσεμπικραίνομαι.definition: Pass., to be yet more angry with, Hdt.3.146

προσεμπίπρημι.definition: set on fire besides, LXXEx.22.6, J.BJ3.7.36:—Pass., of ulcers, become still further inflamed, Aret.SA1.9

προσεμπλάσσω.definition: mix in an ingredient as well, Aët.12.67

προσεμπολάω.definition: gain by traffic besides, Phot., Suid

προσεμφαίνομαι.definition: appear to be in a thing, Arist.Mech.847b24, cf. Iamb.in Nic.p.72 P

προσεμφανίζω.definition: Att. fut. Ph.Bel.72.6:—make clear further, Phld.Mus.p.107 K.; testify besides, J.AJ8.7.3

προσεμφερής.definition: resembling, Hdt.4.2, cf. E.Fr.382.13, X.Smp.4.19, Arist.HA629a31, Thphr.HP3.10.1, al., Epicur.Ep.1p.19U. . Adv. D.S.24.3

προσεμφορέω.definition: put in or into in addition, Plu.2.168a, cf. 547c

προσεμφράσσω.definition: Att. block up besides, Gal.6.263, cf.15.633

προσεμφυσιόω.definition: impress in addition upon a person, UPZ110.69

προσεναλείφω.definition: smear in in addition, Philum. ap. Aët.5.78 , cj. in Sor.1.122

προσενδαψιλεύομαι.definition: Med., give into the bargain, Ph.1.514

προσενδείκνυμαι.definition: Med., indicate besides, D.C.59.13,71.32, Simp.in Epict.p.33 D

προσενέχομαι.definition: Pass, to be holden by, in the grip of, LXX2 Ma.5.18

προσεννέπω.definition: impf. Pi.P.4.97, 9.29:—address; c. acc. et inf., entreat or command, Pi.I.6.17

προσεννοέω.definition: think of, observe besides, cj. in X.Smp.2.16, cf. Arist.de An.430b1; . . Plu.2.640e; understand in addition, Simp.in Epict.p.58 D

προσεξερείδομαι.definition: Med., aor. inf. support oneself by, Plb.3.55.4

προσεξέρχομαι.definition: come out to meet: metaph., Ph.1.215

προσεξετάζω.definition: examine or search into besides, D.21.227 , 24.69, Gal.6.723, Luc.Tyr.11

προσεπαίρω.definition: raise besides, Sor.1.102:—metaph. in Pass., to be encouraged yet more, Arr.An.4.5.4, cf. D.C.48.21

προσεπαυρίσκομαι.definition: Pass., to be attacked by disease besides, Hp.Morb.4.51

προσεπεισφέρω.definition: = foreg., Longin.9.12; contribute in addition, Poll.5.140

προσεπεύχομαι.definition: pray besides, c. acc. et inf., D.C.55.9

προσεπηρεάζω.definition: abuse besides, Arist.Top.161a23:—Pass., to be maltreated as well, D.C.52.29

προσεπιβάλλω.definition: throw upon besides, throw some; impose further burdens, Isoc.6.39

προσεπιγίγνομαι.definition: to be added, supervene, Hp.Morb.1.19; become as well, turn out in addition, PluNob.19

προσεπικαταδέω.definition: tie on or over besides, Hp.Art.14

προσεπίκειμαι.definition: to be urgent or instant besides, D.27.66

προσεπιλιπαίνω.definition: enrich yet more, Eust.ad D.P.Prooem.p.71 B

προσεπιλογίζομαι.definition: bring further proof; abs., take further consideration, Ph.Bel.57.29

προσεπιμερίζω.definition: allot, assign in addition, add, Gem.18.15, Vett.Val.155.35

προσεπιμετρέω.definition: give as additional measure, assign over; embellish, improve a story, Luc.Merc.Cond.29, Alex.30

προσεπινεύω.definition: bend forward the head towards, Sch.D Il.5.290

προσεπισπάομαι.definition: Med., draw towards oneself, Hp.Acut.59 ; Plb.12.13.3; Mitteis Chr.31 viii 30 ; D.S.13.77

προσεπίσταμαι.definition: understand or know besides, Pl.Phdr.268b, Chrm.170b

προσεπιστέλλω.definition: notify, enjoin besides, Th.2.85, X.Cyr.5.4.2; esp. by letter, pf. inf. Pass. Th.1.132; PTeb. 27.95

προσεπιτρέπω.definition: entrust or make over to besides, D.C.38.8; permit besides, c. inf., Id.77.24

προσεπιφέρω.definition: bear or produce besides, X.Oec.5.2; add besides, J.AJ3.9.1; Ph. ap. Eus.PE8.7

προσερίζω.definition: Dor. strive with or against; provoke to anger, Aq.Ex.23.21, al., Aq.Sm.De.9.7, al

προσηχέω.definition: resound or re-echo, Plu.Alex.31; with; c. acc., Him.Ecl.12.8, Or.14.3

προσθαφαιρέω.definition: add or subtract as required, Ptol.Alm.6.10

προσθεωρέω.definition: observe besides, Arist.HA538a6; consider besides, . . Id.Oec.1344b10

προσθλίβω.definition: press or squeeze against, LXXNu.22.25:—Pass., Placit.1.4.4

προσθόδομος.definition: chief of a house or its former lord, A.Ch.322

προσιατρεύω.definition: Ion. give extra treatment to, Hp.Art.14:—Pass., the cure is prolonged, Id.Morb.1.21

προσιζάνω.definition: sit by or near: hence, rest, settle on; metaph., Semon.7.84; A.Pr.278; cleave to, cling to, Id.Th.696

προσίνομαι.definition: hurt, injure before, Aret.CD1.4: also aor. part. Pass., Vett.Val.168.1

προσιππεύω.definition: ride up to, charge, Th.2.79; etc., Plu.Pyrrh.16, Mar.25, etc

προσίστημι.definition: weigh out to, Macho ap.Ath.6.243f; bring together the edges of a wound, Hp.Ulc.10

προσιστορέω.definition: narrate besides; observe or discover besides, Plu.2.276e

προσισχύω.definition: to be able besides, c. inf., S.E.M.8.368

προσκαθαιρέω.definition: pull down besides, f.l. in Ar.Eq.152 ap.Harp. s.v. reduce further, Hippiatr.1:—Pass., D.C.42.26

προσκαθέλκω.definition: aor. part. haul down besides, Plu.Cam.8

προσκαθίννυμαι.definition: cause to sit down besides, Hp.Mul.1.69

προσκάθισις.definition: sitting by or near, v.l. for in Plu.2.166a

προσκαθίστημι.definition: supply labour besides, PPetr.2p.7 ; appoint besides, D.S.13.80, cf. Plu.Num.7:—also in aor.Med., D.C.66.8, etc.; arrange besides, Id.42.46

προσκαινόω.definition: renew by addition, prob.l. in Plu.2.273c

προσκακουργέω.definition: do one an ill turn besides, D.C.45.22

προσκακόω.definition: injure besides, Sor.1.49:—Pass., to be affected besides, Hp.Hum.4

προσκαλεύω.definition: dig out first, Pall.in Hp.2.174 D

προσκαλέω.definition: call on, summon, Th.8.98; metaph., call forth, excite, Sor.1.26; ib.31

προσκαλινδέομαι.definition: spend one's time among, haunt, Eun.VSp.472 B.; Jul.Gal.335c

προσκάμνω.definition: work longer, App.Pun.97; suffer besides, Paus.5.13.6

προσκαταβαίνω.definition: descend besides, Ceb.16, AP11.99; go down to meet, abs., UPZ15.8

προσκαταβλάπτω.definition: damage as well, Arc. aor. subj. . . IG5.6.38
