προσκαταγελάω.definition: laugh at besides, Ath.11.508b, cf. Jul.Or.6.182b

προσκαταγιγνώσκω.definition: condemn besides, Antipho3.3.4; adjudge, award to, D.55.32

προσκατάγω.definition: draw back further, Ph.Bel.74.47; transport down the Nile in addition, PMich.Zen.103.11

προσκαταδέω.definition: bind down to or upon, Hp.Art.7; ib.9

προσκατακλαίομαι.definition: Med., lament one with another, Plb.38.15.9

προσκατακλείω.definition: shut up besides, Hsch. s.v. Pass. Aesop.349b

προσκατακτάομαι.definition: acquire besides, Plb.15.4.4; get made, Sor.1.4

προσκαταλαλέω.definition: bring a counter-argument against one, Tab.Defix.Aud.3b8 : —Pass., have a counter- argument brought against one, Arg.3Ar.Nu

προσκαταλαμβάνω.definition: fasten down to a thing, Hp.Art.43:—Pass., are treated with resin, have resin for one ingredient, ib.63

προσκαταλέγω.definition: enrol besides or in addition to; reckon as belonging to, Str.6.1.15

προσκαταλείπω.definition: leave besides as a legacy; leave over, of surplus material, LXXEx.36.7; leave behind, in dissection or operations, Heliod. ap. Orib.50.48.5, Gal.2.531: generally, leave behind one, J.AJ2.4.5

προσκαταλεπτύνω.definition: reduce, attenuate further, prob.l. in Ruf.Sat. Gon.15

προσκαταλύω.definition: undo or dissolve besides, D.C.47.32; complete the ruin of, Lib.Or.28.15

προσκαταμένω.definition: remain at a place afterwards, Hyp.Lyc.17

προσκαταμετρέω.definition: measure out land in addition, PCair.Zen.745.63

προσκατανέμω.definition: allot or assign besides, Plu.Sol.19; Id.Cat.Mi.33, cf. D.C.51.4

προσκαταξαίνω.definition: fut. cause to pine away, Lyc.173

προσκαταπίμπραμαι.definition: Pass., to be burnt down besides, D.C.62.17

προσκαταπλάσσω.definition: apply as a plaster, Heras ap. Gal.12.819, Paul.Aeg.3.81, Paraphr. Poet.de herb.86

προσκαταποντόω.definition: sink in the sea beside, D.C.42.38

προσκαταριθμέω.definition: reckon in, reckon together with, Thphr.Metaph.18; Plu.Marc.30

προσκατασκευάζω.definition: furnish or prepare besides; prove in addition, Alex.Aphr.in Metaph.260.32

προσκατασπάω.definition: draw down besides, esp. ships into the; Pass., to be brought away together, in vomiting, Hp.Coac.626

προσκαταστρέφομαι.definition: Med., subject to oneself besides, D.H.Isoc.14 , D.C.37.5, etc

προσκατατάσσω.definition: append, subjoin, Plb.3.20.1; assign, Ph.1.31; Corn.ND32

προσκατατείνω.definition: stretch out or extend besides, Hp.Art.77, v.l. in LXX4 Ma.9.19

προσκατατίθημι.definition: pay down besides or as a further deposit, Ar.Nu.1235; Pl.Thg.128a: metaph., add a remark, Gal.6.9

προσκαταχρηματίζω.definition: pf. part. Pass. UPZ26.7 , miscopied from cf. *25.11

προσκαταχωρίζω.definition: credit in addition, add in a bank; enclose or deliver a document with another, PTheb.Bank 2.8, al. , UPZ *25.6, 11

προσκαταψεύδομαι.definition: tell more lies of, Plb.12.13.3; assert falsely besides, Arr.Epict.3.17.8, D.C.45.31

προσκατειλέω.definition: wrap up against the body, cj. in Sor.1.84

προσκατερείδομαι.definition: Pass., to be pressed down besides, Hp.Art.58

προσκατερείπω.definition: complete the overthrow or ruin of, Paus.3.7.10

προσκατέχω.definition: hold steady against a cushion; increase the power of retention, Archig. ap. Orib.8.1.24

προσκατηγορέω.definition: accuse besides, accuse one; in Logic, use an additional name or predicate, Gal. ap. Orib.44.27.2; predicate besides, Dexipp.in Cat.35.18:—Arist. only in Pass., to be predicated besides, Int.19b19, Metaph.1054a16: c. d…

προσκατορθόω.definition: set up or establish besides; achieve besides, D.C.49.23

προσκαυλέω.definition: pf. shoot out like a stalk, Hp.Oss.15

πρόσκαυμα.definition: result of burning: hence soot from the outside of a pot, LXXJl.2.6, Na.2.10

πρόσκαυσις.definition: burning, of bread, Dieuch. ap; metaph., ardour, passion, Phld.Rh.1.361S

προσκεδάννυμι.definition: scatter title of a play by Alexis

προσκέλλω.definition: aor. push to land, land, Orph.A.1050, Opp.H.2.500, cf. Nonn.D.3.47

προσκερδαίνω.definition: aor. Plb.31.28.12, Aen.Gaz.Thphr.p.35 B.: pf. D.56.30:—gain in addition, D.l.c.; Plb. l.c

προσκεφάλαιον.definition: cushion for the head, pillow; name for a treasure-chamber of the Persian kings, Chares2 J

προσκηρυκεύομαι.definition: send a herald to one, Th.4.118

προσκιγκλίζομαι.definition: Pass., wag one's tail, didst twist about, Theoc.5.117

προσκιθαρίζω.definition: Dor. accompany on the lyre, SIG711 L 19 , prob. in Limen.tit

προσκινδυνεύω.definition: expose oneself to danger as well, D.C.Fr.83.2

προσκινέομαι.definition: Pass. with fut. Med., move to or towards, sens. obsc., of women, Ar.Pax903, Ec.256, Xenarch.4.23:—in Act. of the man, Pherecr.131.3

προσκλάομαι.definition: pf. Pass. to be shattered or shivered against, X.Eq.7.6

προσκλείω.definition: = accludo, Gloss.; in Dor. form , adjoin, Tab.Heracl.2.69, 107

προσκληρόω.definition: allot, assign, attribute, Phld.Sto.339.16; Luc.Am.3:—Med., fut. Ph.1.339:—Pass., to be assigned, Id.2.366, 381, J.BJ2.20.4; also, to be attached to, Act.Ap.17.4

πρόσκλησις.definition: judicial summons; invocation, f.l. for in Iamb.Myst.1.12

πρόσκλητος.definition: specially summoned, Sch. Ar.Ach.19; so alone, ; IG14.757, 760

προσκλύζω.definition: Dor. wash with waves; metaph., Luc.Am.53

πρόσκλυσμα.definition: lotion, Dsc.1.115, Antyll. ap. Orib.9.23 tit.; mouthwash, Archig. ap. Orib.8.1.39; hair-wash, Herod.Med. ap. Orib.10.17.1

προσκλύστιος.definition: he who dashes against, of Poseidon, Paus.2.22.4

προσκνάομαι.definition: inf. Pass. or Med., rub oneself against, X.Mem.1.2.30, Plu.2.917d; D.Chr.6.18

προσκνυζάομαι.definition: whine to one in a fawning manner, of a dog, Philostr.Her.Prooem.: metaph. of a person, fawn upon, Hld.7.10

προσκοινόομαι.definition: Pass., to be similarly attached, of rings, J.AJ3.7.5

προσκοινωνέω.definition: to be partaker, of a thing, share

προσκολλάω.definition: intr. of style, to be compact, D.H.Dem.43

πρόσκολλος.definition: Dor. glued or sticking to, Pi.Fr.241; Zos.Alch.p.222 B

προσκομίζω.definition: fut. Th.4.115:— carry or convey to a place, Id.1.50, cf. X.Cyr.7.3.4, Oec.11.16; for building, D.55.20; bring up the engine to assault the wall, Th.4.115; win it to their side, Plu.Arat.25; bring as a gift, Ael.VH1.31…

προσκοπεύομαι.definition: intend, look forward to, c. inf., Democr.92; he has been chosen out for the sword, Sm.Jb. 15.22

προσκοπέω.definition: watch , Ar.Eq.154:—Med., E.IA1098: folld. by indirect question, Thphr.Char.25.4

προσκοπή.definition: = offence taken, Plb.6.7.8; Id.30.29.7; Id.31.10.4, cf. Phld.Po.Herc.994.38, D.S.31.17; i.e. antipathies, Chrysipp.Stoic.3.102; S.E.M.1.195: but give no cause of offence, 2 Ep.Cor.6.3

προσκόπτω.definition: strike one thing against another; intr., stumble or strike against, X.Eq.7.6, Alex.81, Arist.Pr.882b18, GC326a27, etc.; Thphr.HP4.8.8; of liquid, to be checked by striking against, c. dat., Plu.Lyc.9; broken, interrup…

προσκοσμέω.definition: adorn yet more, add ornament to, J.BJ5.13.6; SIG798.20 :—Pass., Ph.2.575: also the adornments added to the theatre, prob. in Plu.Caes.66

προσκόσμημα.definition: additional ornament, 1.18 , IG4.203.9 , CIG 3080.5 ; prob. in BMus.Inscr.481*.530

προσκόσμησις.definition: additional decoration, Keil- Premerstein Dritter Bericht No.117

προσκοτέω.definition: darken or cloud over beforehand, f.l. for in Plb.1.48.8

προσκρεμάννυμι.definition: hang a thing on or to, Gp.10.5:—Pass., to be hung up to, hang up, Ar.Fr.131: to be attached or suspended, Hp.Superf.8, cf. Arist.Mech.856a23, Plb.2.10.4

προσκρίνω.definition: adjudge or award; Pass., to be joined with, assimilated, opp. Anaxag.14, cf. Gal.8.721; Dam.Pr.402

πρόσκρουσις.definition: dashing against a thing; offence, give him offence, Id.Cic.34, cf. 2.138e , etc

πρόσκρουσμα.definition: that against which one strikes; knock, Hippiatr.96

προσκρούω.definition: knock against, Ant.Lib.8.7. II. intr., strike against, collide with, Pl.Ti.43c, cf. Epicur.Ep.2p.38 U., Nat.2.3; Zen.3.29: abs., stumble, fall, D.18.254: metaph. of failure or defeat, Plu.Sull.11, cf. Luc.17. III. met…

προσκτάομαι.definition: fut. Hdt.8.136:—gain, get, or win; of persons, gain or win over, Hdt.1.56; win over Callimachus to his side, Id.6.110; Id.8.136: c.inf., Id.5.103

πρόσκτησις.definition: increase of fortune, Artem.3.61; Hierocl.in CA11p.442M

προσκτίζω.definition: build or found besides, Str.3.5.3; Id.9.2.3:—Pass., J.BJ5.4.2; ib.3.7.7; the two additional festival days founded in his honour, Sammelb.7457.39

προσκυλίω.definition: roll to, roll up; metaph. in Pass., wallow in, Anon.in EN436.7. but in Man.5.200.]

προσκύλλω.definition: molest before, Pass. women with a past, Vett. Val.120.6, cf. Heph.Astr.1.1

προσκυνέω.definition: fut. Hippon.32 , Pl.R.469a: aor; esp. of the Oriental fashion of prostrating oneself before kings and superiors, abs., Hdt.1.119, 8.118: c. acc., make obeisance to him, Id.3.86; Arist.HA630b20; Hdt.1.134, cf. 7.136; S…

προσκύνημα.definition: act of worship, ib.184.8 , al., Epigr.Gr.1004, 1010 ; BGU384.4 , PFay.127.4

προσκύνησις.definition: adoration, obeisance, Pl.Lg.887e ; Arist.Rh.1361a36, cf. Phld.Piet.69 , Plu.Alex.54, Arr.An.4.11.8; PFlor.296.57

προσκύπτω.definition: stoop to or over one, . . Ar.V.608; Pl.R.449b; lean towards one and whisper in his ear, Id.Euthd.275e; cj. in Thphr.Char.2.10; Ath.5.181f; Longin.Rh.p.180 H

προσκυρέω.definition: adjoin, Herod. Med. ap. Orib.10.5.10; BGU1121.8; meet with, Emp.2.5; Thgn.1361; Hp.Praec.8: c. acc. rei, S.OT1299 : reversely, betides the house, A.Ch.13

προσκυρόω.definition: confirm, Hsch.,Gloss.:—Pass., PLond.3.1044.15 : also v.l. for in A.D.Synt.114.17

προσλαγχάνω.definition: obtain by lot besides: has brought an action against us besides, D.32.9, cf. Plu.Per.36; Procop.Gaz.p.161 B

προσλάζυμαι.definition: take hold of besides, E.Hec.64 : also Pomp.Mac.1.3

προσλαλέω.definition: talk to or with, Antiph.218.3, Henioch.4.3: abs., Thphr.Char.7.5, PMich.Zen.80.5,7 ; Plu.2.602f

προσλαμβάνω.definition: fut. X.An.7.3.13: aor; take in, add an area to a building site, PCair.Zen.193.6 :—Math., or Archim.Spir.Praef.; plus, opp. minus, Apollon.Perg.Con.3.12

προσλείπω.definition: leave unworked, IG7.3073.23; intr., to be lacking, Arist.Pol.1337a2; IGRom.4.845

προσλειτουργέω.definition: serve as well, c. dat., Lyd.Mag.3.8

προσλεπτύνω.definition: extenuo, Gloss.:—Pass., become slender besides, Hp.Mochl.5

προσλεύσσω.definition: look on or at, c. acc., S.Aj.546, 1044; Id.OT1376: abs., Id.Ph.1068, etc

προσλέχομαι.definition: lie beside, only Ep. aor. Od.12.34

πρόσληψις.definition: taking in addition; acquisition, J.AJ17.1.2, 18.9.6; Anon.Trop.23

προσλιπαρέω.definition: keep close to, Plu.Aem.23; stand by them to the end, Id.2.245c: c. part., persevere, Agathin. ap. Orib.10.7.25: c. acc., continue to occupy, Arr.Epict.3.24.33: abs., persevere, Luc.Abd.16, Ruf. ap. Orib.8.21.15; to be…

προσλιπάρησις.definition: perseverance in a thing, Antyll. ap. Orib.6.10.14; persistence, Luc.Cal.20

προσλογεύω.definition: exact in addition, PHib.1.66.3 , IG12 .237.44 :—Pass., PCair.Zen.206.66

προσλογίζομαι.definition: fut. Luc.Alex.1; reckon or; take into account besides, Arist.Cael.294a4; Plu.Cam.28

προσλοιδορέω.definition: rail at besides, D.C.38.10:—Med., Them.Or.23.289b, cf. J.AJ7.8.1: aor. 1 Pass. in med. signf., ib.15.7.4

προσμανθάνω.definition: learn besides, A.Pr.697, Trag.Adesp.516a, Ar.V.1208, Th.20: c. inf., ib.24

προσμαρτυρέω.definition: bear witness in addition; ascribe, J.AJ5.8.9

προσμάσσω.definition: knead or plaster one thing against another: apply, attach closely to, Theoc.12.32; the cupping instrument to the snake- bite, Nic.Th.922; Ar.Eq.815:—aor. Med., stuck to [the arm], Theoc.3.29:—Pass., stuck close to his…

προσμάχομαι.definition: aor. J.AJ20.4.1:—fight against, Pl.Lg.647c, cf 830a, Plb.1.28.9; assault a town, X.Cyr.7.5.7; Plu.Demetr.33; X.HG7.2.7

προσμάω.definition: = pf. part. Pass. PSI10.1180.48 :—aor. Med. dub. in PRyl.29.21

προσμείγνυμι.definition: Arith., add, Cat.Cod.Astr.1.168; mix in as well, Zos.Alch.p.142B

προσμειδιάω.definition: smile upon, Plu.2.821f, etc.; ib.28a; Chor.Brum.6: abs., Luc.Merc.Cond.7, 16

προσμελῳδέω.definition: sing songs to or besides, Semus10, Aristid.Or.21 .15

προσμένω.definition: Dor. SIG615.7 (Delph., ii; c. dat., remain attached to, cleave to, A.Eu.497 ; Act.Ap.11.23; continue in . . , 1 Ep.Ti.5.5; Gal.15.436

προσμερίζω.definition: apportion to, Plb.27.9.5, cf. OGI455.5 , D.S.14.107:—more freq. in Pass., Plb.21.22.15, Supp.Epigr.4.246.13 , D.H.6.42, Sor.1.42, S.E.M.9.284, PRyl.209.25

προσμεταπέμπομαι.definition: Med., send for or send to fetch besides, Th.2.100, 8.71, Aeschin.3.87, IG12.870.6, D.H.2.44, D.C.40.2

προσμετρέω.definition: measure out to, join to, Is.Fr.169; adapt, IGRom.4.1302.13

προσμηκύνω.definition: provide as an extension, add, IG5.268.36 :—Pass., . . ib.48

προσμηχανάομαι.definition: Pass., to be cunningly fastened to or; Med., contrive or procure for oneself, Pl.R.467c; D.H.7.37; J.AJ8.13.1; Porph.Abst.1.9

προσμήχω.definition: rub beforehand, Archig. ap. Gal.12.407: aor. part. PSI10.1180.64 :—Pass., Gp.16.15.2; cf

προσμισθόω.definition: let out for hire besides, put; give a contract for besides, IG12.374.127:— Pass., ib.370.11

προσμοιράζω.definition: allot to, assign, Herm. ap. Stob.1.49.44

προσμολυβδοχοέω.definition: attach by soldering, Eratosth. ap. Eutoc.in Archim.p.94 H

προσμυθεύω.definition: add further fictions, Str.1.2.19; ib.40; Id.10.2.24:—Pass., Plb.34.2.9, Str.1.2.19

προσμυθολογέω.definition: talk or prattle with one, Luc.Sat.7

προσμύρομαι.definition: make tearful lament in answer to, AP9.362.23

προσνεανιεύομαι.definition: add in youthful wantonness, . . D.C.53.13; promise wantonly, Id.59.26

προσνέω.definition: aor. Th.3.112:—swim to or towards, l.c.; Luc.Bis Acc.21; heap up against, Plu.2.775e

προσνήχομαι.definition: swim towards, . . Call.Del.47: c. dat; of water, in Act., dash upon, Theoc.21.18

προσνικάω τῷ χρόνῳ.definition: use time as a help in overcoming an evil, Hp.Art.62

προσνίσομαι.definition: come or go to, . . Il.9.381 ; Pi.O.6.99; approach them with sacrifices, A.Pr.530 . II. come against, S.Ant.129

προσνοέω.definition: observe, X.Smp.2.16 codd; think in addition, Plot.3.8.11:— Pass., Id.6.6.17

προσνομίζω.definition: bring into use or practise besides, Aristid.Or.45.9, 23:—Pass., OGI56.43

προσνομοθετέω.definition: ordain by law besides, IG22.222.43, 7.4254.40 , Ph.2.227, D.C.37.29

προσνωμάω.definition: approach, S.Ph.717 ; but moved himself to it, Sch.ad loc

προσξενολογέω.definition: detail troops for special service, BGU1231.7

προσοδάρχων.definition: treasurer of a religious association, Ath.Mitt.6.42

προσοδεύω.definition: Med., receive income or revenue, Str.12.8.16, cf. Ph.2.371,402: c. acc., convert into a source of revenue, derive profit from, ib.389, cf. 172; J.AJ4.8.25:—Pass., to be received as revenue, IG 22.1080, App.BC4.5; also…

προσοδιάζω.definition: receive as income, Eust.1206.18:—Pass., profits, Vett.Val.292.30

προσοδοιπορέω.definition: travel to a place, f.l. in Aret.SD2.2

προσοικειόω.definition: associate with, . . Plu.Ant.60; adapt, Asp.in EN26.11

προσοικέω.definition: dwell by or near; has his house abutting on the wall, OGI 483.105

προσοικίζω.definition: found near or beside, D.S.13.79; J.BJ5.5.8; also of a temple or worship, Porph. ap. Eus.PE3.11

προσοικοδομέω.definition: build besides, build; metaph., . . they also framed, Pl.Ti.69c; Arist.Pr.866b17, cf. Thphr.Sud.30; Plu.2.168a

προσοιμώζω.definition: lament, J.BJ1.17.3; told me to 'go to the devil', Lib.Decl.29.27

προσοίχομαι.definition: have gone to a place, Pi.P.6.4

προσοκέλλω.definition: run [a ship] on shore, D.C.Fr.4.4: c. dat., run ashore on, Luc.VH2.2; so of the ship, Id.Tim.3: metaph., v.l. in Aret.SD2.10; Dius ap. Stob.4.21.17

προσολοφύρομαι.definition: wail to, vent one's griefs to, Th.8.66; wail to one another, Plu.Cic.47

προσομιλέω.definition: hold intercourse with, associate with; of sexual intercourse, Hld.4.8, cf. Luc.Am.17; PMasp.153.26, al

προσόμνυμι.definition: include with in an oath, Plu.2.223b

προσόμοιος.definition: also Str.3.4.18:— nearly like, much like, E.Ph.128 , Ar.V.356, Av.685, Amips.19, Pl.Sph.267a, etc. Adv. Id.Lg.811c

προσομοιόω.definition: intr., to be like, resemble, D.60.30:—in pf. Pass., Poll.9.131

προσομολογέω.definition: concede or grant besides, Hyp.Ath.8; simply, concede, allow, Isoc.9.50; admit, confess, Id.15.35; J.BJ1.25.1:—Pass., And.1.15; Aeschin.3.53

προσομόργνυμαι.definition: wipe off upon another, impart, Plu.Crass.2; Them.Or.21.248d

προσονειδίζω.definition: object as a reproach besides, Sch.Ar.V.664; . . J.BJ2.2.5:—Pass., ib.2.16.4

προσοράω.definition: fut. S.Ant.764: Dor. Theoc.6.22 , inf. AP9.604 :—look at, behold, Mimn.1.8, Xenoph.2.6, S. l.c., El.381, Pl.Phdr.250e; S.Tr.842 ; cf. :—Med., Id.OC244

προσοργίζομαι.definition: Pass., to be angry at, J.BJ2.14.6 , Plu.2.13d

προσορέγω.definition: reach a thing to, CratesEp.34.3:—Med., hold out as an inducement, Hdt.7.6

προσορίζω.definition: include within boundaries, add to a; determine or fix, Plu.Lyc.27:—Med. with fut. Att. determine or define besides, Arist.Ph.252a27, Rh.1407b5:—Pass., PSI 10.1160.18

προσορμέω.definition: come to anchor at, Plb.10.42.1; UPZ81 ii 7 : abs., PGoodsp.Cair.11.4

προσορμίζω.definition: bring a ship to anchor at or near, Luc.Am.11, cf. PTeb.802.11 ; Iamb.VP3.14; IG12.653.12 :—in early writers only Med., come to anchor near a place, Hdt.6.97; D.25.84; Id.4.44; Plu.Aem.26:—later in Pass., Arr.An.6.20.4…

προσόρμισις.definition: coming to anchor or to land, Th.4.10

προσορχέομαι.definition: dance to, Luc.Cal.16; to the words, Plu.2.46b

προσουδίζω.definition: dash against or to the ground, cf. E.IA1151 , Plu.Galb.26, Procop.Goth.4.29,al.:—Pass., Plu.2.506b, cf. D.C.72.13

προσουρέω.definition: make water upon, D.54.4, cf. Arist.Mir.845a33, Thphr.Fr.175: metaph., trifle with it, Ar.Ra.95, cf. Porph.Abst.3.14

προσοφείλω.definition: owe besides or still, Th.7.48; to be behindhand, Plb.38.8.6

προσοφθαλμιάω.definition: look with aching eyes at, Ph.2.560

προσοφλισκάνω.definition: fut. Arist.EN1124b11: 2 aor; as law-term, lose one's suit and incur a penalty besides, D.35.46; Id.45.6, Aeschin.1.163; D.23.80: abs., was fined in his office of Antiph.204.5

προσοχθίζω.definition: fut. , to be wroth with; Pass., to be treated with contumely, ib.2 Ki.1.21

προσόχθισμα.definition: object of wrath, offence, ib.4 Ki.23.13; ib.De.7.26

προσοχυρόω.definition: strengthen besides or still more, LXX1 Ma.13.48,52, Sch.Th.4.9

προσοψωνέω.definition: add to the dishes already mentioned, Ath.8.331c

προσπάθεια.definition: passionate attachment; in later Philos., clinging of the soul to the body and its passions, Porph.Sent.28; ib.29; Hierocl.in CA3p.425M., cf. M.Ant.12.3

προσπαθέω.definition: feel passionate love for, Arr.Epict.3.24.82, cf. Ph.2.48 ; Arr.Epict.4.1.77, cf. M.Ant.5.1; to be affected by contact with, become susceptible to, Dam.Pr.414

προσυπακούω.definition: listen to as well, Pl.Lg.898d; Gramm., understand something not expressed, supply in thought, Gal.16.740, Alex.Aphr.in Sens.105.13, Hierocl.in CA3p.423M.:—Pass., Phld.Po.5.10 , Ph.1.443, Sch.Luc.Anach.17

προσυπάρχω.definition: exist besides, Arist.GC335a31; and it would further have been my fate not even to be buried at home, D.21.106

προσύπειμι.definition: underlie in addition, c. dat., Eustr.in EN113.10

προσυπερβάλλω.definition: surpass, Ph.2.44, cf. 190; exceed, transgress, Ph.2.393 : abs., go beyond what is right or necessary, Id.1.276, 2.262, al

προσυπεργάζομαι.definition: prepare the ground for another, Plu.Sol.12

προσυπέχω.definition: to be answerable also for, D.Prooem.25 ; also Aristid.2.429 J

προσυπισχνέομαι.definition: promise besides, Plu.Demetr.10; make a higher bid, Wilcken Chr.167.20

προσυποβάλλω.definition: place under, submit besides, Plu.2.814f:—Pass., Gal.18.454

προσυπογράφω.definition: sketch out besides; subjoin, Ptol.Phas.p.10 H.; add below in writing, PMag.Lond.121.804

προσυποδείκνυμι.definition: show besides, Plb.22.10.4, cf. Aristeas136; . . Id.168

προσυπόκειμαι.definition: Pass., lie under besides, v.l. for; to be mortgaged besides, OGI46.17

προσυπολαμβάνω.definition: suppose besides, Arist.Cael.308a27; imply, import in addition, Phld.Mus.p.74 K. , f.l. for in D.H.Th.35

προσυπομένω.definition: pf. Jahresh.15 Beibl.96 :—endure further, PPetr.2p.22 , Ph.2.531

προσυπομιμνήσκω.definition: remind one of a thing besides, Plb.38.8.2: abs., Id.22.18.7:—Pass., aor. part. Phld.Ir.p.19 W

προσυποπτεύω.definition: suspect besides, Phld.Ind.Sto.4, D.C.Fr.40.46a; . . Id.Fr.40.46: c. inf. fut., Id.Fr.111.3

προσυποτάσσω.definition: subjoin besides, PTeb.38.26, al. , Ar.Byz.Epit.35.19, Vett.Val.96.24. S.E.M.11.1

προσυποτίθημι.definition: put underneath besides, Dsc.1.68.7; Med., assume besides, Gal.6.127

προσυριγγόομαι.definition: Pass., to be channelled, provided with a cavity beforehand, D.S.32.10

προσυφαίνω.definition: 1 aor. inf. Sever. ap. Eus.PE13.17:-interweave with, Pl.Ti.41d, cf. Sever. l.c.; Ph.1.511, cf. 536 , Jul.Gal.178b; Them.Or.26.316a; Porph.Marc.32: metaph. of buildings, Philostr.Im.2.28; Lib.Or.11.218

προσυφάπτω.definition: fix on beneath, Theo Sm.p.180 H

προσυφίσταμαι.definition: fut. reply, rejoin, Phld.Lib.p.6 O.; present itself to the mind from without, in pf. part., external objects, M. Ant.5.19

προσυφόω.definition: raise still higher, LXX1 Ma.12.36, J.BJ3.7.30, etc

προσφάζω.definition: Att. Pl.Min.315c:—sacrifice; kill first, dub. l. in Plu.Phoc.30

προσφαίνομαι.definition: Pass., appear besides, Aristid.Or.45.24; f.l. for in X.Cyr.4.5.57 codd.; cf

προσφέρω.definition: Dor. Prov. ap. Plu.2.239a: fut. E.Andr.257: Ion. aor. Hdt.3.87: Ion. aor. Pass. Id.9.71:-bring to or upon, apply to, E.Ph.488; Id.Andr.257; Hdt.6.18, cf. Th.2.58 ; bring to bear against . ., D.35.39); Hdt.3.87; but la…

προσφεύγω.definition: flee for refuge to, c. dat., Plu.Pomp.46, Cic.3, POxy. 488.23 , cf. J.AJ1.19.8, Sm.Ez.29.16

προσφθέγγομαι.definition: call by a name, call so and so, Pi.O.10.50; Pl.Plt.287e; intr., sound to, accompany, Poll.4.81

προσφθεγκτήριος.definition: accosting; gifts brought to a bride with a salutation, Id.3.36

πρόσφθεγμα.definition: address, salutation, mostly in pl., A.Ag.903, Ch.876, E.Ion401, etc.: sg., S.Aj.500, Ph.235; epithet, Philostr.Im.2.1

προσφθείρομαι.definition: meet to one's own or another's hurt, meet in an evil hour, if he, curse him, meet and insult you, Ar.Ec.248; mischievously meeting a ship in full course, Ael.NA2.17; Alciphr.1.32, cf. 34; also, make an acquaintance in…

προσφθονέω.definition: oppose through envy, Plu.Cam.36; regard with envy, Id.Alex.33

προσφιλής.definition: Act., of persons, kindly affectioned, well- disposed, S.Ph.532, cf. Th.1.92, 7.86. Adv. kindly, S.El.442, Pl.Lg.822b; to be kindly affectioned to us, X.HG2.3.44; Id.Mem.2.3.16: Comp. Pl.Mx.248d: Sup. X.Eq.Mag.1.1, Iso…

προσφιλοκαλέω.definition: add from a love of splendour; abs., of artists, have a love of beauty, Ph.1.495

προσφιλονεικέω.definition: vie with another in anything; cling stoutly to, Arist.Mete.343b25; persist in, Charito5.1

προσφιλοσοφέω.definition: speculate further upon; philosophize in company with another, c. dat. pers., Id.Gall.11, Philostr.VS2.1.9: metaph., Luc.Tim.6

προσφιλοτεχνέω.definition: employ further art, Athenio1.25; add; abs., cavil, Ph.2.509

προσφιλοτιμέομαι.definition: lavish money or enthusiasm upon, Ael.VH9.9: abs., Ph.1.451, Ephes.2.20 , IGRom.4.881.7 , Phalar.Ep.142.2

προσφιλοφρονέομαι.definition: make affectionate overtures to a woman, Nic.Dam.47.7J

προσφοιτάω.definition: go or come to frequently, resort to; metaph., visit, Antiph.240

προσφορά.definition: bringing to, applying; presenting, offering, ib.792a; shewbread, LXX3 Ki.7.48

προσφορέω.definition: bring to, bring in, Hdt.1.82; X.HG7.2.8

πρόσφορος.definition: Dor. , serviceable; suitable, fitting, Pi.N.3.31, 8.48, cf. E.Heracl.480, etc.; Epicur.Fr.250 : c. dat., Pi.N.7.63, E.Supp.338, Hec.1246, Ar.V.809, Av.124 , prob. in Pi.N.9.7; Antiph.62; suitable to, agreeing with, E.…

πρόσφυγος.definition: fleeing for refuge, Aesop.417, v.l. in Hdn.5.3.10

προσφυή.definition: = II, dub. in; pl., supernumerary teeth, Hippiatr.95

προσφυής.definition: firmly attached by growth; fixed or attached to, . . Od.19.58; Diog.Oen.39: metaph., inseparable from, Epicur.Fr.200: Comp., more akin to, Pl.Phlb.64c, 67a. Adv. of kissing, Luc.DMeretr.3.2

προσφώνημα.definition: that which is addressed to another, address, S.OC891: pl., ib.325, E.Alc.1144

προσφώνησις.definition: addressing, address, Parmenisc; dedication, Cic.Att.13.12.3; Onos.Praef.1; Plu.TG8

προσχαρίζομαι.definition: gratify or satisfy; gratify besides, Ath.Naucr. ap. Ath.5.211b

προσχάσκω.definition: aor. pf. in pres. sense; gape eagerly at, be greedy for, Plb.4.42.7; J.AJ11.3.5, cf. Ph.2.560

προσχέω.definition: fut. LXXLe.1.5:—pour to or on, LXX l.c; metaph. in Pass., deluged, Gal.5.318

προσχηματίζομαι.definition: Med., make a pretext, Apostol.3.33; Pass., to be protruded, become apparent, of haemorrhoids, Dsc.Eup.1.204

προσχολάζω.definition: pf. study formerly with, Phld.Ind. Sto.46

προσχορεύω.definition: dance to the sound of, Poll.4.81

προσχορηγέω.definition: supply in addition, in Pass., PTeb.27.57, 61.360, al

προσχράομαι.definition: use or avail oneself of a thing besides; abuse, dub. sens. in PSI4.406.7

προσχρῄζω.definition: Ion. require or desire besides, c. gen., Hdt.5.11, cf. 18; S.Ph.1055: c. gen. pers. et inf., I request you to listen to him, c. inf. only, S.OT1155, cf. OC1168: in poetry with inf. understood, A.Pr.641, cf.787, S.OC52…

προσχρώννυμι.definition: spread upon, D.S.19.33; metaph., . . 'painted them black', Plu.2.859e

προσχώννυμι.definition: form these new lands by deposition, of rivers, Hdt.2.10: abs., continually forms fresh deposits, Th. l.c.:—Pass., to be joined to the land by deposits of rivers, Thphr.HP5.8.3

προσχωρέω.definition: fut. Th.2.2,79; also Id.8.48; come or go over to, join, Hdt.1.58, cf. 7.235; Th.1.74, cf. 2.2, etc.; Hdt.4.120, Th.3.61, D.13.20: abs., Th.2.79, 3.7, 52, al.; also Hdt.7.156; Th.1.117, 2.100; Id.1.103; . . to what oth…

προσψαύω.definition: Dor. and poet. touch upon, touch, Pi.Fr.121.3: c. gen., Ael.NA1.57: abs., S.Ph.1054, OC329; Id.Tr.1214:—Pass., Dsc.Eup.1.167

προσψηφίζομαι.definition: Dor. Supp.Epigr.3.674A18 :—vote besides, Lys.6.24; App.BC2.18, cf. D.C.37.31, etc.: c. inf., Plu.Cat.Mi.32:—Pass., it was also voted, c. acc. et inf., D.C.56.28; Inscr.Magn.92b.15, 101.89

προσψήφισμα.definition: addition, rider to a decree, Sch.Hermog.inRh.4.818 W

προσψιθυρίζω.definition: whisper, chirp, whistle to, AP5.151 , cf. Plu.2.505c, Porph.VP24

προσωθέω.definition: push to or towards, Hp.Morb.1.8 , LXX2 Ma.13.6, Gp.17.19.4; freq. v.l. for as in Plb.1.48.8, D.S.20.95

προσωνέομαι.definition: buy besides, X.Vect.4.7; f.l. for in D.27.32

προσωνυμία.definition: right of placing one's name at the head of an order, BCH51.220

προσωπεῖον.definition: mask, Thphr.Char.6.3, Dsc.3.144 , LXX4 Ma.15.15, Arr.Epict.1.29.41, al., Luc.Nigr.11, Tim.27; i.e. wears an ugly aspect, CIG 3902r ; to do a thing under the mask, in the person, of Solon, Plu.2.857f

προσωπίδιον.definition: Dim. of Ar.Fr.264, Stud.Pal. 22.56.23 , Maria ap.Zos.Alch.p.157 B

προσώπιον.definition: = IG7.303.68 (Oropus, iii; = Dsc.4.106: also fem. ibid.; Id.Eup.2.119 ; Gp.5.48.4

προσωποληπτέω.definition: to be a respecter of persons, Ep.Jac.2.9

προσωποληψία.definition: respect of persons, Ep.Rom.2.11, Ep.Col.3.25, Ep.Jac.2.1

προσωποποιέω.definition: compose by means of III.2; Med., identify a person, Olymp.Alch.p.80B

προσωποποιία.definition: dramatization, the putting of; the putting of imaginary speeches into one's own or another's mouth , Id.Inv.3.10,15, Charis. p.284 K., Rutil.2.6

προσωτέρω.definition: further from, Plu.Cam.4; Sup. , Att. furthest, X.Mem.1.2.54; Id.Cyr.2.1.11; when furthest distant, Hdt.4.43; Id.2.103; S.Aj.731; as far as possible, Id.El.391

προσωφελέω.definition: help, assist besides, contribute to assist, Hdt.9.68; PSI4.400.5 : c. dat., Hdt.9.103, E.Alc.41, Heracl.330: abs., ib.34, D.H.8.74; contribute to it, Hp.Art.53:—Pass., gains something towards it, ibid

προσωφέλημα.definition: help or aid in a thing, c. gen., . . E.Med.611

πρότακτος.definition: or posted in front, the van, Plu.Cam.41, Crass.23, etc

προταλαιπωρέομαι.definition: suffer beforehand, Poll.6.139:—Act. is v.l. in Th.2.53

προτανεία.definition: alternative Attic form of IG22.1672.6, 8; also ib.11

προταρβέω.definition: fear beforehand, A.Th.332; fear or be anxious for one, S.Tr.89, Ant.83

προταριχεύω.definition: salt or pickle beforehand, Hdt.2.77; reduce a patient first by fasting, Hp.Acut.26

προτάσσω.definition: Att. 2 aor. Pass; class as prior, Plot.6.1.25; prefer, Sch.Ar.Ra.546

προτειχίζω.definition: protect by a wall, Str.5.3.7 , Gloss

προτείχισμα.definition: advanced fortification, outwork, Th.4.90, 6.100 , LXX2 Ki.20.15, Plb.2.69.6, etc

προτέλειος.definition: before a ceremony of; generally, beginning, in the preliminary conflicts, A.Ag.65 ; ib.720

προτελειόω.definition: perform preliminary initiation, in Med., Hsch.:—Pass., of a deed, to be executed previously. PFlor.56.11

προτελευτάω.definition: die before, Philoch.169, cf. D.S.1.91, Plu.2.113e, Hdn.1.15.8, Artem.2.57 , etc

προτελής.definition: = sacrifice offered before a marriage, Agathocl.2

προτελίζω.definition: initiate or consecrate by a ceremony preliminary to marriage, E.IA433:—Pass., to be prepared for the mysteries, Cratin.180, v.l. in Poll.3.38

προτενθεύω.definition: forestall, receive too soon; Med., greedily anticipating his bite . . , Eust.1202.3

προτεραῖος.definition: previous to, qualifying; former, the former condition . ., PMasp.2 iii 6

προτερέω.definition: of Time, to be beforehand with, get the start of, precede, opp. Arist.GA741b35, cf. 775a26; Id.Mete.369b9; Epicur.Ep.2p.46U.; of abnormally precocious animals, Arist.HA544b21; to be earlier in date, D.S.3.52, etc.; of…

προτερηγενής.definition: born sooner, older, Antim.42, Call.Jov.58, A.R.4.268

προτέρημα.definition: advantage, superiority, in pl; in war, advantage gained, success, Plb.1.9.7, 2.10.6, D.S.2.19, al.; Id.3.54; LXXJd.4.9, cf. Onos.13.1

προτέρησις.definition: superiority, give them a 'longer start', Hld.4.20

προτεχνολογέω.definition: treat technically before, in Pass., Ammon.in Porph.21.7, Sch.Hermog.in Rh.7.551 W.; Nicom.Ar.1.17, cf. Alex.Aphr.in Top.124.33

προτεχνόομαι.definition: Pass., to be trained already, pf. inf. Gal.13.656

προτήκω.definition: melt beforehand, Hippiatr.34, cf. Archig. ap. Orib.Fr.133

προτιθασεύω.definition: soothe, conciliate first, Olymp.in Alc.p.87 C

προτιμάω.definition: c. acc. only, prefer in honour or esteem, Heraclit. l.c.; A.Eu.739, etc., cf. Ag.1415; v.l. in Th.8.64; Arist.EN1096a16; OGI244.34 :—Pass., to be so preferred, Th.6.9, Lys.6.50, OGI754 , etc.; Isoc.10.60; X.An.1.6.5; …

προτίμησις.definition: honouring before or above others, preference, Th.3.82: pl., Poll.8.140; assigning a higher value to, Plot.6.7.20; in order of importance, Hermog.Id.1.11. .)

πρότιμος.definition: most honoured, Xenoph.2.17: abs., precious stones, v.l. in Pl.Lg.947d; Id.Erx.393d , cf. J.AJ6.10.2, Luc.D Deor.5.3, Ael.NA8.4 , D.C.47.31

προτιμωρέω.definition: help beforehand or first, Th.1.74:—Med., revenge oneself before, Id.6.57

προτινάσσω.definition: set in movement first, Archig. ap. Orib.8.1.1

προτολμάομαι.definition: Pass., to be first ventured or risked, Th.3.84; Hdn.6.7.10; D.C.47.4

προτραγῳδέω.definition: indulge in tragic declamation before, Sch.E.Hipp.601:—Pass., Lyd.Mag.2.21

προτρέχω.definition: aor. Antipho3.2.8; run in advance of, outrun, X.An.5.2.4; Isoc.1.41; Thphr.HP8.7.7

προτρίβω.definition: rub up or powder beforehand; rub first, Sch.Arat.1035

προτροπή.definition: exhortation, encouragement, Democr.181; urgent invitation, behest, POxy.1252v.27 , cf. 1415.23 , BGU618.19

πρότροπος.definition: a sweet Mytilenean wine, that flowed from the grape before the treading , Dsc.5.6, Androm. ap.Gal.13.30, Xenocr. ap. Orib.2.58.114, Ath.1.30b, 2.45e

προτρύγαιος.definition: epith. of Dionysus; festival of Dionysus and Poseidon, Hsch

προτρυγάω.definition: gather the vintage in advance, PRev.Laws 26.11, 17

προτρυγητήρ.definition: harbinger of the vintage, name of the star Vindemiatrix , interpol. in Arat.138, cf. Hipparch.2.5.5, 3.1.4, Gem.3.6, Ptol.Tetr.24: pl., Plu.2.308a

προτυγχάνω.definition: happen or be before one; obtain first, c. gen., pf. part. D.C.47.34: abs., App.BC1.53

προτυπόω.definition: form or mould beforehand, Ph.1.69, cf. Gal.5.418:—Med., form for oneself, Hld.9.25; figure to oneself, conceive, Luc.Par.40:—Pass., Phld.Mus.p.77 K.; . . OGI458.15

προϋδροποτέω.definition: drink water first, Antyll. ap. Orib.7.16.2

προϋπαντάω.definition: advance to meet, J.AJ8.1.2, BJ2.5.2, Hld.9.22; Ph.2.532: abs., ib.13

προϋπάρχω.definition: take the initiative in a thing, c. gen; intr., exist before, be pre-existent, Th.2.85, 4.126, Pl.Prt.317d, PLille 1v4 , etc.; Arist.Pol.1292b20, cf. SIG526.31 ; from pre-existent materials, Arist.Rh.1419b22; Id.APo.0.…

προϋπεργασία.definition: preparation, previous defence of what one is going to say, Lat. praemunitio, as a form of Rhetoric, like Rufinianus 32

προϋπερείδομαι.definition: Pass., to be sustained beforehand, Aret.CA2.3

προϋπέρχομαι.definition: to be moved first, of the bowels, Gal.18.271

προϋπεύθυνος.definition: previously subject or liable, c. dat., Keil-Premerstein Dritter Bericht No.55

προϋποβάλλω.definition: put under first, Gal.11.138, 18.568:—Med., put under as a foundation, Plu.2.966d, Them.in de An.49.6, al.:—Pass., to be prepared or ready as material, Luc.Hist.Conscr.51

προϋπογράφω.definition: sketch out, indicate before; subscribe, sign first, Lyd.Mag.2.10

προϋποδείκνυμι.definition: explain beforehand, Aristid.2.226J., Hierocl.in CA20p.466M.; . . Ph.1.480:—Pass., . . Longin.43.6, cf. S.E.M.2.71

προϋπόκειμαι.definition: serving as pf. Pass. to to; to be assumed first, Nicom.Ar.1.4

προϋπολαμβάνω.definition: assume beforehand, Arist.APo.71a12; hold an opinion previously, Id.Rh.1395b6

προϋποσπείρω.definition: sow beforehand, metaph. in Pass., Vett.Val.269.30

προϋποστέλλομαι.definition: Med., use abstinence first, Archig; Pass., to be placed beneath, Ruf.Anat.28

προϋποστρώννυμι.definition: strew or put under before, in Pass; Pass., constitute a prior foundation, Dam.Pr.341, cf. Ammon.in Porph.120.13

προϋποστυφή.definition: astringent, hardening process: metaph. in pl., . . TheanoEp.4.4

προϋποτάσσω.definition: place under one before, LXX3 Ma.1.2

προϋποτέμνω.definition: cut away from under before, Hld.4.18

προϋποτίθημι.definition: set under before, Hp.Acut.21; Pass., to be laid as a foundation before, Dam.Pr.121; ibid

προϋποτυπόομαι.definition: Pass., to be sketched in outline before, Ph.1.493, cf.Alex.Trall.8.2

προϋποχρίω.definition: smear underneath before, Asclep. ap. Gal.13.743, Aët.7.43

προυσελέω.definition: treat with contumely, outrage, maltreat, A.Pr.438 ; . . Ar.Ra.730 cod.Rav. : is written in codd. of Ael.Ep.3; Hsch. has cf. EM690.11; Suid.—The etym. is unknown

προϋφαιρέω.definition: snatch, i.e. have them held before the proper time, Aeschin.2.61

προϋφίσταμαι.definition: fut. A.D.Synt.14.12:—presuppose, Phld.Sign.16: but usu. in aor. 2 and pf. Act., exist before, LXXWi.19.7, Plu.2.636d, etc.; A.D.Pron.7.2; antecedents, Aen.Gaz.Thphr.p.43B.; Dam.Pr.23; Nicom.Ar.1.6: c. gen., Plu.2.570f…

προφανής.definition: foreseen, B.3.51; seen clearly or plainly, conspicuous, X.Cyr.4.2.15; Thphr.HP3.18.8

προφαντασιόομαι.definition: Pass., to be already enabled to conceive or imagine, Papp.678.9

πρόφαντος.definition: appearing at a distance, far seen; foreshown, esp. by an oracle, S.Tr.1159; as the divine oracle ran, ib.1163; Hdt.5.63; . . oracles were delivered to them, Id.9.93; J.AJ18.6.9

προφασίζομαι.definition: impf. Th.1.90: Att. fut; allege that . . , Pl.Mx.240a

πρόφασις.definition: motive or cause alleged; alleged motive, plea, without implication of truth or falsity, Thgn.323; Pi.P.4.32; Hdt.1.29; . . Id.6.133; whether the plea put forward be a trifle or a weighty matter, Th.1.141; the plea in …

προφέριστος.definition: surpassing, excellent, Dioscorus in PLit.Lond. 100 C1

προφητεία.definition: gift of interpreting the will of the; concrete, prophecy or oracular response, LXX2 Ch.15.8, Hld.2.27

προφήτευμα.definition: prophecy, oracular utterance, Phot. and Suid.s.v

προφητεύω.definition: Dor. Pi.Fr.150 and Inscrr.(v; expound, interpret, preach, under the influence of the Holy Spirit, Ev.Luc.1.67, Ev.Jo.11.51, Act.Ap.2.17, 19.6, 1 Ep.Cor.11.4, 13.9, al.: also Callistr.Stat.2

προφθάνω.definition: outrun, anticipate, c. acc; abs., to be beforehand, E.Ph.1385, Theo Sm.p.160H.: aor. Med., A.R.4.913

προφιλιόομαι.definition: to be treated as a friend first, Plu.in Hes.31

προφλεβοτομέω.definition: open a vein before, Posidon. ap. Gal.19.711, Gal.10.786 , Alex.Trall.7.9

προφοβέομαι.definition: Pass., fear beforehand, A.Supp.1044 ; . . X.Cyr.1.6.24 : abs., D.C.55.18

προφοιβάομαι.definition: Med., predict the future, Cat.Cod.Astr.8.137, prob. in 147

προφοινίσσω.definition: redden, stimulate beforehand, Sor. ap. Gal.12.419, Archig.ib.407, v.l. in Alex. Trall.1.1

προφορέομαι.definition: Med., in weaving, carry on the web by passing the weft to and fro across the warp , Poll.7.32, Hsch., Phot., Suid., prob. in Call.Fr.244: hence, of a spider, run to and fro, Call.Com.2, cf. Ar.Av.4; of dogs, X.Cyn.6.15

προφροντίζω.definition: consider before, Hp.Aër.2 (vv. Il; do mental work, Gal.17.175

προφυλακή.definition: guard in front; in pl., outposts; guarding, guard, Plb.5.95.5, cf. D.S.11.2

προφυλακτέος.definition: to be guarded against, Vett. Val.292.4

προφύλαξ.definition: advanced guard: =; officer on guard, Aen.Tact.22.9, and so prob. in IGRom.4.455 .— Also fem., Eratosth.Cat.22

πυγαῖος.definition: of or on the rump; = Hp.Art.57,78, Arist.HA620a15: pl., Archipp.41 , Sor.1.102, Dsc.Eup.2.56, Hsch., Phot.; of a bird, Hdt.2.76

πύγαργος.definition: white-rump, name of a kind of antelope; a kind of eagle, perh. Circus cyaneus, Arist.HA618b19; opp. Archil.189, cf. Lyc.91 : metaph. of a coward, S.Fr.1085

πυγίζω.definition: paedico, Id.Th.1120, Theoc.5.41: 3pl. impf. Sammelb.6840 : pf. AP9.317:—Pass., Sammelb.7452.9

πυγμαχέω.definition: practise boxing, be a boxer, Hexam. ap. Hdt.5.60, A.R.2.783

πυγμαχία.definition: Ep. boxing, Il.23.653,665, Pi.O.11.12, etc.: pl., Pratin.Lyr.1.8, Opp.C.2.20

πυγμάχος.definition: one who fights with the fist, boxer, Od.8.246, Pi.I.8.68, Luc.JTr.33

πυγμή.definition: fist, Hp.Art.71, E.IT1368; generally, fight, Edict.Caes. ap. J.AJ14.10.6, cf. Artem.5.58; of partridges, Gp.14.20.1, 2

πυγοστόλος.definition: epith. of a woman, decorating the with collat. notion of lewd, Hes.Op.373

πυδαρίζω.definition: dance the fling, App.Prov.4.25: hence kick up a Ar.Eq.697: , = Com.Adesp.977. or from by Irenaeus ap. EM696.2 = Sch.Ar.l.c.): hence = Zonar

πύελος.definition: bathing-tub, Hp.Acut.65, Ar.Eq.1060, Pax843, Th.562, Crates Com.15.5, Eup.256, PEnteux.83

Πυθαγορίζω.definition: to be a disciple of Pythagoras, Antiph.226.8, Alex.220.1

Πυθαεύς.definition: epith. of Apollo at Lindus, IG12.820, 834; also at Corinth, Delph., etc., Paus.2.35.2, 3.10.8, etc.: hence and his festival at Sparta and Megara, IG5.659, 7.48

Πυθαΐς.definition: sacred mission or sent to Delphi, Is.7.27, SIG696 A 6 , prob. ib.296

Πυθαϊστής.definition: member of such a mission, ib.696 B 19 , Str.9.2.11; also as Adj., Call.Iamb.1.229

Πυθιόνικος.definition: of or belonging to a Pythian victory, Pi.P.6.5, etc

πυθμένιον.definition: Dim. of BGU781 ii 15 , Gp.4.4, Hsch. s.v

Πυθόκραντος.definition: confirmed by the Pythian god: the Pythian oracles, A.Ag.1255

Πυθόληπτος.definition: seized with Pythian frenzy, Hsch., Phot

Πυθόμαντις.definition: the Pythian prophet; the prophetic seat at Pytho, S.OT965

Πυθοχρήστης.definition: Dor. sent by the Pythian oracle, A.Ch.940

Πυθόχρηστος.definition: delivered by the Pythian god; declared or appointed by the Pythian oracle, E.Ion1218; Plu.2.163b; SIG697 E 9 , IG3.241, Tim.Lex. s.v. Clitodem. 14

πυκνογόνατος.definition: with frequent knots or joints, Dsc.1.18, al

πυκνοκίνδυνος.definition: ever in dangers, v.l. for in Arist.EN1124b7

πυκνόκοκκον.definition: name of a plant with purgative properties, Ruf. ap. Orib.7.26.37

πυκνόκομον.definition: motherwort, Leonurus Cardiaca, Dsc.4.174, Plin.HN26.57; cf. foreg

πυκνομματέω.definition: to be riddled with holes, of a shield, S.Fr.35

πυκνόπορος.definition: with close or narrow pores, Alex.Aphr.Pr.2.76

πυκνόρριζος.definition: with matted roots, Thphr.HP3.11.4, al., Dsc.1.1

πυκνόσαρκος.definition: with solid flesh, Hp.Vict.3.78, Mul.1.73, al., Arist.Pr.861b29

πυκνοσπορέω.definition: sow thick, Thphr.HP8.6.2:—Pass., ib.8.7.2, cf. CP4.14.2

πυκνόστυλος.definition: with the pillars close together, i.e. at a distance of 1 1/2 diameters, opp. Vitr.3.3.1

πυκνοσύγκριτος.definition: Medic., of a constricted habit of body, BKT3p.20

πυκνόω.definition: make close or solid; contract, condense, opp. Arist.Spir.485a31; of the effect of cold, Id.GA783b1:—Pass., of frozen water, Antipho Soph.29, Arist.Metaph.1042b28, Mu.394a33; is contracted, Plu.Alc.6; of steam, Hp.Flat.8

πύκνωμα.definition: thick cloth, A.Supp.235 (nisi leg; dense mass, concentration, Epicur.Ep.1p.4U., al.; crowded detail, Phld.D.3.11; compression, Sor.2.41; close order, J.BJ6.1.3; Plu.Aem.20, cf.Phil.9

πύκνωσις.definition: condensation, opp; condensed matter, Arist.Mete.344a16, Plu.2.721a

πυκτεύω.definition: Boeot. box, spar, X.Lac.4.6, D.4.40; 1 Ep.Cor.9.26; Pl.Grg.456d; Corinn.11; strike with the fist on the head, E.Cyc.229: generally, fight, Hld.10.31; of gladiators, Rev.Arch.30.24 :—Med., Philostr.Im.2.19

Πυλαγόρας.definition: delegate sent to; SIG795 B 5 ; cf

πύλωμα.definition: gateway, in pl., A.Th.408,799, E.Hipp.808, Ph.1113, etc

πυλών.definition: gateway, Arist.Mu.398a16 , PCair.Zen.193.9 , PEnteux.74.3 , Sammelb.6157 , IG3.398 ; freq. separated from the house or temple to which it gave entrance, gate-tower, gate-house, IPE12.32B48 , Plb.4.18.2, Luc.Hipp.5, et…

πυλωρέω.definition: keep the gate, Luc.DMort.20.1, etc.; Plu.2.980b: metaph., Ps.-Democr. ap. Hp.Ep.23, cf. PMag.Par.2.158

πυλωρός.definition: gate-keeper, warder, porter, A.Th.621; Medic., pylorus or lower orifice of the stomach, Gal.UP4.7, cf. Nat.Fac.3.4, Cels.4.1.7, Ruf.Onom.169, Id. ap. Orib.7.26.34

πυξάκανθα.definition: thorn like the box-tree, = Dsc.1.100: also Lat. pyxacanthus, Plin.HN12.31, 24.125, Gal.12.63

πυξογραφέω.definition: write or draw on a tablet, Artem.1.51

πυορροέω.definition: discharge matter, Hp.Epid.7.5, Dsc.1.64.4, 2.151, Ruf. ap. Orib.8.24.67

πυουλκός.definition: surgical instrument for drawing off pus, HeroSpir.2.18, Afric.Cest.p.27 V., Gal.11.125, Hermes 38.283

πυρακτόω.definition: = foreg. I, Plu.2.624b, 762b; heat a cautery-iron, in Pass., Leonid. ap. Paul.Aeg.6.44, Gal.14.280

πυργηρέομαι.definition: Pass., to be shut up as in a tower, beleaguered, A.Th.22, 184, E.Or.762 , 1574, Ph.1087

πυργίδιον.definition: Dim. of Ar.Eq.793; as a farm-building, IG22.2776.15, 24

πυργίον.definition: Dim. of IG11.287A154 , PTeb.780.11 , Str.3.5.5, 12.3.18 , BGU889.10 , Luc.Pseudol.19, Vit.Auct.9

πυργίσκος.definition: Dim. of burial-vault; cupboard, cabinet, Ael.VH9.13, Artem.1.74, S.E.M.7.102, 9.78

πυργίτης.definition: of a tower, house-; fem. a plant, Hsch

πυργομαχέω.definition: assault a tower, X.Cyr.6.4.18, An.7.8.13; fight from a tower, Plb.5.84.2

πυργοσείστης.definition: tower-shaker, an engine of war, Anon. in Rh.3.580 W

πυργοφορέω.definition: bear a tower or towers, Luc.Syr.D.15

πυργοφόρος.definition: bearing a tower, of Rhea, AP5.259 ; of Demeter, Lyd.Mens.4.63, Suid. s.v. Plu.2.307b, Hld.9.16

πύργωμα.definition: that which is furnished with towers, fenced city, Orac. ap. Hdt.7.140 , E.Ph.287: pl., fenced walls, A.Th.30,251,469, E.Cyc.115, Hel.51

πυρέκβολος.definition: neut. pl. as Subst., fire- throwing machines, Alex. Aphr.Pr.1.38

πυρέσσω.definition: E.Cyc.228; Att. Ar.V.813, Pl.Tht.178c: fut. Hp.Mul.1.2: aor. Id.Prog.16, 4.26, al., Arist.Ph.228a28: pf. Id.Pr.901b10, M.Ant.8.15:—Pass., pf. Gal.4.447: :—to be feverish, fall ill of a fever, Hp.Aph.2.28, E. l.c., Ar.…

πυρεταίνω.definition: = Hp.VM17, Epid.4.7, etc.:—Med., f.l. in Id.Fract.11

πυρέτιον.definition: Dim.of sq., slight fever, pl., POxy.896.33

πυρετός.definition: burning heat, fiery heat; fever, Hp.Aph.2.26, Ar.V.1038 , etc.; Epigr.Gr.247 ; quotidian, tertian, quartan fevers, Pl.Ti.86a, etc. ; Arist.Pr.866a23

πυρευτής.definition: one who fishes by torchlight, Poll.1.96

πυρηνίδιον.definition: Dim. of knob, IG11.223B19, 36 , BGU781 iii 9

πυρήνιον.definition: Dim. of I, Thphr.HP3.7.4; = IG11.161 B 116 . only in Boeot. form

πυρηνοειδής.definition: shaped like a stone in fruit, of the III, Gal.2.756, UP12.7; provided with knobs, Paul.Aeg.6.2

πυριάλωτος.definition: caught by fire, of sea-birds, Philostr.Im.2.17

πυρίαμα.definition: Ion. = I.2, Hp.Flat.9, Philist.63, Arist.Pr.866a24; = I.1, Palaeph.43

πυρίασις.definition: warming by a vapour bath, Thphr.Ign.37 , Dsc.1.16

πυριατήριον.definition: bean-shaped hot-water bottles, Archig. ap. Aët.9.28

πυριβήτης.definition: poet. standing over a fire, Arat.983

πυρίβλητος.definition: struck by fire, Nonn.D.8.355; Act., = AP12.76 , cf. Nonn.D.30.91

πυριβριθής.definition: laden with fire, Orac. ap. Procl.in Ti.2.54 D

πυριγενής.definition: = foreg., born in or from fire; of instruments, wrought or forged by fire, E.Hipp.1223; Henioch.1; i.e. a weapon, E.Or.820

πυριγλώχιν.definition: gen. barbed with fire, Opp.C.2.166 , Nonn.D.1.151

πυριγόνος.definition: producing fire, Plu.Alex.35; proparox. Pass., fire-engendered, Ael.NA2.2; Ph.1.263, 2.500

πυρίδειπνος.definition: = foreg., prob. to be written divisim in Call.Fr.346

πυρίδρομος.definition: fiery in its course, Orph.H.8.11, prob. in A.1122

πυρίεφθον.definition: = Philippid.10 · and as gloss on s.v. cf. Gal.6.694, Poll.1.248, Eust.1626.6 , Phot., etc

πυριθαλπής.definition: heated in the fire, A.R.4.926, Nic.Th.40, AP7.742

πυρικαής.definition: = AP6.281 ; Gal.16.709. metri gr. in APl.c.]

πυρίκαυστος.definition: burnt in fire, Il.13.564; caused by a burn , Hp.Epid.2.1.1; Dsc.1.68.2, cf. Hp.Fract.27, Arist.Pr.866a6; later Aret.SA1.9

πυρίκμητος.definition: wrought at or with fire, Call.Del.145, cf. Fr.anon.50; scorched, Nic.Th.241; cooked, Porph.Abst.1.13

πυρικοίτης.definition: Dor. wherein fire lies asleep, of the cane of Prometheus, AP6.294

πυρίκτιτος.definition: made in or with fire, in an earthen pot, restored by Kock in Tim.Fr.23

πυριλαμπής.definition: bright with fire, AP5.15 , cf. Arat.1040, Hymn.Is.8, Opp.C.3.72, al

πυρίληπτος.definition: seized by fire, volcanic country, Str.12.2.7; Id.16.2.44

πυριμάχος.definition: resisting fire, of a fire-proof; fiery in fight, Hsch

πυρίπαις.definition: Son of fire, of Dionysus, Opp.C.4.287

πυριπηγάναξ.definition: lord of the fount of fire, PMag.Osl.1.155 ; written ib.344 , PMag.Par.1.3177 , Rev.Phil.1930.249 , Tab.Defix.Aud.38.29 , etc

πυριπληθής.definition: full of fire, Orac. ap. Eus.PE4.9

πυρίπνευστος.definition: breathed on by fire, Nonn.D.33.6, cf.IPE12.274

πυριπνέων.definition: Ep. part. with no Verb in use, fire-breathing, Musae.41; must be read in E.Ion203

πυρίπνοος.definition: contr. fire- breathing, Lyc.1314, PMag.Par.1.592, etc.; fiery, AP5.179 ; ib.7.354

πυριρρόθιος.definition: surging with fire, cj. in Orph.H.7.4

πυρισθενής.definition: mighty with fire, Nonn.D.24.6; ib.29.193, cf. PMag.Berol.2.90

πυρισπόρος.definition: = foreg., PMag.Par.1.596; proparox. gendered in fire, Orph.H.45.1, Opp.C.4.304

πυρίσσοος.definition: for plucked from the burning, Agamestor ap. Sch.Lyc.178

πυριστάτης.definition: tripod to stand on the fire, Sch.Ar.Av.436; also and Eust.1827.56; and Gloss

πυρίτοκος.definition: gendered in fire, of Dionysus, Lyd.Mens.4.160

πυρίφευκτος.definition: volatile, vaporizable, Ps.-Democr. ap. Zos.Alch.p.122 B

πυροφορέω.definition: bear wheat, App.BC2.40; to be II, IG42.227 ; ib.384.8

πυρρίζω.definition: to be red or ruddy, LXXLe.13.19, al

πυρριχίζω.definition: dance the Arist.Fr.519, Plu.2.554b, Luc.D Deor.8.1

πυρρόομαι.definition: Pass., become red, Arist.Pr.966b32, Aq., Sm., Thd.Ex. 25.5; Act. and Pass. dub. in Plu.2.1081b

πυρσαίνω.definition: tinge with red, E.Tr.227 , cf. Sotionp.191 W.; Poll.5.102; Philostr.Ep.40

πυρφορέω.definition: to be a torch-bearer, E.Tr.348: c. acc; esp. to be a or bearer of sacred fire, IG7.1776 ; ib.42.121.43

πυστιάομαι.definition: inquire, as of a god, Plu.2.292e, Phot.: impf. in Hsch

πυτίζω.definition: spit frequently, spurt water from one's mouth, EM697.57: hence Lat. pȳtissare, spit out wine after tasting, Ter.Heaut.457; pytisma, spittle, Vitr.7.4.5, Juv.11.175

πῶ.definition: Adv., Dor. for where? Hsch.; for; or where in the world? how in the name of fortune? or, without a question, = not a whit, Pherecr.9, Ar.Pl.66, Fr.346, Lys.Fr.254 S., D.19.51

πωγωνοτροφέω.definition: let the beard grow, Str.15.1.71, D.S.4.5, Plu.2.230b

πωλεύω.definition: break in a young horse, X.Eq.2.1, Poll.1.182, Him.Ecl.13.36:—Pass., ib.21.4: generally, to be trained, of elephants, Ael.NA13.8; ib.16.36

πωλέω.definition: Ion.impf. Hdt.1.196: fut; let out the taxes, Aeschin.1.119; Arist.Ath.47.2; SIG284.28

πωλοδαμνέω.definition: break young horses, E.Rh.187,624; metaph., train, S.Aj.549; Luc.Am.45; Plu.2.13e

πωμάζω.definition: furnish with a lid or cover, Arist.HA627b8, Pr.899b26, Dsc.1.8, Babr.58.2; cover up, seal, Gp.6.16.1; stop up, ib.7.15.2: generally, cover, 1 Enoch10.5

πωρέω.definition: = Hsch.; Elean, acc. to Sch.S.OC14, Suid.s.v

πωροειδής.definition: like I, Aret.SD2.3; of gall-stones, Gal.8.384

πωροκήλη.definition: hard tumour of the testicle, Id.19.448, Poll.4.203, Paul.Aeg.6.63

πώρωσις.definition: process by which the extremities of; metaph., obtuseness, blindness, Ev.Marc.3.5, Ep.Eph.4.18: abs., Ep.Rom.11.25

παγγενεί.definition: Adv. with one's whole race, Xanth.10; IG3.1423, 1424: written in EM647.53, v.l. in Ael.NA17.27

παγγυναικί.definition: Adv. with all their women, D.C.41.9

πάγχυ.definition: Adv., Ep., Ion., and Aeol. for wholly, entirely, Il.14.143; 12.165; Od.4.825; , Il.10.99, Hes.Op.264; Sapph.Supp.5.5; or think or hope fully that . . , Hdt.1.31, 4.135, cf. Pi.P.2.82, Epich.99.3, Epic.Alex.Adesp.8.3, …

παιδιόθεν.definition: Adv. from a child, LXXGe.47.3, Ev.Marc.9.21

παιδόθεν.definition: Adv. from childhood, Ibyc.1.10, Them.Or.25.310d, Ps.-Luc.Philopatr.19; Sammelb.5294.8

πάλαι.definition: Adv. long ago, Il.9.527; like an Adj. with Art. and Noun, men of old, Pi.I.2.1; S.OT1; ib.268; ib.916, cf. Tr.1165, El.1490, etc.; D.19.276 ; the ancients, opp. Arist.Metaph.1069a29

παλιμπρυμνηδόν.definition: Adv. stern-foremost, E.IT1395, from Hsch., who expl. it

πάλιν.definition: poet. also , Adv; of Place, back, backwards , mostly joined with Verbs of going, coming, etc.; Hdt.5.72; A.Pr.854, S.OC601, Pl.Cra.438a, etc.; A.Pr.962; E.Med.412 ; Id.Ph.725, cf. 1400; give back, restore, Il.1.116, e…

παμπήδην.definition: Adv., = entirely, Thgn.615, A.Pers.729 , Fr.156, S.Aj.916:—also Theognost.Can.163

παμπληθεί.definition: Adv. with the whole multitude, Ev. Luc.23.18, D.C.75.9

παμψηφεί.definition: Adv. with all the votes, AP11.239 , cf. Sch.Ar.Eq.525, etc.; Dor. Polus ap. Stob.3.9.51

πανασμένως.definition: Adv. very readily, only in Sup. Tz.H.9.10

πανδημεί.definition: or Dor. or A.Th.296, Eu.1038 :—Adv. of with the whole people, in a mass or body, Hdt.6.63, 7.120, al.; Isoc.10.27; A.Th. l.c., cf. Eu. l.c.; Th.1.126; Id.5.33, cf. 1.73,90, 4.42, Pl.Lg.814a; And.3.18; Lys.2.49; Hdt.7.…

πανηβηδόν.definition: Adv. with all the youth, Tz.H.7.995

πανημαδόν.definition: Adv., = sq., Max.182, Orac. ap. Oenom. ap. Eus.PE5.22

πανθοινί.definition: or Adv. at a high festival, A.D.Conj.234.9, Hdn.Epim.255

παννεωτερικῶς.definition: Adv. quite recently, in form paneotericos, Sch.Bemb. Ter.Adelph.765

πανοικεσίᾳ.definition: Adv. with all the household, Th.2.16, 3.57, Antipho Soph.108, D.H.7.18, PLond.2.479.4 , etc.:—also Max.Tyr.19.1, Sammelb.6267.18 , v.l. in Th.3.57

πανσπερμηδόν.definition: Adv. with all sorts of seeds, Nic.Fr.72.5

πανσυδί.definition: or Adv., with all one's force, hence = utterly, Th.8.1, cf. Pherecr.31, D.H.5.46: written X.Cyr.1.4.18, Onos.42.12, v.l. for sq. in X.HG4.4.9, Ages.2.19

πανσυδίην.definition: Adv. = foreg., EM650.55, v.l. in Suid.; also Hsch. s.v

παντάπασι.definition: in affirmative answers, by all means, undoubtedly, Pl.Phdr.278b, Sph.227a; X.Mem.4.5.3

πανταχόθεν.definition: Adv. from all quarters, from every side; from every side, i.e. in every way, . . Th.1.17; ib.124, cf. X.Mem.2.1.25; D.18.242

πανταχόθι.definition: Adv. = Gal.14.81, Vict.Att.16: c. gen., Luc.D Deor.9.1

πανταχοῖ.definition: Adv. in every direction, any whither, Ar.V.1004; , Id.Lys.1230; D.4.24, cf. 8.76

πανταχόσε.definition: Adv., = foreg., Th.7.42, Pl.R.540a, etc.; incorrectly for Plu.Agis14

πανταχοῦ.definition: Adv. everywhere, Hdt.3.117 (nisi leg; altogether, absolutely, Pl.R.503a; not at all, Id.Prm.128b

πανταχῶς.definition: Adv. in all ways, altogether, Pl.Prm.143c, Isoc.15.94

πάντοθεν.definition: Adv., from all quarters, from every side, Il.15.623, S.OC1240 , etc.; A.Ag.1370: in Ion. Prose, Hdt.2.138, 7.129: rare in Att. , Pl.Criti.117e; Men.625, cf. Mon.63; Arist.PA656b29; Id.EN1121b32: freq. with Prep., Il.1…

πάντοσε.definition: Adv. every way, in all directions, Il.5.508; 12.266; 13.649, etc.; cf. in Prose, X.An.7.2.23, HG7.4.4, Arist.de An.413a29: c. gen., AP9.668.10

πάντοτε.definition: Adv. always, Philem.187, Arist.EN1166a28, Men.Mon.324, 720; twice in LXX,Wi.11.21, 19.18, cf. BGU1123.8 , Ev.Matt.26.11, al., IG3.1362, 7.2713, D.Chr.32.37, etc.: condemned by the Atticists, who recommend or Phryn.82,…

πάντως.definition: Adv., in all ways; in strong affirmations, at all events, at any rate, A.Pr.16, Hdt.5.111, Pl.Ap.33d, 1 Ep.Cor.9.22, etc.; so Ar.Th.984 ; Ephipp.15.11; Ar.Eq.232; Id.Th.805; assuredly, opp. Jul.Or.7.222a; . . , and yo…

πάνυ.definition: Adv., altogether, first in; with Verbs, A.Ch.861 , Pl.Cra.386c, Euthd.272d, etc.; perfectly, Ar.Ra.65,195; X.An.6.1.31: with Adjs., very, exceedingly, etc., very many or few, very small, A.Ag.1456 , Pl.Ap.25b, Arist.H…

παππωνυμικῶς.definition: Adv. called after one's grandfather, formed like Suid. s.v

παραβεβλημένως.definition: Adv. pf. part. Pass. of recklessly, Poll.3.136

παραβλήδην.definition: Adv., thrown in by the way; parallelwise, Arat.535

παραδρομάδην.definition: Adv. in running or passing by, Orph.A.858

παραιβαδόν.definition: Adv. in going beside or near to, c. gen., prob. in Opp.C.1.484

παρακειμένως.definition: next, following, Placit.1.8.1 ; in the next place, ib.4.22.3, S.E.M.7.227, al

παρακεκινδυνευμένως.definition: Adv. in a bold dashing style, Pl.Lg.752b

παρακεκομμένως.definition: Adv. briefly, v.l. for in Sch.Luc.Lex.3

παρακλιδόν.definition: Adv., turning aside; leaning against, Orph.A.559

παραλλάξ.definition: Adv. alternately, in turn, S.Aj.1087; in alternating rows, . . Th.2.102

παραπαιόντως.definition: Adv. in a foolish way, Hsch

παράπαν.definition: Adv. for altogether, absolutely, in; freq. with neg., not at all, Hdt.1.32; Ar.Pl.17, cf. Isoc.17.35, etc. ; . . Pl.Tht.187a; Id.Ap.26c; . . Pherecr.113: with a neg. Verb, Antipho3.3.7

παραπεπλεγμένως.definition: Adv. pf. part. Pass. entwined, Hsch

παραπολύ.definition: Adv. by much, by far, Hp.Art.7; Dsc.3.80: better divisim

παρασεσυρμένως.definition: Adv. pf. part. Pass., mockingly, Ph.2.599

παρασταδόν.definition: Adv. standing beside, at one's side, Il.15.22, Od.10.173, Thgn.473, A.Ch.991; Theoc.25.103

παρασυνήθως.definition: Adv. in a manner contrary to custom, PMasp.6.5

παρασχεδόν.definition: Adv. beside, near, of Place, A.R.2.10,859; nearly, almost, D.H.7.45

παρατεταγμένως.definition: Adv. pf. part. Pass. as in; of a straight line, to be drawn parallel to the ordinate of a conic, Apollon. Perg.Con.1.27,al

παρατεταμένως.definition: Adv. extendedly, throughout the whole length, Sch. D Il.17.748

παρατετηρημένως.definition: Adv. carefully, Ph.1.221, Heliod. ap. Orib.49.8.7; according to rule, A.D.Conj.238.29

πάραυτα.definition: or Adv. for , immediately, straightway, A.Ag.737 , D.23.157; E.Fr.1079.5 codd. Stob., cf. Plb.23.5.11; Id.38.11.11 ; prob. in Epicur.Fr.423.2. c. gen., Socr.Ep.11

παραυτίκα.definition: with Substs., present death, E.Alc.13; momentary splendour, Th.2.64; Id.8.82; X.Cyr.1.5.9, 8.1.32; Pl.Phdr.239a

παραφθαδόν.definition: Adv. overtaking, c. gen., Opp.H.3.298: abs., in rivalry, ib.4.97

παραχρῆμα.definition: Adv. for on the; in later writers, c. gen., D.Chr.11.130; Eun.Hist.p.240 D., cf. Gp.10.75.16

παρεδρικῶς.definition: Adv. after the manner of a familiar spirit, PMag.Berol.1.1

παρειμένως.definition: Adv. pf. part. Pass. of remissly, slackly, Hsch.; to be paralysed in the hind limbs, Ael.VH1.7

παρεκεῖ.definition: Adv. thereabouts, Hsch. and Suid. s.v

παρελκόντως.definition: Adv. superfluously, Dsc. Ther.Praef., Ptol.Harm.2.8, Eust.26.7

παρεμποδών.definition: Adv. in the way, Procop. Gaz.Ep.127, Alex. Trall.2

παρεοικότως.definition: Adv. in a manner somewhat like, Poll.9.131

παρευρημένως.definition: Adv. pf. part. Pass., craftily, f.l. in Zen.2.60

παρεφθαρμένως.definition: Adv., corruptly, Eupolem. ap. Alex. Polyh.18, Gal.18.193

παρημελημένως.definition: Adv., negligently, Plu.2.34od, f.l. in D.H.7.12

Παρθιστί.definition: Adv. in the Parthian tongue, Plu.Ant.46

παρωρμημένως.definition: Adv. pf. part. Pass., violently, Hsch. and Phot. s.v

παρῳχημένως.definition: Adv., in the past tense, Sch.E.Ph.622

πατριαστί.definition: later Adv. with the father's name, PHal. 1.248 , SIG1023.32 , 793.13

πατρόθεν.definition: Adv., from or after a father; coming from, sent by one's father, imposed by Zeus, Pi.O.3.28; A.Ag.1507 ; a father's curse, Id.Th.841

πεδίονδε.definition: Adv. to the plain, Il.11.492, Od.15.183, h.Merc.88, Ar.Av.507

πελαγόσδε.definition: Adv. to, into, or towards the sea, A.R.4.1233

πέλας.definition: Adv. near, hard by, c. gen. , which commonly; one's neighbours, Democr.293, Antipho Soph.58, Hdt.1.97, Critias15.6 D., Th.1.69, 4.78,92, Arist.EN1169a14, etc. ; one's fellow creatures, E.Heracl.2, Hipp.441; opp. Hdt.7…

πεντάκις.definition: Adv. five times, Pi.N.6.19, A.Pers.323, Ar.Pax242, Isoc.5.5:—later Opp.C.3.56, AP13.15, Iamb.in Nic.p.80 P., al

πένταχα.definition: Adv. five-fold, in five divisions, Il.12.87; but Hsch

πενταχῶς.definition: Adv. in five ways, Theo Sm.p.23 H., S.E.M.1.122, Eust.32.40

πεντεκαιδεκάκις.definition: Adv. fifteen times, Sch.Ptol. Geog. 1.24.2, Theo Sm.p.203 H

πεπαιδευμένως.definition: Adv. in a well-bred manner, Isoc.11.30, Ael.VH12.1

πεπεισμένως.definition: Adv. confidently, D.L.9.71, cf. 4.56; from conviction, Ptol.Alm.2.6, Iamb.VP30.175: f.l. in Str.15.1.24

πεπιστευμένως.definition: Adv., truly, Aristox. ap. Stob.4.25.45, Phld.Rh.1.352 S.: Aq.Is.25.1, Nu.5.22, al

πεπλανημένως.definition: Adv., mistakenly, in error; irregularly, of fits of disease, Hp.Epid.1.3

πεπλασμένως.definition: Adv., artificially, by pretence, opp. Pl.R.485d; opp. Bato7.5; opp. Arist.Rh.1404b19; Phld.Rh.1.200 S

πεπληθυσμένως.definition: Adv., by way of multiplication, as a plurality, Porph.Sent.33.2, Procl.in Cra.p.51 P.; opp. Id.in Alc.p.52 C

πεπληρωμένως.definition: Adv., gloss on Sch.Ar.V.1285; = Lat. plene, Dosith.p.409K., Gloss

πεποιημένως.definition: Adv. as a made up or onomatopoeic word, Sch.Il.15.607

πεποικιλμένως.definition: Adv. in a manner diversified, Phld.Po.5.29

πεπονημένως.definition: Adv. pf. part. Pass., elaborately, Ael.NA; with toil, Agath.4.17

πεπορθημένως.definition: Adv. so as to be destroyed, AB393, Suid. s.v

πέραθεν.definition: Adv., from beyond, from the far side, E.Heracl.82 , X.HG3.2.2: Ion. Hdt.6.33; Luc.Syr.D.13

περιβάδην.definition: Adv. astride, of a rider, Plu.Art.14; with crossed legs, Sch.Poll.3.90

περιβεβλημένως.definition: Adv. pf. part. Pass., metaph. in Rhet. diffusely, Hermog.Id.1.10, 11; cf. III.3

περιγεγονότως.definition: Adv., successfully; = i. e. superfluously, Simp.in Ph.1023.16

περιεπτισμένως.definition: Adv., in a winnowed, clean style, metaph., of speech, Poll.6.150

περιεσταλμένως.definition: Adv., covertly, Arr.Epict.3.7.13, D.L.7.16; gloss them over, TheonProg.2: gloss on Erot

περιζαμενῶς.definition: Adv. very powerfully or violently, h.Merc.495

περικεκαλυμμένως.definition: Adv. covertly, Apollon.Lex. s.v. Ascl.in Metaph.30.9

περινενοημένως.definition: Adv. in a carefully thought-out fashion, opp. Hermog.Id.2.5, cf. 9

περιπεπλεγμένως.definition: Adv., gloss on Sch.Opp.H.2.376; on Suid

περιπεφρασμένως.definition: Adv. very thoughtfully, gloss on Hsch

περιπεφυλαγμένως.definition: Adv. very cautiously, gloss on Erot

περιπλέγδην.definition: Adv. closely entwined, Eratosth.27; in close embrace, AP5.258 , cf. 254.16 , Opp.H.2.376; of ivy, Luc.Am.12, etc

περιρρήδην.definition: Adv. of sq. II, sloping, A.R.4.1581

περισπωμένως.definition: Adv. pres. part. Pass., pronounced with a circumflex, esp. on the last syllable, Gal.19.120, Ath.9.400a, Sch.Ar.Pl.109, etc

περισσάκις.definition: Att. Adv. of of numbers, taken an odd number of times, multiplied by an odd number, Pl.Prm.144a, Plu.2.744a, etc

περισταδόν.definition: Adv. standing round about, Il.13.551; from all sides, Th.7.81

περιστολάδην.definition: Adv. surrounding, Nic.Al.475 codd. ; prob. by drops, cf. Sch.ad loc., and Hsch

περιφλέκτως.definition: Adv. with burning passion, Eun.VSp.455 B

περιφοράδην.definition: Adv. trailing round, of the peculiar movement of the hind feet of oxen walking, Hp.Art.52, cf. Gal.18.586

περιωδευμένως.definition: Adv. pf. part. Pass. of fully, in detail, Phld.Rh.1.248 S., Plu.2.537d

Περσιστί.definition: Adv., in the Persian tongue; in the Persian fashion, Aristid.Or.34 .56

πεφεισμένως.definition: Adv., sparingly, cautiously, D.S.31.31, Vett.Val.187.6, Hippiatr.96, Ael.NA7.45, etc.: c. gen., ib.6.24

πεφραγμένως.definition: Adv., guardedly, Chrysipp.Stoic.2.42; with a good defence, J.BJ7.6.4

πεφρονημένως.definition: Adv., thoughtfully, i. e. has been thought out, Diotog. ap. Stob.4.1.96

πεφροντισμένως.definition: Adv., carefully, Str.15.1.2, D.S.12.40, Ph.2.214, J.AJ15.2.7, Antyll. ap. Orib.44.8.7, Themist.Ep.8, etc.; Ael.NA3.33

πεφυλαγμένως.definition: Adv., with due caution, X.An.2.4.24, Eq.Mag.6.2, Aen.Tact.15.7, D.7.29, Plu.Oth.7,al., Luc.Philops.6; Isoc.8.97

πεφυρμένως.definition: Adv., confusedly, M.Ant.2.11, cj. in Diotog. ap.Stob.4.1.133

πήποκα.definition: Adv., Dor. = IG5.213.5 , Theoc.8.34, Com.Adesp.in Gött.Nachr.1922p.28, Epigr. ap. Poll.4.102

πινακηδόν.definition: Adv., like planks, Ar.Ra.824, cf. Sch.ad loc

πλειστάκις.definition: Adv., mostly, very often, Hp.Art.51, Arist.EN1153b34, LXXEc.7.23, etc.; X.Oec.16.14; Hp.Art.67, Antipho5.86, Pl.R.459d, etc.—A form PRyl. 130.12 , EM169.31, Eust.122.7

πλεισταχόθεν.definition: Adv. from most or many places, Ar.Fr.840

πλεοναζόντως.definition: Adv. in the majority of instances, usually, Phld.Rh. 2.74 S., Lib.p.43 O., Heliod. ap. Orib.46.10.1, Sor.Fract.19; superfluously, Eust.934.16

πλεονάκις.definition: Adv., more frequently; taken more times together, multiplied by a larger number, opp. Pl.Tht.148a:—also PMagd.25.4 ; PCair.Zen.29.2 , IG12.533 , 9.694.45 ; Sammelb.4638.18

πλευροειδῶς.definition: Adv. after the manner of ribs, Thphr.HP3.10.3, cf. 3.17.3

πληθικῶς.definition: Adv. in the majority of instances, OGI669.49

πλινθηδόν.definition: Adv. brick-fashion, i.e. in courses with; of a kind of writing in which the letters were arranged in a rectangle, Eust.1305.33, Sch.D.T.p.191 H., etc

πλουτίνδην.definition: Adv. according to wealth, Arist.Pol.1273a24, cf. Ath.3.1, Plb.6.20.9, Plu.2.154c

πόθι.definition: interrog. Adv., poet. for where? Od.1.170; later for whither? A.R.1.242, AP7.566 . B. enclit. Adv., poet. for anywhere, somewhere, Il.10.8, etc.; S.Aj.886

ποίμνηθεν.definition: Adv. of or from a flock, A.R.2.491

πολλάκις.definition: Ep. and Lyr. sts. in Trag; of Time, many times, often, Il.1.396, etc.; Hdt.7.46; X.Cyr.1.2.9; Ephes. 3p.152 No.70

πολλαχόθεν.definition: Adv. from many places or sides, Th.6.32; from many considerations, for many reasons, . . Th.4.6

πολλαχόθι.definition: Adv. in many places, Plu.Pomp.24, Luc.Herm.30

πολλαχόσε.definition: Adv. towards many sides, into many parts or quarters, Th.2.47: c. gen., X.HG4.4.16

πολλαχοῦ.definition: Adv. in many places; c. gen., v.l. in Pl.Phd.111a

πολλαχῶς.definition: Adv. in many ways, Diog.Apoll.2, Isoc.4.8, D.22.25, etc.; in many senses, Arist.Top.158b10, Pol.1276a23

πολλοδεκάκις.definition: Adv. many tens of times, Ar.Pax243

πόντονδε.definition: Adv. into the sea, Od.9.495, 10.48, A.Supp.33

ποσαπλοῦς.definition: = foreg., Gal.13.872. Adv. how many times? LXXPs.62.1

ποσαχῶς.definition: Adv. in how many ways, Arist.Pol.1289a11, Gal.14.791, 19.47; esp. in how many senses? Arist.Top.105a23; Id.Metaph.1028a5, cf.Rh.1398a28

ποταμηδόν.definition: Adv. like a river, Luc.Sat.7, Aret.SD2.13

ποταμόνδε.definition: Adv. to or towards a river, Il.21.13, Od.10.159, al

πρέμνοθεν.definition: or Adv. from the stump, i. e. utterly, cj. for A.Th.71, 1061 ; from the bottom, cj. in Call.Del.35

πρεπόντως.definition: Adv. part. of fitly, meetly; c. dat., in a manner befitting, suitably to, Pl.Lg.699d, cf. 835b: c. gen., in a manner worthy of, Id.Mx.239c

προβάδην.definition: Adv., as one walks, Hes.Op729; lead them out onward, Ar.Ra.352 : metaph., advancing gradually, of intervals in musical scales, Iamb.VP26.121

προεσκεμμένως.definition: Adv. with forethought, Antyll. ap. Orib.45.17.9

προηγουμένως.definition: Adv. part. of previously; principally, directly, as the primary or initial action, S.E.P.2.240; opp. Thphr.Ign.14, Plu.Demetr.1

προκληδί.definition: Adv. by challenge, Theodos. Gr.pp.74, 78 Göttling, Suid

προμηθικῶς.definition: Adv. shrewdly, warily, with allusion to the name Prometheus, Ar.Av.1511

προοικονομικῶς.definition: Adv. by way of preparation, Sch.S.El.448

προόντως.definition: Adv. in priority to Being, Iamb.Myst.8.2

πρόπαλαι.definition: Adv. very long ago, Ar.Eq.1155, cf. Plu.2.674f, Luc.JTr.26; Them.Or.2.38a

προπέρυσι.definition: before a vowel Adv. two years ago, Pl.Euthd.272b, D.20.33, 33.25, PThead.16.4 , cj. in Lys.9.4, etc.: but is Att. acc. to A.D.Adv.166.25, Phryn.PSp.105 B., and is required by the metre in Pherecr.182

προπροκαταΐγδην.definition: Adv. rushing down and onward, A.R.2.595

προσεοικότως.definition: Adv. so as to resemble, D.Chr.12.55

προσέτι.definition: Adv. over and above, besides, Hdt.1.41, Ar.Ach.984, Av.855 , Th.1.80, Pl.Phlb.30b, etc.; sts. separated by a word, X.An.3.2.2, Cyr.6.2.18; SIG827 iii 4 ; both orders in X.Cyr.2.1.31

προσεχόντως.definition: Adv. of I.4, attentively, carefully, Hp.Dent.12, Men.Mon.191, Crito ap. Gal.13.884

προσηκόντως.definition: Adv.suitably, fitly, as beseems the dignity of the state, Th.2.43, cf. Pl.Lg.659b, Isoc.3.27, 6.70, Hyp.Eux.17, Men.Epit.490, etc

πρόσθεν.definition: and in Poets also in Ion. Prose; of Place or Space, before, Il.5.170; 13.385, cf. 392, etc.; 19.13; Od.22.4, cf. Il.23.877; before, i.e. outside, 12.145, cf. 9.473; . . A.Pers.447; in front of them, at their head, Il.…

πρόσσοθεν.definition: Adv., Ep. for read by Aristarch. in Il.23.533

προσχαρακτηρικῶς.definition: Adv. as extension of character, dub. in Phld.Lib.p.6O

πρόσωθεν.definition: Att. Dor. Archyt.1, Ep; distantly, in sense, D.L.7.16

προσωπικῶς.definition: Adv. in respect of grammatical person, Choerob.in Theod.2.29H

προταινί.definition: Adv. in front of, E.Rh.523 : Boeot. = IG7.1739.14 , 2406.6

προτέρωσε.definition: Adv. toward the front, forward, h.Hom.32.10, A.R.1.306, etc.; ib.1241

πρότριτα.definition: Adv., for three days before, or for three successive days, Th.2.34, CIG3641b22 ; Aristid.Or.51.34

προτροπάδην.definition: Dor. Adv., turned forwards, i.e. headforemost, with headlong speed, Il.16.304; Pi.P.4.94; Pl.Smp.221b, Arr.An.3.28.3; Plb.12.4.4; to drive headlong, Plu.Ages.18; Ph.2.432

προχθές.definition: Adv. the day before yesterday, PLips.37.12 , Sch.Philostr.Her.p.578 B

πρυμνόθεν.definition: Adv. = A.R.4.911, Arat.343, etc; from the bottom: hence, utterly, root and branch, A.Th.71,1061

πρωΐθεν.definition: Adv., from morning, LXXEx.18.13, Ru.2.7; ib.3 Ki.18.26; cf. Hdn.Gr.1.501

πρῴραθεν.definition: Ion. in Poets before a consonant Adv. from the ship's head, from the front, Pi.P.4.22, 10.52, Th.7.36, etc.; opp. Theoc.22.11; Q.S.14.378

πυθμενόθεν.definition: Adv. from the foundation, not at all, Hp.Acut.40, cf. Erot

Πυθόθεν.definition: Adv., from Pytho or Delphi, St.Byz

Πυθοῖ.definition: Adv., at Pytho or Delphi, Pi.O.7.10; to Pytho or Delphi, Plu.Demetr.11.—The trisyll. form is cited by Choerob.in Theod.1.310 H. from Pi., cf. I.7 .51

Πυθώδε.definition: Adv., to Pytho, Od.11.581, S.OT603,788, Ar.Av.189, SIG56.9 , Pl.Lg.950e

Πύλονδε.definition: Adv. to or towards Pylos, Il.11.760, Od.3.182

πύππαξ.definition: an exclamation of admiration, bravo! Pl.Euthd.303a, Com.Adesp.1130

πυργηδόν.definition: Adv. towerwise, Aret.SD2.13; of soldiers, in masses or columns, in close array, Il.12.43, 13.152, 15.618, D.H.6.33; also of clouds, Nonn.D.32.76
